title: GLOBAL SOLARENERGYTRANSPORTATIONNETWORK
abstract: A solar energy transportation system for transporting solar energy is described. The solar energy transportation system comprises one or more solar energy collectors configured to collect solar energy and are configured to be enabled in the presence of solar energy. The system further includes one or more solar energy converters configured to receive the collected solar energy from the one or more solar energy collectors and configured to be enabled in the presence of minimal solar energy. The solar energy collectors and solar energy converters are distributed across a plurality of time zones thereby forming a global network. The system further includes one or more guiding devices configured to couple the solar energy collectors to the solar energy converters.

title: RANKING CALCULAION APPARATUS OF PHOTOVOLTAIC POWER GENERATION SYSTEM AND DETECTION METHOD
abstract: The present invention relates to a device for calculating the generation ranking of a solar energy generation system and a method thereof capable of improving the efficiency of solar energy generation by analyzing an installation state and an operation state of each solar energy generation unit installed for each field, calculating the generation ranking, and displaying the generation ranking. The device for calculating the generation ranking of the solar energy generation system comprises a plurality of solar energy generation units, a solar energy measurement unit, a solar energy generation ranking calculation unit, and a solar energy generation monitoring unit. The plurality of solar energy generation units comprises a solar battery module which is installed in each field and converts solar energy into electric energy. The solar energy measurement unit is installed in each solar energy generation unit; measures air temperature and the temperature, the amount of solar radiation, the generation time, and the generation amount of the solar battery module; and diagnoses fault, cleaning, and maintenance. The solar energy generation ranking calculation unit calculates reference generation amount with the generation time and the generation ratio of each solar energy generation unit based on a lot of information measured in the solar energy measurement unit and calculates the generation ranking by comparing the reference generation amount with real generation amount and calculating an increase ratio of solar energy generation according to the installed capacity of each solar energy generation unit. The solar energy generation monitoring unit monitors a generation state, monitoring, diagnosis, analysis, and a report with the ranking information of each solar energy generation unit, which is calculated in the solar energy generation ranking calculating unit, in real time.

title: Solar-powered seawater desalination system in fixed point array
abstract: The invention relates to focusing of solar energy, and in particular relates to a solar-powered seawater desalination system which collects solar energy by means of point focusing solar energy mirrors and is applied to focusing tracking solar energy. The invention provides the solar-powered seawater desalination system in a fixed point array. The system comprises at least one or one group of point focusing solar energy mirrors, at least one seawater desalination device and a tracking control device. The solar energy mirrors are arranged on a solar energy bracket, and the seawater desalination device is arranged in a pointy area focused by the solar energy mirrors. The focal length of the solar energy mirrors in the process of tracking solar energy changes and is always maintained in the pointy area of the seawater desalination device. The tracking control device controls the solar energy mirrors to focus sunlight to at least one seawater desalination device when sunlight changes. The seawater desalination devices do not move with the solar energy mirrors in the process of tracking solar energy by the solar energy mirrors, and the seawater desalination devices are stationary relative to the ground, so that solar energy is tracked and focused.

title: 3-three dimensional solar energy system-high tech
abstract: PURPOSE: A three-dimensional solar energy system is provided to pragmatize, commercialize and generalize a solar energy system by using a solar cell. A cylindrical solar energy system, a pole-shaped solar energy system, a weight-shaped solar energy system, a polygonal solar energy system and a ball-shaped solar energy system are installed in the solar energy system. The sunlight is absorbed in the solar energy system and continuously reflected on the mirrors. By repeating absorption and reflection of the sunlight in the solar energy system, the amount of light and heat absorption is maximized. Herein, a both-sided mirror, a polygonal mirror, a spherical mirror, a cylindrical mirror and a pole-shaped mirror are included in the solar energy system. Thus, chain reflection occurs and light is geometrically activated, intensified and developed. Therefore, the amount of light and heat absorbed in the solar energy system is maximized.

abstract: A solar thermal power plant for converting solar energy into electrical energy is provided. The supercritical fluid is preferably supercritical water. Additionally a method for converting solar energy into electrical energy by using the solar thermal power plant is provided, wherein the solar energy is converted into thermal energy of the working fluid and the thermal energy of the working fluid is converted into electrical energy.

title: SOLAR ENERGY COLLECTION PIPE RETAINING STRUCTURE OF PHOTOVOLTAIC POWER GENERATION SOLAR ENERGY COLLECTION COMPOSITE PANEL
abstract:

title: Solar energy corridor lighting device
abstract: A solar energy corridor lighting device installed on a building comprises sunlight receiving panels, a solar energy battery, a solar energy lamp and a switch. The solar energy corridor lighting device can be widely popularized and used.

abstract: The utility model provides a solar -energy light collector, includes base, pole setting, solar energy solar panel and driver part, the base is fixed subaerial, vertically on the base installs the polesetting, and fixed a plurality of solar energy solar panels are supported as supporting the dead lever to the pole setting, are equipped with a plurality of solar energy solar panels, the rotatable skew under the driver part effect of solar energy solar panel along the pole setting direction of height. title: Iron shoe cabinet
abstract: The embodiment of the utility model provides an iron shoe cabinet, and energy supply equipment for the iron shoe cabinet comprises a solar energy power supply device which comprises a solar panel and is used for absorbing solar energy and converting the solar energy into electric energy; the energy storage device is electrically connected with the solar power supply device and is used for storing electric energy to charge the iron shoes; wherein the solar panel is rotationally connected with the energy storage device. According to the energy supply equipment for the iron shoe cabinet, the solar power supply device absorbs solar energy, converts the solar energy into electric energy and supplies energy to the energy storage device, and the solar panel is rotationally connected with the energy storage device, so that the solar panel can rotate relatively and rotate in real time along with the illumination direction; therefore, the solar power supply device has higher charging efficiency in unit time.

title: SIDE SOLAR CONCENTRATOR
abstract: PURPOSE: A side solar energy concentration device is provided to improve generality by reducing manufacturing costs. CONSTITUTION: A side solar energy concentration device comprises a solar energy-collecting part(20) and a side solar energy-collecting member(30). The solar energy-collecting part is composed of a unit solar energy-collecting concentration module(21) and a solar energy-collecting guide part(22). The solar energy-collecting guide part is protruded or recessed corresponding to the lower part of the unit solar energy-collecting concentration module and guides a first spot beam. The side solar energy-collecting member is located on the lower part of the solar energy-collecting part corresponding to the unit solar energy concentration module one by one. A reflecting body(31) is formed, in stepped shape, in the side solar energy-collecting member. The reflecting body reflects the first spot beam in a horizontal direction.

title: Solar energy concentration device
abstract: A solar energy concentrating device for concentrating the intensity of solar radiation impinging on a solar collector includes a plurality of adjacently positioned tapered solar energy passageways having solar energy reflecting walls. These tapered solar energy passageways are disposed in an arcuate array to form a solar energy concentrating device. The convex side of the concentrating device is the outer surface of the concentrating device through which solar energy enters the tapered solar energy passageways, and the concave side of the concentrating device is the inner surface of the concentrating device from which concentrated solar energy emerges from the concentrating device. A solar collector is located to the concave side of the concentrating device so that the concentrated solar energy leaving the concentrating device will impinge on the solar collector.

title: Vegetable greenhouse's solar energy energy supply system
abstract: The utility model provides a vegetable greenhouse's solar energy energy supply system, including lightning protection solar energy energy supply system, lightning protection solar energy energy supply system includes solar energy power supply system and solar collector, solar energy power supply system is including the solar module, control of charge and discharge unit and two the at least power storage unit that connect gradually, solar module lays on vegetable greenhouse's ceiling, solar energy power supply system still includes lightning protection device, adoption solar energy has reduced the consumption to conventional energy as vegetable greenhouse's the energy energy, simultaneously, be provided with lightning protection device, can avoid thunderstorm weather to cause harm to solar energy power supply system.

title: Household solar energy lighting device
abstract: The utility model discloses a household solar energy lighting device which comprises a solar energy controller, wherein the signal input end of the solar energy controller is connected with a photovoltaic cell panel component; and the signal input/output end of the solar energy controller is connected with a solar energy storage cell; and the signal output end of the solar energy controller is connected with a lamp. The photovoltaic cell panel component in the household solar energy lighting device directly converts the received light energy to electric energy, and the electric energy is conveyed to the solar energy storage cell for storage by an electric cable via the solar energy controller; and the solar energy storage cell sends a direct current to a main line of each function chamber via the solar energy controller, so as to light the lamp of each function chamber of a house.

title: Wind-solar integrated energy storage system coupled with thermochemical heat storage and operation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a coupling thermochemical heat storage wind-solar integrated energy storage system and an operation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of wind-solar power generation and heat energy storage. The wind-solar integrated energy storage system comprises an energy storage system and an energy release system. When the solar energy and the wind energy are sufficient, the solar energy is utilized to drive the thermochemical energy storage reactor to store the wind energy and the solar energy; when the solar energy and the wind energy are insufficient and electricity consumption is in a valley, the wind energy, the solar energy and heat energy supplemented by the electric heater are uniformly stored in the solar-driven thermochemical energy storage reactor; when solar energy and wind energy are insufficient and power consumption is in a peak period, the energy release system converts heat released by reaction in the solar-driven thermochemical energy storage reactor into electric energy, and the demand of a power grid load is met. According to the system, solar energy and wind energy are coupled and converted into stable high-quality electric energy, the problem that fluctuation is large when solar energy and wind energy are used for grid connection is solved, and the system is an effective method for absorbing clean energy and stabilizing power grid fluctuation.

title: Solar energy signal controlling system
abstract: The utility model discloses a solar energy signal controlling system, including solar panel, solar charging ware, solar energy signal lamp support, removal solar energy semaphore, solar energy signal lamp, handheld functional module, the bottom of solar energy signal lamp support is equipped with the box, solar charging ware, removal solar energy semaphore, handheld functional module all are located in the box, solar panel, solar energy signal lamp support, solar energy signal lamp all are located outside the box, the solar energy signal lamp is installed on solar energy signal lamp support, solar panel is located the box that removes solar energy semaphore top position. The utility model discloses control the flexibility, the change procedure is simple, and manual module can remotely be controlled, and remote controller operation is simple, good reliability, frequency stabilization height, and the interference killing feature is strong.

title: Separable solar energy storage device
abstract: A separable solar energy storage device, comprising a solar energy reception device, a solar energy conversion circuit, an extension cord for connecting the solar energy reception device and the solar energy conversion circuit, and storage batteries connecting to the solar energy conversion circuit, the solar energy reception device can be disposed, through connection to the extension cord, at the optimal position for the most efficient reception of solar energy, so as to enable storage batteries to achieve the optimal energy-storage efficiency.

title: Solar energy system and solar plate adjustment system
abstract: A solar energy system having a solar plate adjustment system is disclosed. The solar energy system is used for automatically search a best angle for receiving the most solar energy. The solar energy system is automatically toward to east everyday after receiving the solar energy. The solar energy system is able to control the open/close time for a load for saving the energy.

title: A SUNBEAM-BOILER USING WATER CONVEX LENS
abstract: PURPOSE: A sunbeam-boiler using a water convex lens is provided to heat water using solar energy by focusing the solar energy inside a solar energy heater. CONSTITUTION: A sunbeam-boiler using a water convex lens comprises a solar energy heater(100), a solar energy hole(110), a sun light reflection mirror(120) and a water convex lens(200). The solar energy hole is formed on top of the solar energy heater. The sunlight reflection mirror is located on the inner wall of the solar energy heater. The water convex lens is located on the solar energy heater. The water convex lens continuously accumulates solar energy through the solar energy hole by the solar energy heater. A water heating film(300) is in the sun light reflection mirror in the solar energy heater. The hot water is made by passing the water between the water heating film and the water convex lens.

title: Solar energy motorcycle
abstract: Some existing solar energy motorcycles use solar energy battery panels to charge batteries. The solar energy motorcycles are energy-saving, environmentally friendly and easy to use; but the existing solar energy motorcycles basically hold up the solar energy battery panels on luggage racks of the motorcycles, and the solar energy battery panels are difficultly fixed so as to increase resistance and cause a certain risk when driving. The invention designs a solar energy motorcycle. The solar energy motorcycle is safe and reliable without obstructing driving, and the solar energy battery panel is mounted on the motorcycle body.

title: Solar energy harvesting protecting sheath and back-side cover of mobile device
abstract: The present disclosure provides a solar energy harvesting protecting sheath for installing to the back-side cover of a mobile device. The solar energy harvesting protecting sheath comprises a body, a solar energy receiving unit, a solar energy harvesting circuit, a thermal resistive layer and an energy transmission interface. A containing portion of the body is for accommodating the mobile device. The solar energy harvesting circuit is disposed in the body and coupled to the solar energy receiving unit. The solar energy harvesting circuit has at least an energy storage unit for storing solar energy. The thermal resistive layer disposed in the body is placed between the solar energy receiving unit and the solar energy harvesting circuit. The energy transmission interface is coupled to the energy storage unit and transmits the energy in the energy storage unit to the mobile device through an electrical connector of the mobile device.

title: Solar energy converting device and method and unit for converting solar energy
abstract: The invention discloses a solar energy converting device and method and unit for converting solar energy, and belongs to the field of conversion of solar energy. The solar energy converting device comprises a solar energy panel, a solar energy controller and an electricity energy storing device; the solar energy controller is respectively connected with the solar energy panel and the electricity energy storing device; the solar energy controller comprises a communication interface and a processor which are interconnected; the communication interface is used for receiving an operation instruction sent by a household gateway device and sending the operation instruction to the processor, wherein the operation instruction is generated by a user device and sent to the household gateway device; the processor is used for performing the operation as indicated by the operation instruction. With the adoption of the solar energy converting device, the problem that the solar energy can be converted into electricity only and the function is simple can be solved, and the effect of enriching the functions of the solar energy conversion device is achieved.

title: Solar energy shutter
abstract: The invention relates to a solar energy shutter. Slats of the shutter are provided with solar cell plates stuck to the slats through bonding layers; the solar cell plates on all the slats are connected in series to form a solar cell set; and the shutter also comprises a solar energy generating set consisting of the solar cell set, a solar energy controller, an inverter, a storage cell and a device connected to a household circuit. The invention has the advantages that each solar slat is used as a solar energy generating plate; by means of a unique structural design, the solar energy shutter with a simple and practical structure is provided for people, and sunlight irradiated by the solar energy generating plate is converted into electric energy as the electric energy of other electric apparatus. In the invention, a common shutter is combined with a household solar energy generating system, huge sunlight energy irradiated outside the shutter is converted to be used by people, therefore, the solar energy shutter is energy-saving and environment friendly.

title: Separable solar energy storage device
abstract: A separable solar energy storage device, comprising a solar energy reception device, a solar energy conversion circuit, an extension cord for connecting the solar energy reception device and the solar energy conversion circuit, and storage batteries connecting to the solar energy conversion circuit, the solar energy reception device can be disposed, through connection to the extension cord, at the optimal position for the most efficient reception of solar energy, so as to enable storage batteries to achieve the optimal energy-storage efficiency.

title: Heat dissipation solar energy frame
abstract: The utility model discloses a heat dissipation solar energy frame, including solar panel and solar energy frame, solar panel's one end is fixed in among the solar energy frame, solar energy frame is provided with the seal groove with solar panel's junction, solar energy frame's interior side is provided with one deck rubber packing pad, solar energy frame's outside limit is provided with a plurality of heat radiation fins, the utility model has the advantages of reasonable design, can be effectual dispel the heat to solar energy frame, prevent that solar energy frame from deforming because ofoverheated emergence, increased solar energy frame's life.

title: Solar energy gathering device and solar energy supply system
abstract: The invention provides a solar energy gathering device and a solar energy supply system. The solar energy gathering device comprises two or more solar energy gathering units, the solar energy gathering units comprise condensers and light guides, the condensers are mounted at one ends of the light guides, and the ends, away from the condensers, of the two or more light guides are gathered to form asolar energy output part. The solar energy gathering device can gather sunlight, the energy loss in the solar energy gathering process is small, more solar energy can be obtained, and then the utilization efficiency of the solar energy is improved.

title: SIMULATING A QUANTITY OF INTEREST OF LARGE SOLAR ENERGY INSTALLATIONS
abstract: A method for simulating a quantity of interest of a solar energy installation comprising a plurality of solar energy elements (2) and/or of parts thereof, comprising: identifying (103) a plurality of groups of solar energy elements within the solar energy installation, wherein a performance variable is similar for each of the solar energy elements (2) within the group; obtaining (104), for each group, a representative solar energy element (2) of which the performance variable is representative for the group; simulating (105) a quantity of interest of the representative solar energy element (2) of each group; and determining (106), from the quantity of interest of the representative solar energy element (2) of each group, the quantity of interest of the solar energy installation and/or of at least one solar energy element (2) of the solar energy installation.

title: SOLAR ENERGY ALIGNMENT AND COLLECTION SYSTEM
abstract: A solar energy alignment and collection system includes at least two solar energy receivers having a central focal point, with each of the at least two solar energy receivers generating an energy output. An actuation system is operatively coupled to the at least two solar energy receivers and is configured and disposed to shift the solar energy receivers along at least one axis. A control system, operatively linked to the solar receivers and the actuation system, senses the energy output of each solar energy receiver and shifts the actuation system along the at least one axis causing solar energy to be directed at the central focal point. When solar energy is directed at the central focal point, the energy output of each solar energy receiver is substantially identical.

title: Solar charging device of light box
abstract: The invention relates to a solar charging device of a light box. The light box (1) is provided with solar energy chips (2); the solar energy chips (2) absorb solar energy; the solar energy is converted into electrical energy through an energy conversion module (5); when the solar energy is not sufficient to support the operating state of the light box (1), a central control module (3) switches on a circuit (4), so that charging can be performed; the solar energy chips (2) are distributed at the side edges and top of the light box (1); the power source of the light box (1) is dependent on the solar energy and the circuit; the central control module (3) determines a power source according to the use situation of the solar energy; and the solar energy chips (2) absorb the solar energy and store the solar energy in the energy conversion module (5). The solar energy is converted into the electrical energy, so that the operation of the light box can be maintained, and therefore, electricity can be saved, and environmentally-friendly electricity utilization can be realized.

title: SOLAR ENERGY POWER GENERATION SYSTEM
abstract: The present invention relates to a solar energy power generation system that is capable of effectively collecting solar energy, thereby generating electricity from the solar energy. According to the present invention, the solar energy power generation system includes: a solar energy collecting unit for collecting solar energy to convert an energy absorbing medium into the energy absorbing medium in a gas state; a vacuum turbine for providing kinetic energy through the energy absorbing medium in the gas state generated from the solar energy collecting unit; a power generation unit for converting the kinetic energy supplied from the vacuum turbine into electrical energy; a condenser for cooling the energy absorbing medium in the gas state discharged from the vacuum turbine to a liquid state; and a circulating pump for pumping the energy absorbing medium in the liquid state cooled by the condenser to the solar energy collecting unit, wherein the solar energy collecting unit includes a hollow solar energy collecting tube having an energy absorbing medium flow path formed therein to move the energy absorbing medium and a lens for collecting the solar energy to the solar energy collecting unit.

title: SOLAR ENERGY CONCENTRATION DEVICE AND SOLAR ENERGY SUPPLY SYSTEM
abstract: Provided in the present disclosure are a solar energy concentration device and a solar energy supply system. The solar energy concentration device comprises at least two solar energy concentration units. Each solar energy concentration unit comprises a condenser and a light guide. The condensers are installed at one end of the light guides, and one end of each of at least two light guides away from the condensers converge to form a solar output part. The solar energy concentration device may concentrate sunlight, and energy loss during the solar energy concentration process is little, and more solar energy may be obtained, thereby improving the utilization efficiency of solar energy.

title: SOLAR ENERGY HARVESTING PROTECTING SHEATH AND BACK-SIDE COVER FOR MOBILE DEVICE
abstract: The present disclosure provides a solar energy harvesting protecting sheath for installing to the back-side cover of a mobile device. The solar energy harvesting protecting sheath comprises a body, a solar energy receiving unit, a solar energy harvesting circuit, a thermal resistive layer and an energy transmission interface. A containing portion of the body is for accommodating the mobile device. The solar energy harvesting circuit is disposed in the body and coupled to the solar energy receiving unit. The solar energy harvesting circuit has at least an energy storage unit for storing solar energy. The thermal resistive layer disposed in the body is placed between the solar energy receiving unit and the solar energy harvesting circuit. The energy transmission interface is coupled to the energy storage unit and transmits the energy in the energy storage unit to the mobile device through an electrical connector of the mobile device.

title: Portable solar energy power supply system
abstract: The invention provides a portable solar energy power supply system. The portable solar energy power supply system comprises a solar energy panel and a current condenser, wherein absorbed solar energy is converted by the solar energy panel into electrical energy which is stored in the current condenser electrically connected with the solar energy panel, and the solar energy panel is detachably mounted at an inner side or an outer side of a window. Through the portable solar energy power supply system, a problem that the solar energy panels can not be commonly used in city because of having no mounting places in residential buildings of city people is solved. The portable solar energy power supply system is widely applied to the energy source field.

title: A mobile terminal
abstract: The invention is applicable to the technical field of solar energy conversion, and provides a mobile terminal, comprising a display screen module, a solar circuit module, a solar energy processing module and an external power supply. The solar energy circuit module and the solar energy processing module are arranged inside the display screen module. The solar energy circuit module is used for collecting solar energy, converting the collected solar energy into electric energy and sending the electric energy to the solar energy processing module for processing. The solar energy processing moduleis used for processing the received electric energy, and the processed electric energy is used for supplying power to the display screen module. The external power supply is used for supplying powerto the display screen module. The service life of the external power supply can be prolonged by the above method.

title: 태양광 전광판, 태양관 가로등, 태양열 전광판, 태양열 지붕, 태양열 창문, 태양열 가로등, 태양열 창문덧뎀, 태양열 스텐드, 태양열 받침, 태양열 거치대
abstract: The present invention relates to sunlight and, more particularly, to solar energy. Solar energy is contacted in daily life to have an effect of reducing emissions and energy substitution of other power plants.

title: Solar heat air generating set
abstract: The invention discloses a solar thermal power generator, which mainly consists of three parts, namely a solar thermal collector, a solar thermal energy accumulator and a power tower. The solar thermal energy collector comprises a solar diffusing thermal energy collector and a solar focusing thermal energy collector, wherein the solar diffusing thermal energy collector is directly connected with the power tower, and the collected solar thermal energy heats air and sends the air to the power tower; and the solar focusing thermal energy collector collects the diffused solar thermal energy, and converts the energy into high-temperature thermal media to store in the solar thermal energy accumulator which transmits the thermal media to the power tower for generating through a thermal media pipeline. Compared with the prior solar power generator, the solar thermal power generator requires less energy transformation, has less energy loss and high solar energy utilization rate; moreover, the construction cost of a power plant is lower, and the generating cost is close to that of a solar thermal power generating system of coal and electricity, so that the solar thermal power generator is suitable for promotion and use.

title: Remote control and solar energy strage system using wireless resonant power transfer apparatus
abstract: The present invention relates to a solar energy storage system using lithium ions and flow cells. More specifically, the solar energy storage system induces a wireless inter-charging operation between a detachable flow battery storing power generated with solar light and adjacent communities in rural areas without an electrical power network of an electrical power company to build an electrical power network as a foundation facility. The solar energy storage system has a detachable structure to be used easily in an outdoor environment or in a camp site. The solar energy storage system includes a solar energy system connection controller and a wireless solar energy charging guide device. According to the present invention, the solar energy system connection controller of the solar energy storage system includes: a solar panel; a solar energy storage device which stores power generated by the solar panel and discharges the stored power to a system load; a control device which executes a control operation to connect the electrical energy stored in the solar energy storage device to adjacent systems through the wireless solar energy charging guide device. The wireless solar energy charging guide device executes a guide operation to connect and distribute the electrical energy stored in the solar energy storage device to systems and to other solar energy storage devices within a predetermined distance in a wireless charging method.

title: Flat solar energy converter
abstract: The utility model discloses a flat solar energy converter, which comprises a solar energy collector module, wherein the solar energy collector module comprises a solar energy absorbing plate and a working medium conduit, the solar energy absorbing plate comprises a front side and a reverse side, the front side of the solar energy absorbing plate is provided with a solar energy absorbing coating which is used for converting solar energy into heat energy, or a solar photovoltaic cell is arranged to convert the solar energy into electric energy and heat energy at the same time, the reverse side of the solar energy absorbing plate is provided with an annular neck structure, the working medium conduit is buckled in the annular neck, and heat conduction grease is filled between the working medium conduit and the annular neck. The flat solar energy converter disclosed by the utility model also comprises a phase change heat energy exchange system and has the characteristics of high efficiency, simple structure and low manufacturing cost.

title: Hot water combination system is concentrated with solar energy to solar airconditioning
abstract: The utility model discloses a hot water combination system is concentrated with solar energy to solar airconditioning, concentrate the hot water unit including a plurality of solar energy air conditioning unit and a plurality of solar energy, this system can realize solar energy air conditioning unit and solar energy and concentrate the hot water unit one to one, the one -to -many, the many to one, the combination of multi -to -multi, in application, can concentrate hot water unit partial shipment in the rural area of difference with a plurality of solar energy air conditioning unit and a plurality of solar energy, these solar energy air conditioning unit and solar energy are concentrated the hot water unit to constitute a solar energy and are used multipurposely the system, can concentrate the hot water unit to carry out centralized management the solar energy air conditioning unit and the solar energy in same rural area or several neighbouring rural areas, carry out energy allotmentbetween each solar energy air conditioning unit and the concentrated hot water unit of solar energy, make the supply and demand trend towards balanced state, the maximize utilizes solar energy resource. This will greatly impel solar energy to use in rural areas's scale, and new rural construction provides strong technical support for socialism.

title: Solar energy storing method and system
abstract: The present invention relates to a solar energy storing method and system. The solar energy storing method includes the steps as follows: S1, collecting solar energy by a solar energy plate and converting the collected solar energy into electric energy; S2, detecting the real-time maximum power of the solar energy plate; S3, controlling the solar energy plate to input the electricity energy with the real-time maximum power to a main energy storing module; S4, judging whether the electricity energy of the main energy storing module is full or not, stopping the input of the electricity energy to the main energy storing module if the electricity energy of the main energy storing module is full, and returning the step S1 if the electricity energy of the main energy storing module is not full. The solar energy storing method and system can efficiently utilize solar energy, has the advantages of energy conservation and environmental protection, and can efficiently input the electricity energy converted from solar energy to the energy storing module.

title: Solar energy and air energy combination hot water control system
abstract: The utility model provides a solar energy and air energy combination hot water control system. The solar energy and air energy combination hot water control system comprises a solar energy circulating system, an air energy circulating system and a transition water pump connected with the solar energy circulating system and the air energy circulating system. The solar energy and air energy combination hot water control system is reasonable in design, the solar energy circulating system and the air energy circulating system are reasonably combined, solar energy is fully utilized, air energy is combined to overcome the shortcoming that the solar energy is subject to the climate influence, the solar energy utilization rate can be improved by about 40%, and the use cost is reduced.

title: Solar energy acquisition device
abstract: The utility model discloses a solar energy acquisition device which belongs to the field of solar energy utilization and comprises a bracket and a solar energy acquisition panel arranged on the bracket, the outer surface of the solar energy acquisition panel takes on a cone shape, and the solar energy acquisition panel is designed in an array manner. By adopting the solar energy acquisition device, with limited land occupation area, solar energy acquisition area is enlarged, and the output power of solar power generation is increased; and most of the dispersed and reflected light of the sunlight is absorbed by the surface of an adjacent solar energy acquisition panel, so that the use ratio of the solar energy is improved.

title: Solar energy heating water system provided with solar energy total heat meter
abstract: The utility model relates to a solar energy heating water system provided with a solar energy total heat meter. By adopting the solar energy heating water system, the utility model can measure the practical absorbed solar energy of a solar energy collector, quantify the energy saving effect of the solar energy and can establish the corresponding management method according to the practical absorbed heat quantity of solar energy in different seasons so as to improve the use efficiency of the solar energy; the solar energy heating water system comprises the solar energy collector and a water tank communicated with the solar energy collector through a water outlet pipe and a water inlet pipe; and the solar energy heating water system is characterized in that a heat quantity meter is arranged on the water outlet pipe, and a temperature sensor connected with the heat quantity meter through a signal wire is arranged on the water inlet pipe.

title: Solar energy panel charger
abstract: The utility model discloses a solar energy panel charger comprising a solar energy electric power generation system, switches and output plug heads, wherein the solar energy electric power generation system comprises a solar cell panel, a solar energy controller and a storage battery; the solar cell panel is connected with the solar energy controller; the solar energy controller is connected with the storage battery; the storage battery is connected with the switches and the plug heads. The solar energy panel charger is characterized in that electric energy is supplied through solar energy, solar energy resources are effectively used, the electric energy is saved, a plurality of electronic products can be charged at the same time, time is saved, the electronic products can be normally used by people is guaranteed, and convenience is brought to life of people.

title: Solar energy alignment and collection system
abstract: A solar energy alignment and collection system includes at least two solar energy receivers having a central focal point, with each of the at least two solar energy receivers generating an energy output. An actuation system is operatively coupled to the at least two solar energy receivers and is configured and disposed to shift the solar energy receivers along at least one axis. A control system, operatively linked to the solar receivers and the actuation system, senses the energy output of each solar energy receiver and shifts the actuation system along the at least one axis causing solar energy to be directed at the central focal point. When solar energy is directed at the central focal point, the energy output of each solar energy receiver is substantially identical.

title: SYSTEM THAT INCREASES SOLAR ENERGY PRODUCTION FOR LARGE SCALE SOLAR ENERGY INSTALLATIONS
abstract: Systems and methods for solar energy systems are disclosed. A solar energy system comprising a plurality of elevated rectilinear solar energy structures covering an area is disclosed. Each of the solar energy structures of the plurality of elevated rectilinear solar energy structures has a long side and a short side. The plurality of elevated rectilinear solar energy structures are grouped together, oriented and aligned such that the long side of each of the solar energy structures is generally parallel and at least one of the plurality of elevated rectilinear solar energy structures has a plurality of solar panels attached in a fixed manner forming a solar energy collection canopy.

title: Solar tile
abstract: The utility model relates to a solar energy utilization device, in particular relates to a solar energy tile. The utility model discloses a solar energy tile which comprises a tile substrate body and is characterized in that a solar energy battery panel is arranged on the sun-orientation surface of the tile, and the solar energy battery panel is connected with a storage battery to construct a loop through a solar energy controller. The solar energy tile has simple structure, practicality, convenience, and is widely applicable to roofs and can absorb solar energy without occupying limited space, and convert solar energy into electrical energy and store the electrical energy for standby application in future.

title: Solar energy automatic tracking photovoltaic power generation drive system
abstract: The invention provides a solar energy automatic tracking photovoltaic power generation drive system. The solar energy automatic tracking photovoltaic power generation drive system aims to provide a drive system which uses solar energy as an energy source and is used for the rotating of a solar panel. The solar energy automatic tracking photovoltaic power generation drive system comprises a solar energy groove-type panel, a solar energy automatic tracker, a solar energy battery pack, a motor box, a motor, a drive gear, a rotary shaft and a storage battery. Driven by the solar energy automatic tracker, the solar energy automatic tracking photovoltaic power generation drive system can track sunshine all-weather, photovoltaic power generation of the solar energy battery pack supplies power source for the rotating of the solar energy groove-type panel, so that the solar energy automatic tracking photovoltaic power generation drive system is provided with high solar energy utilization efficiency and mass transfer efficiency, the efficiency of a fixed type solar energy battery is normally around 10%, and the efficiency of the solar energy battery using the automatic tracking technology can be up to around 20%. Due to the fact that the driving power source is supplied by the solar power generation, the solar energy automatic tracking photovoltaic power generation drive system gets over the constraint of an external power source, and thus high efficiency, energy conservation and self-sufficiency are achieved.

title: Energy Recovery of Secondary Obscuration
abstract: A solar energy system is provided to capture an increased amount of solar energy in an area. Methods and devices to collect obscured solar radiation and covert it into usable electrical energy are described. The devices include a major concentrated solar energy system combined with a minor solar energy system. In one embodiment, the minor solar energy system includes a primary mirror, secondary mirror and a second photocell. Primary and secondary mirrors of a minor solar energy system are defined by their location, at least a portion of which may be substantially within the concave region of the secondary mirror of a major solar energy system. The electrical connection from the minor solar energy system to the major solar energy system is described. Methods for making minor solar energy system are provided.

title: Fixed point array heat pipe solar utilization system
abstract: The utility model relates to solar energy focusing and utilization, especially the use of point-focusing solar energy mirror to realize solar energy collection and application to a fixed point array heat pipe solar energy utilization system. The utility model comprises at least one or one group of point-focusing solar energy mirror(s), at least one heat pipe utilization device and a tracking control device, wherein the solar energy mirror is arranged on a solar energy mirror bracket, the heat pipe utilization device is arranged in point-shaped region of focusing of the solar energy mirror, and arranged above or below the solar energy mirror, and the solar energy mirror has its focal distance changed during process of tracking the solar energy and maintains its focal distance always in the point-shaped region of the heat pipe utilization device; and the tracking control device controls the solar energy mirror to focus sunlight onto the at least one heat pipe utilization device when the sun changes, and during the process of the solar energy mirror tracking solar energy, the heat pipe utilization device does not move together with the solar energy mirror, and remains static relative to the ground, to realize solar energy tracking, focusing and utilization.

title: Solar energy water heater for heating
abstract: A multifunctional solar energy water heater for heating with high heat efficiency comprises a solar energy water tank. Solar energy collection vacuum tubes are fixedly connected to two sides of the solar energy water tank and communicated with the solar energy water tank; a water service pipe is arranged at the lower end of the solar energy water tank and communicated with the solar energy water tank; a heat exchanger coil is arranged in the solar energy water tank; the upper end of the heat exchanger coil passes through the upper surface of the solar energy water tank, while the lower end of the heat exchanger coil passes through the lower surface of the solar energy water tank; and an air exhaust opening is formed on the upper surface of the solar energy water tank.

title: Energy-conserving energy storage system of engineering type solar energy

abstract: The utility model provides a solar energy gathering device and a solar energy supply system, comprising at least two solar energy gathering units, each solar energy gathering unit comprises a condenser and a light guide pipe, the condenser is installed at one end of the light guide pipe, and the ends, far away from the condenser, of the at least two light guide pipes are gathered to form a solar energy output part. title: Solar charging type head-mounted tool
abstract: The invention discloses a solar charging type head-mounted tool which comprises a cap. The cap comprises a bottom buffer layer and a solar energy absorbing layer which are sequentially arranged from inside to outside. The solar energy absorbing layer is connected with a conversion input connecting wire which is connected with a solar energy converter, and a data line is detachably inserted to the solar energy converter and inserted to electronic equipment. Heat energy and light energy in solar energy are collected through the solar energy absorbing layer, the solar energy converter converts solar radiation into electric energy, and the electronic equipment is connected with the solar energy converter through the data line so as to be charged. Solar energy received by the head-mounted tool is fully utilized, the clean energy is environmentally friendly and free of pollution, whole solar energy absorbing and converting parts are small and low in weight, loads on a user are avoided, and the user can conveniently carry and use the tool.

title: SOLAR ENERGY GENERATION SYSTEM FOR HIGH TEMPERATURE ENVIRONMENT
abstract: PURPOSE: A solar energy generating system for a high temperature environment is provided to improve a cooling effect of a solar cell by separating and collecting solar energy of a spectrum band for solar power generation. A lens collects the second solar energy on the thermoelectric module unit.

title: System for obtaining energy by using solar energy
abstract: A system (100) for harvesting energy using solar energy is provided. The system for obtaining energy by using solar energy comprises at least two groups of first solar energy obtaining devices (1) which are fixed in angle and arranged front and back in rows, and at least one group of solar energy obtaining flat single-axis tracking devices (2) arranged between the two groups of first solar energy obtaining devices (1). title: Movable point array heat pipe solar energy utilization system
abstract: The utility model relates to solar energy utilization, especially the use of point-focusing solar energy mirror to realize solar energy collection and application to a movable point array heat pipe solar energy utilization system. The utility model comprises at least one or one group of point-focusing solar energy mirror(s), at least one heat pipe utilization device and a tracking control device, wherein the solar energy mirror is arranged on a solar energy mirror bracket, the heat pipe utilization device is arranged on a heat pipe utilization device bracket, in point-shaped region of focusing of the solar energy mirror, and above or below the solar energy mirror; and the tracking control device controls the solar energy mirror to focus sunlight onto the at least one heat pipe utilization device when the sun changes, and during the process of the solar energy mirror tracking solar energy, the heat pipe utilization device moves, and each or each group of solar energy mirror(s) selects the heat pipe utilization device capable of achieving the maximum solar energy utilization efficiency to perform focusing, thereby realizing solar energy tracking, focusing and utilization.

title: Solar energy photovoltaic technology teaching platform
abstract: The invention discloses a solar energy photovoltaic technology teaching platform which comprises a solar energy photovoltaic material performance testing module, a solar energy photovoltaic function detection module, a solar energy photovoltaic structure design module, a solar energy photovoltaic power generation system assembling module and a wind and solar hybrid power generation demonstration module, wherein the solar energy photovoltaic material testing module and the solar energy photovoltaic function detection module enter into the solar energy photovoltaic power generation system assembling module and the wind and solar hybrid power generation demonstration module through the solar energy photovoltaic structure design module. The solar energy comprehensive utilization system is low in cost and environmentally-friendly, and can output energy in multiple forms.

The solar energy photosensitive tracking plate aims at solving the present problems of low solar energy utilization rate and low lighting efficiency, and to install a solar energy photosensitive tracking plate on the solar energy receiving device; via the tracking plate, the solar energy receiving device can change with movement of sunlight irradiation, can track sun irradiation, and can reach highest receiving of solar light energy. To reach the purpose, a solar energy photosensitive tracking plate is provided, the solar energy photosensitive tracking plate is provided with a light hole cover, the center hole of the light hole cover is facing the central original point of the solar energy photosensitive tracking plate. The solar energy photosensitive tracking plate in the utility model can better control the position of sun irradiation, improving utilization rate of sunshine, the solar energy photosensitive tracking plate also adjusts the angle of a solar energy battery collector, making the solar energy battery collector to form a 90 degree angle with the sun irradiation light at any moment.

title: Solar energy assembly for portable electronic device
abstract: An exemplary solar energy assembly includes a body (10), a solar energy collecting component (20), and a lens module (30). The lens module is movably mounted to the body and is configured for concentrating incident solar radiation onto the solar energy collecting component. The solar energy collecting component is movably mounted to the body and is configured for converting incident solar radiation energy into electrical energy. The solar energy collecting component and the lens module are movable between a first position and a second position. In the first position the lens module, the body, and the solar energy collecting component are stacked on each other. In the second position the solar energy collecting component and the lens module are moved away from the body so as to enable the lens module to concentrate incident solar radiation onto the solar energy collecting component.

title: Solar energy charger and system
abstract: The utility model provides a solar energy charger, relates to the solar energy charging field, and aims to solve the environment pollution problems; the charger comprises a control module, and a solar energy module, a storage battery module, a machinery motor module and a charging module respectively connected with the control module, wherein the solar energy module is also respectively connected with the storage battery module, the machinery motor module and the charging module; the solar energy module is used for receiving solar energy; the machinery motor module is controlled by the control module so as to adjust a reception direction of the solar energy module; the storage battery module is controlled by the control module so as to store the solar energy received by the solar energy module; the charging module is controlled by the control module so as to use the solar energy received by the solar energy module or the power stored in the storage battery module for charging an electric device. The solar energy charger and system fully use and optimize the solar energy charging technology, thus providing energy saving and emission reduction effects.

title: Self-generating charging device
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of solar energy, in particular to a self-power-generation charging device which comprises a supporting column, a plurality of solar receiving pieces, a solar controller, a power storage piece and a charging assembly, the solar receiving pieces are arranged around the supporting column and face different directions, and the solar controller is connected with the power storage piece. The solar energy receiving part is electrically connected with the solar energy controller, the solar energy controller converts received solar energy into electric energy and stores the electric energy into the electric power storage part, and the electric power storage part is also electrically connected with the charging assembly. The solar energy receiving pieces are arranged towards the sun in multiple directions, when the position of the sun changes, the solar energy receiving pieces can still directly face the sun to receive solar energy, and therefore the receiving efficiency of the solar energy is improved.

title: System and array for tracking solar energy linearly
abstract: The invention discloses a system and an array for tracking solar energy linearly. In the invention, various solar energy optical mirrors of which the focuses are in a straight line are adopted. In a solar energy tracking process, the solar energy optical mirrors move on an axis of a straight focus line instead of an axis of the bottom line of the conventional solar energy optical mirror, and the focus line is kept still all the time or at rest relative to the ground. In the invention, the structural design that the focus line does not move is adopted, so a heat tube can be applied in heat transfer of the system; and meanwhile, other heavy solar energy-using equipment, such as solar energy photovoltaic generating equipment, a stirling generator and other kinds of large equipment, can be arranged on the focus line, so the solar energy tracing and utilization can be realized by a small drive force. The invention provides an array structure of the system to facilitate massive solar energy utilization, particularly the application of the solar energy in aspects of solar energy thermal power generation, solar energy heating, solar energy cooking, solar energy refrigeration and the like.

title: Air energy heat pump and solar energy complementary energy-saving hot water system
abstract: The utility model relates to an air energy heat pump and solar energy complementary energy-saving hot water system, and belongs to an energy-saving hot water system. The energy-saving hot water system comprises an air energy heat pump, a solar heat accumulator, a solar heat collecting pipe, a solar hot water circulating pipe and a solar hot water heat exchanger. The air energy heat pump and the solar heat accumulator serve as a heat source jointly. When sunlight is insufficient, the energy accumulated by the solar heat accumulator is insufficient, and the air energy heat pump assists in providing energy to meet the heat energy demand of the solar heat collecting pipe. When the sunlight is sufficient, excessive energy is accumulated by the solar heat accumulator, the temperature of heated water in the solar heat collecting pipe is excessively high, the solar hot water heat exchanger and the solar hot water circulating pipe conduct circular heating through residual heat, and the electric energy is saved. According to the air energy heat pump and solar energy complementary energy-saving hot water system, air energy heat pump and solar heat accumulator double-heat-source complementary heating is adopted, and the dependence on the weather of a traditional singular solar water heater is avoided; meanwhile, through the solar hot water heat exchanger and the solar hot water circulating pipe, the energy utilization rate is greatly increased, the electric energy is saved, and waste is reduced.

title: Solar greenhouse solar heating intelligent control system

According to the solar greenhouse, effective heating of the solar greenhouse can be achieved through heat stored in the hollow heat collection plate at night and in cloudy and rainy days, and consumption of other energy sources is not needed.

title: SOLAR ENERGY ALIGNMENT AND COLLECTION SYSTEM
abstract:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a solar energy alignment and collection system that facilitates tracking and improves the efficiency of collection.

SOLUTION: A solar energy alignment and collection system includes at least two solar energy receivers having a central focal point, with each of the at least two solar energy receivers generating an energy output. An actuation system is operatively coupled to the at least two solar energy receivers and is configured and disposed to shift the solar energy receivers along at least one axis. A control system, operatively linked to the solar receivers and the actuation system, senses the energy output of each solar energy receiver and shifts the actuation system along the at least one axis causing solar energy to be directed at the central focal point. When solar energy is directed at the central focal point, the energy output of each solar energy receiver is substantially identical.

title: Solar energy apparatus and method for receiving solar energy
abstract: The invention discloses a solar energy apparatus and a method for receiving solar energy. The solar energy apparatus includes a first base and a solar energy module pivoted to the first base. The solar energy module includes a first indication device and a second indication device. Besides, there is an orientation angle between the sunlight and the solar energy module, and the second indication device is for indicating light absorption efficiency related to the orientation angle of the solar energy module.

title: METHOD OF CONCETRATING SOLAR ENERGY
abstract: A method of concentrating solar energy includes receiving solar energy through a surface of an optically clear shell, guiding the solar energy through a liquid contained in the optically clear shell, folding the solar energy back through the liquid toward a solar receiver, and shifting the solar receiver within the optically clear shell to track the sun, wherein the solar energy collected by the solar receiver is converted into electrical energy.

title: Solar-energy battery assembly
abstract: The utility model relates to the technology field of solar-energy battery assembly structures. A solar-energy battery assembly comprises a plurality of solar-energy battery strings packaged by a packaging structure. Solar-energy battery panels are of the same specification and are cut from a complete solar-energy battery panel. The solar-energy battery strings in every solar-energy battery string set are mutually connected in parallel. The solar-energy battery string sets are successively connected in series. Amounts of the solar-energy battery panels in every solar-energy battery string are the same. Amounts of the solar-energy battery string in solar-energy battery string set are the same and are reciprocal of panel-cutting proportion. Compared with conventional assemblies, the solar-energy battery assembly having the same silicon chip amount has the following advantages: the output voltage and current are basically maintained the same; ohm loss generated by current through interconnection strips, series resistance of the whole assembly and nominal operation temperature (NOCT) of the solar-energy battery panels are reduced; peak output power of the assembly is lifted.

title: Solar energy control system
abstract: A solar energy control system includes a solar energy operated absorption board, a charging battery, and a load. The solar energy operated absorption board is connected to the load via the charging battery. The solar energy control system further includes a monitor device, a first ZigBee module, a second ZigBee module, and a solar energy controller. The monitor device is connected to the first ZigBee module. The second ZigBee module is connected to the solar energy controller. The monitor device controls the solar controller through the first ZigBee module and the seconde ZigBee module by a wireless mode, and sets controlling parameters. The solar energy controller is connected to the charging battery, the solar energy operated absorption board, and the load. The charging battery provides a working voltage to the solar energy controller. The solar energy controller controls the solar energy operated absorption board to charge the charging battery. The solar energy controller controls a voltage for the charging battery providing to the load by detecting a current of the load.

title: A SOLAR POWERED LIGHTING SYSTEM
abstract: Abstract A solar powered lighting system includes a solar module adapted to receive solar 5 energy and transform received solar energy into electrical energy and a lighting module. The lighting module is electrically coupled to the solar module and is configurable to emit light using electrical energy generated by the solar module only while the solar module receives solar energy. The solar module and the lighting module are electrically couplable such that light emitted from the lighting module 10 mimics a characteristic of sunlight from which the solar energy is received.

title: Integrated solar energy micro-power rainwater pumping station
abstract: The utility model discloses an integrated solar energy micro-power rainwater pumping station. The rainwater pumping station comprises a solar energy generating module arranged on the ground and a pumping station connected with the solar energy generating module and buried under the ground. The solar energy generating module comprises a solar energy cell panel, a solar energy controller, a solar energy storage battery and a photovoltaic inverter which are in signal connection in sequence. A second switch is arranged between the solar energy controller and the solar energy storage battery, a third switch is arranged between the solar energy storage battery and the photovoltaic inverter, and the solar energy controller is in signal connection with the photovoltaic inverter through a first switch. The beneficial effects of the integrated solar energy micro-power rainwater pumping station are that: the solar energy cell panel generates electric energy, the electric energy is stored in the solar energy storage battery and is employed as the micro-power energy to provide energy needed for working for a DC motor, the on/off of a DC submersible pump is automatically controlled through an electric cabinet and a liquid level float switch, so that accumulated water in city low-lying areas can be introduced into the pumping station and then discharged to rivers or ground which is easy to penetrate, and therefore disasters are reduced.

title: Active-passive solar building energy supply system
abstract: The invention discloses an active-passive solar building energy supply system which comprises an active solar energy utilization module, a passive solar house, a room energy storage and supply module and an air source heat pump. The passive solar house is arranged on the south side of a roof of the functional room, solid energy storage is achieved through a building envelope structure, and heat is supplied to the functional room. A floor of the passive solar house is used for storing solar radiation heat as an evaporation side heat source of the air source heat pump, and the air source heat pump is connected with the active solar energy utilization module to supply heat or cold to the room energy storage and supply module; the room energy storage and supply module is arranged in the functional room; the active solar energy utilization module is used for absorbing solar energy, converting the solar energy into electric energy, conducting electricity-heat conversion and supplying heat or cold to the room energy storage and supply module. The solar energy utilization efficiency is improved through direct solar energy utilization, passive solar energy storage and active solar energy storage.

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of solar energy road barrier lamps, and provides a solar energy road barrier lamp part assembling method and device and a computer storage medium. title: Combined solar energy cell structure
abstract: The present invention discloses a combined solar energy cell structure. The combined solar energy cell structure includes: a shell, a solar energy cell chip, a thin-membrane solar energy cell and a lens. The solar energy cell chip is set on the bottom of the cell, and the thin-membrane solar energy cell is set around the solar energy cell chip in an obconical form pattern. With a lens set on the opening of the shell, the shell can absorb incident light in any angle to make the incident light centralize on the solar energy cell ship efficiently. abstract: A dual-source wind-solar complementary power generator, a wind-solar power generation system utilizing wind energy and solar energy, is used to generate power by utilizing wind energy and solar energy, to provide ventilation for buildings and to service as a power generator on a solar building or a power source in other systems. The dual-source wind-solar complementary power generator comprises a power generating device (11), external blades (2), internal blades (4), an external blade arm (3), a body (5), a shaft (6), a fan bearing seat (9), a photoelectric device and the like. The dual-source wind-solar complementary power generator realizes reuse of wind energy and solar energy, generates power by utilizing wind energy and solar energy, and converts solar energy into air kinetic energy to provide power and ventilation for buildings. In addition, the photoelectric device of solar cell panels added in the dual-source wind-solar complementary power generator can assist in generating power, and convey wind energy and solar energy to and convert wind energy and solar energy for a building power generator and a ventilation and air conditioning system of a building.

This solar energy component includes light -transmitting substrate, fixed frame, solar energy power generation curtain subassembly and expandes the motor that fixed frame is connected with light -transmitting substrate, solar energy power generation curtain subassembly includes the sunshade screen and sets up the photovoltaic module on the sunshade screen surface that solar energy power generation curtain subassembly is fixed on fixed frame, expandthe motor setting on fixed frame to be connected with solar energy power generation curtain subassembly, be used for expanding the sunshade screen. title: Solar energy collection device, and natural energy efficient collection, storage and application system
abstract: The utility model relates to a solar energy collection device, and a natural energy efficient collection, storage and application system. The solar energy collection device comprises a fixed support (1) and a plurality of solar energy collectors (2), wherein a follow-up support (3) is hinged with the fixed support (1); the solar energy collectors (2) are rotatably installed on the follow-up support (3) respectively. The natural energy efficient collection, storage and application system comprises the solar energy collection device, a heat energy storage and application device and a cold energy storage and application device. According to the solar energy collection device, and the natural energy efficient collection, storage and application system disclosed by the utility model, the solar energy collection device is used to collect solar energy in a follow-up tracking manner, thereby efficiently collecting solar energy to the maximum degree; the natural energy efficient collection, storage and application system is used to perform all-around collection, storage and systematic application upon natural energies, such as solar energy, and also can be used to collect solar energy and natural cold energies and store the same with use of a storage device before the solar energy and the natural cold energies are applied.

title: Solar power forecasting using mixture of probabilistic principal component analyzers
abstract: A method for solar forecasting includes receiving a plurality of solar energy data as a function of time of day at a first time, forecasting from the solar energy data a mode, where the mode is a sunny day, a cloudy day, or an overcast day, and the forecast predicts the mode for a next solar energy datum, receiving the next solar energy datum, updating a probability distribution function (pdf) of the next solar energy datum given the mode, updating a pdf of the mode for the next solar energy datum from the updated pdf of the new solar energy datum given the mode, forecasting a plurality of future unobserved solar energy data from the updated pdf of the mode, where the plurality of future unobserved solar energy data and the plurality of solar energy data have a Gaussian distribution for a given mode determined from training data.

title: Electronic device having transformation of solar energy
abstract: An electronic device having transformation of solar energy is provided. The electronic device includes a first body, a solar energy plate, a slidable rail and a pivot. The first body has a sliding slot and a receiving space. The sliding slot is disposed in the inner of the first body. The solar energy plate has a solar energy receiving region and a pivot part. The solar energy receiving region is used for receiving solar energy and transforming the solar energy into electric energy so as to provide the electric energy to the electronic device. The solar energy plate is accommodated in the receiving space through an opening. The slidable rail is disposed in the sliding slot. The pivot is connected to the pivot part and sildable rail so that the solar energy plate is rotatable with respect to the slidable rail.

title: Solar energy Stirling engine device
abstract: The invention discloses a solar energy Stirling engine device, comprising a cylinder with a hot cavity and a cold cavity, wherein the hot cavity is a solar collecting vacuum tube, or is communicated with the solar energy collecting vacuum tube to absorb solar energy to heat the working medium by the solar collecting vacuum tube. The solar energy Stirling engine device utilizes renewable solar energy as the energy source of the engine, does not have waste gas emission and is environmentally friendly; the solar energy collecting vacuum tube is used as the hot cavity and a hot source acquiring device simultaneously, thus simplifying the device and being convenient to control; the invention is applied in solar energy generation; the solar energy Stirling engine device greatly reduces generation cost, provides hot water when the engine works, and has simple equipment and high solar energy utilization ratio.

title: Energy-saving floor radiation heating system allowing air-energy heat pump and solar energy to be mutually complemented
abstract: The utility model relates to an energy-saving floor radiation heating system allowing an air-energy heat pump and solar energy to be mutually complemented, and belongs to the technical field of energy-saving floor radiation heating. The energy-saving floor radiation heating system comprises the air-energy heat pump, a solar heat accumulator, a solar heat collection tube, a solar hot water circulating tube and a solar hot water heat exchanger, wherein the air-energy heat pump and the solar heat accumulator jointly serve as heat sources. When sunlight is insufficient, energy accumulated by the solar heat accumulator is insufficient, and the air-energy heat pump assists in supplying energy to satisfy the heat energy requirement of the solar heat collection tube. When the sunlight is sufficient, the energy accumulated by the solar heat accumulator is too much, the temperature of heated water in the solar heat collection tube is too high, the solar hot water heat exchanger and the solar hot water circulating tube utilize excess heat for cyclic heating, and therefore electric energy is saved. According to the energy-saving floor radiation heating system, the air-energy heat pump and the solar heat accumulator are adopted as the two heat sources for complementary heating, and therefore the dependence on weather by a traditional simplex solar water heater is avoided; meanwhile, as the solar hot water heat exchanger and the solar hot water circulating tube are arranged, the energy utilization rate is greatly increased, the electric energy is saved, and waste is reduced.

title: Solar energy storage device
abstract: The utility model provides a solar energy storage device. The solar energy storage device comprises a solar energy storage device body, the solar energy storage device body comprises a battery and a solar panel, and the solar panel is matched with the battery; the installation frame is arranged on the solar energy storage device body, the installation frame and the solar panel are connected with a ventilation pipe, and the ventilation pipe is arranged on the solar energy storage device body; the ventilation fan is arranged in the ventilation pipe; and the heat dissipation fins are arranged in the solar energy storage device body, and the heat dissipation fins are communicated with the ventilation pipe. The solar energy storage device provided by the utility model is better in heat dissipation effect, so that the failure rate is reduced, meanwhile, the solar panel is convenient to clean, and the energy storage efficiency is improved.

title: SOLAR ENERGY ALIGNMENT AND COLLECTION SYSTEM
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a solar energy alignment and collection system which facilitates tracking and increases collection efficiency.SOLUTION: A solar energy alignment and collection system includes at least two solar energy receivers having a central focal point, each receiver generating an energy output based on received light energy; an actuation system operatively coupled to the at least two solar energy receivers, the actuation system being configured and disposed to shift the solar energy receivers along at least one axis; and a control system operatively linked to the solar energy receivers and the actuation system, the control system sensing the energy output of each of the solar energy receivers and shifting the actuation system along the at least one axis, causing solar energy to be directed at the central focal point. When the solar energy is directed at the central focal point, the energy output of each of the solar energy receivers is substantially identical.

title: Solar seat cushion
abstract: The invention discloses a solar seat cushion taking solar energy as an energy source. The solar seat cushion comprises a support device, a solar energy utilization device and a soft seat cushion body, wherein the solar energy utilization device is arranged in the support device. Preferably, the side length of the top face of a prism frustum support is identical with that of a prism support, and heat retaining panels are inlaid on the side faces of the prism support. The solar seat cushion has the advantages that solar panels absorb solar energy and convert the solar energy into electric energy, and then the electric energy is converted into heat energy to enable the seat cushion to keep warm to a certain degree, thus, the solar seat cushion can be used by the elderly conveniently.

title: Tandem solar energy cell array device for high altitude balloon
abstract: The invention discloses a tandem solar energy cell array device for a high-altitude balloon. The tandem solar energy cell array device for the high-altitude balloon comprises a high-altitude balloon body, a pod, a solar energy cell array and an adjusting mechanism. The pod is arrange at the lower part of the high-altitude balloon body, the solar energy cell array is connected with the pod, and theadjusting mechanism is arranged on the pod and is used for controlling a structural state of the solar energy cell array. The solar energy cell array comprises a plurality of solar energy subarrays formed by solar energy power generation plates, and the solar energy subarrays are arranged in series through connecting assemblies.
