According to the tandem solar energy cell array device for the high-altitude balloon, the requirement on the strength of a frame of a solar energy power generation panel device can be reduced to reduce the weight, and the maximization of solar energy power collected in different time periods can be realized.

title: Wind-energy solar-energy charging station
abstract: The utility model discloses a wind-energy solar-energy charging station. The technology aims to provide the wind-energy solar-energy charging station which can be used for generating electricity by simultaneously applying wind energy and solar energy. The wind-energy solar-energy charging station comprises a solar-energy battery board, wherein the solar-energy battery board is connected with a charging electrode of a battery, a discharging electrode of the battery is connected with an external charging interface, and the charging electrode of the battery is also connected with a wind-power generator set. The wind-energy solar-energy charging station can be used for charging by fully utilizing solar energy and light energy, has high electricity-generating efficiency and is applicable to being applied to the charging of electric-energy automobiles.

title: Focus solar converter
abstract: The utility model discloses a light-collecting type solar energy converting device in order to solve the problem that the prior common solar-energy panel photoelectric converting device has low converting efficiency, comprising a solar energy panel and a accumulator device, the solar energy panel is connected with the center of a paraboloidal solar-energy receiving face through a solar-energy conversion connection tube, the paraboloidal solar-energy receiving face is connected with the accumulator device through a connection tube, a water storage device is connected between the back of the paraboloidal solar-energy receiving face and the solar-energy panel through a water tube, another water tube is also arranged between the front of the paraboloidal solar-energy receiving face and the back of solar energy panel, the utility model is characterized in that: a. when using the same size of solar energy panel, more energy can be obtained by the method of collecting light, the converting efficiency is high; b. solar energy panel can collect the energy generated by semi-conductor temperature difference to the accumulator device while adopting the cooling to lower temperature; c. hot water generated by the utility model is available.

title: Highly-effective laminate solar battery and method for making same
abstract: The invention relates to a high-effect laminated solar-energy battery and a relative production, which can improve the utilization of solar energy and the photoelectric conversion efficiency of solar-energy battery, belonging to the solar-energy battery and production technical field. The invention is composed of a top solar-energy battery and a transparent battery of bottom solar-energy battery which are adhered via sealing glue, or the top and bottom share one glass baseboard, wherein the top solar-energy battery is leaded out a couple of electrodes, and the bottom solar-energy battery is leaded out another couple of electrodes, to form a laminated solar-energy battery with four terminal structures. The invention can realize the best match of solar-energy battery, to improve the photoelectric conversion efficiency of solar-energy battery, and improve the quality and property of solar-energy battery. The invention can effectively resolve the problems of single solar-energy battery as narrow spectrum adsorption range and low light adsorption utilization efficiency, to effectively improve the spectrum adsorption of solar-energy battery and improve the photoelectric conversion efficiency, while the photoelectric conversion efficiency can reach 25-30%.

title: PORTABLE SOLAR ENERGY SUPPLYING DEVICE
abstract: A portable solar energy supplying device includes a body, a solar energy board, a secondary battery, a charging circuit, and a control unit. The body has a receiving space. The solar energy board is received in the receiving space, and receives solar energy and converts the solar energy into electrical power when the solar energy board is unfolded outside of the receiving space. The charging circuit is electrically connected with the solar energy board for receiving the electrical power converted by the solar energy board to charge the secondary battery. The control unit is electrically connected to the secondary battery for adjusting the output voltage of the secondary battery for an application system. Thereby, the goals of charging and supplying solar energy are achieved. The occupied space is reduced, it is convenient for the user to carry it, and the solar energy board is protected.

title: SOLAR PHOTOVOLTAIC POWER GENERATION SYSTEM
abstract: The present invention relates to a solar energy generation system having a solar energy module monitoring function considering external environmental factors. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the solar energy generation system having a solar energy module monitoring function considering external environmental factors comprises: a determining unit for determining at least one solar energy module included in solar energy array - the determining unit determines if a voltage value of a target solar energy module included in the solar energy array is a first standard value or less, and if the voltage value of the target solar energy module is the first standard value or less, it is determined if the voltage value of the target solar energy module is a total average value or less, and if the voltage value of the target solar energy module is the total average value or less, it is determined that the target solar energy module has an error; and a standard value setting unit for setting the first standard value considering external environmental factors.

title: Solar assembly with a device for heating water and associated method
abstract: The method involves receiving solar energy at a receiving position, and transferring a part of the received solar energy to water by heating the water at a transfer position that is removably arranged from the receiving position. The solar energy is transported in the form of light waves from the receiving position to the transfer position. The solar energy is focused and/or directed before transporting the energy to the water. The focused solar energy is dispersed for transfer of the energy to the water, where the solar energy heats an energy transfer unit contacted by the water. An independent claim is also included for a device for heating water by solar energy.

title: SOLAR ENERGY HARVESTING SYSTEM
abstract: Disclosed is a solar energy harvesting system comprising: a solar radiation redirecting layer, comprising an array of features with a sub millimetre scale, adapted to redirect solar radiation having a predetermined range of wavelengths; a solar radiation guiding layer for guiding solar radiation; wherein the system further comprises solar energy harvesting means adapted to convert solar energy into electric energy; where the solar radiation redirecting layer, redirects solar radiation with the predetermined range of wavelengths, towards the solar energy harvesting means. By providing the system with a solar radiation redirecting layer, a part of the solar radiation incident on the system is refracted with different angle allowing the refracted solar radiation to be guided within the solar radiation guiding layer towards the solar energy harvesting means. By using the solar radiation redirection layer to redirect the solar radiation, solar energy harvesting means having a smaller area can be used.

title: Solar Energy Concentrator
abstract: A solar energy concentrator has a solar panel comprising a plurality of solar cells, a solar energy concentrating plate including a plurality of concentrating elements, each of the concentrating elements corresponding to one solar cell, and a supporting member supporting the solar panel and the solar energy concentrating plate. The solar energy concentrating plate concentrates sunbeams to the solar panel.

title: Solar energy device and electronic device employing the same
abstract: A solar energy device ( 100 ) for an electronic device includes a solar energy collecting component ( 10 ) and a lens module ( 20 ). The solar energy collecting component has a first surface ( 105 ) and a second surface. The lens module is rotatably mounted relative to the solar energy collecting component. The lens module is configured to concentrate incident solar radiation onto the first surface of the solar energy collecting component. The solar energy collecting component is for converting incident solar radiation energy to electrical energy. The lens module is movable between a first position in which the lens module is spaced from the first surface of the solar energy collecting component so as to concentrate incident solar radiation onto the first surface and a second position in which the lens module abuts the second surface so as to reduce overall volume of the solar energy device.

title: Solar street lamp
abstract: The utility model discloses a solar street lamp, its structure includes bracing piece, street lamp chimney, LED lamp, bent type connecting rod, dead lever, lamp post, round base, accumulator case, street lamp controller, solar device, small -size connecting rod, the utility model relates to a solar street lamp, the structural solar device that is equipped with, the upper surface of bracing piece welds with solar device's lower surface mutually, when the sun appears, solar device through on the solar street lamp absorbs solar energy, on projecting the solar energy absorber plate through glass apron with the sunlight, become the electric energy through the solar energy absorber plate with solar energy conversion, give the street lamp through the solar energy connecting pipe with its power transfer, it is difficult to run off can to protect the messenger with the heat energy in the sunlight through the solar energy heat preservation, thereby let the solar energy absorber plate can absorbmore solar energy, thereby it rates higherly to reach energy utilization, the effect that power consumption is comparatively little.

title: Signal enhancement equipment for solar photovoltaic power generation based on nanotechnology
abstract: The invention discloses signal enhancement equipment for solar photovoltaic power generation based on nanotechnology in the technical field of space solar power generation; the equipment comprises a microwave tower for solar radiation energy and alternating-current batteries, each solar alternating-current battery is of a hexagonal prism structure, and the prism surface of each solar alternating-current battery is fixedly provided with a solar panel. The solar panel adopts single silicon and gallium elements as carriers and is used for receiving solar energy and converting solar radiation energy into electric energy by utilizing a photoelectric effect, a plurality of groups of solar alternating-current batteries are mutually spliced to form a honeycomb solar alternating-current battery array, the microwave tower for solar radiation energy comprises a microwave antenna. The ways of receiving solar radiation energy by the solar cell panel are increased, so that the solar radiation energy received by the solar cell panel in unit time is increased, and the energy efficiency of solar power generation is improved.

title: Disconnect -type solar lamp pole
abstract: The utility model discloses a disconnect -type solar lamp pole, choose the arm including solar energy electric power storage district, solar panel light energy transition zone and lamp holder, solar energy electric power storage district, solar panel light energy transition zone all are the cuboid form, and the cross -section of solar energy electric power storage district, solar panel light energy transition zone is the cross -section length of side that the cross -section length of side square and solar panel light energy transition zone is less than solar energy electric power storage district, the installation of solar energy electric power storage district perpendicular to the ground, solar panel light energy transition zone is installed at the top in solar energy electric power storage district, and the lamp holder is chosen the arm and is installed at the top of solar panel light energy transition zone, and the terminal installation street lamp of arm is chosen to the lamp holder. The utility model discloses the light energy transition zone uses solar panel vertically method, keeps the virtual value that the solar energy maximum area shines, really accomplishes not have thedead angle, and the solar panel of perpendicular installation prevents effectively that the condition of snow under the adverse circumstances such as sleet sky, ponding from taking place.

title: Pillar connecting device
abstract: A pillar connecting device relates to the solar cloth field and is characterized by comprising a solar cloth and a first solar polished section arranged on the solar polished section; wherein the solar cloth is provided with solar polished sections used for absorbing solar energy and generating energy, and the first solar polished section is used for absorbing solar energy and generating energy.

title: SOLAR POWER FORECASTING USING MIXTURE OF PROBABILISTIC PRINCIPAL COMPONENT ANALYZERS
abstract: A method for solar forecasting includes receiving a plurality of solar energy data as a function of time of day at a first time, forecasting (620) from the solar energy data a mode, where the mode is a sunny day, a cloudy day, or an overcast day, and the forecast predicts the mode for a next solar energy datum, receiving (622) the next solar energy datum, updating a probability distribution function (pdf) of the next solar energy datum given the mode, updating a pdf of the mode for the next solar energy datum from the updated pdf of the new solar energy datum given the mode, forecasting (624, 626) a plurality of future unobserved solar energy data from the updated pdf of the mode, where the plurality of future unobserved solar energy data and the plurality of solar energy data have a Gaussian distribution for a given mode determined from training data.

title: Solar energy collecting transmitter capable of automatically tracking sun
abstract: The invention discloses a solar energy collecting transmitter capable of automatically tracking the sun, namely a curved-surface heliostat. The solar energy collecting transmitter comprises a solar energy collecting device and a solar energy transmitting device, wherein the solar energy collecting device is provided with a first automatic tracking-correcting device for automatically tracking the sun direction; and the solar energy transmitting device is provided with a second automatic tracking-correcting device for adjusting the angle of a reflective mirror. According to the solar energy collecting transmitter, sunlight is collected through a big concave mirror and a small concave mirror and can be transmitted distantly through the reflective mirror and a transmitting cavity; the solar energy collecting device and the solar energy transmitting device are respectively provided with the tracking-correcting device, the rotation of a motor is controlled through a sensor, a processor or a photoresistor, and a relay respectively, the motor can be used for changing the directions of the solar energy collecting device and the solar energy transmitting device through a driving device, and therefore, the solar energy collecting transmitter can be wholly aligned to the sun in real time so as to collect sunlight; and the collected sunlight is transmitted distantly through the solar energy transmitting device, and light energy can be supplied for a tower type solar energy collecting device.

title: Improved type solar energy circuit device
abstract: The utility model discloses an improved type solar energy circuit device which comprises a solar energy plate and a rechargeable battery, wherein, the solar energy plate uses solar energy for providing electricity, and the rechargeable battery receives the electricity of the solar energy plate. The utility model is characterized in that the drain electrode and the source electrode of a metal oxide semiconductor field-effect transistor (MOSFET) are respectively electrically connected with the solar energy plate and the rechargeable battery, and a diode of the MOSFET is antrorsely connected between the solar energy plate and the rechargeable battery. When the solar energy plate is not used for charging, current of the rechargeable battery is prevented from flowing to the solar energy plate.

title: New energy in transportation industry
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of solar thermal power, in particular to solar thermal power applied to the transportation industry. For building a solar energy heat accumulation station, a solar energy heat accumulation warehouse and a light-catching and heat-accumulating work system circuit are required, wherein the light-catching and heat-accumulating work system circuit comprises a light-catching mechanism, a heat exchanger, a reversing valve, a high-temperature connecting valve and a solar energy mobile heat reservoir. Heat energy is stored in the solar energy mobile heat reservoir or the heat accumulation warehouse. Standby heat energy is stored in the solar energy heat accumulation warehouse. Heat energy is transferred into the solar energy mobile heat reservoir through another heat energy transfer work system circuit, so as to produce solar energy mobile energy. The solar energy mobile heat reservoir and a steam engine inside a cylinder are adopted for combined use, and the solar energy mobile heat reservoir provides a heat source to the steam engine inside the cylinder. The steam engine inside the cylinder is used as power for automobiles, and a plurality of solar energy mobile heat reservoirs can be mounted on the chassis of an automobile for alternative use. The solar energy heat accumulation stations can be built at more places on the two sides of a road, so as to replace and mount solar energy mobile heat reservoirs at any time, and the solar energy mobile heat reservoirs serve as new energy in transportation industry.

title: SOLAR ELECTRICITY GENERATION SYSTEM
abstract: A solar electricity generation system including a solar energy-to-electricity converter having a solar energy receiving surface including at least an electricity-generating solar energy receiving surface and a plurality of reflectors arranged to reflect solar energy directly onto the solar energy receiving surface, each of the plurality of reflectors having a reflecting surface which is configured and located and aligned with respect to the solar energy receiving surface to reflect specular solar radiation with a high degree of uniformity onto the solar energy receiving surface, the configuration, location and alignment of each of the reflectors being such that the geometrical projection of each reflecting surface is substantially coextensive with the electricity-generating solar energy receiving surface.

title: Mobile lattice array solar focusing alkali metal power generation system
abstract: The invention relates to solar energy utilization, in particular to that solar energy collection is realized by a point focusing solar energy mirror and is applied to a mobile lattice array solar focusing alkali metal power generation system. The mobile lattice array solar focusing alkali metal power generation system at least comprises one or one group of point focusing solar energy mirrors, at least one alkali metal power generation device and a tracking control device, wherein the solar energy mirrors are arranged on a solar energy mirror bracket; the alkali metal power generation device is arranged on an alkali metal power generation device bracket; the alkali metal power generation device is arranged in the dotted area focused by the solar energy mirrors and is arranged below or above the solar energy mirrors; the tracking control device controls the solar energy mirrors to focus sunlight to at least one alkali metal power generation device when sunlight changes; in the process that the solar energy mirrors track solar energy, the alkali metal power generation device moves; and each or each group of solar energy mirrors selects the alkali metal power generation device which can achieve the highest solar energy use ratio for focusing so as to realize the tracking focusing use of the solar energy.

title: Concrete and system for collecting solar energy and solar energy collecting method
abstract: The invention discloses a concrete and system for collecting solar energy and a solar energy collecting method. According to the concrete and the system for collecting the solar energy and the solar energy collecting method, a convex glass condensation principle is utilized, solar energy collecting components are formed by combining convex glass, reflective base materials and light-transmitting crystals, and then the solar energy collecting components are embedded into one of gravel concrete or asphalt concrete according to matrix arrangement to form the concrete for collecting the solar energy, the upper surfaces of the light-transmitting crystals of the solar energy collecting components are exposed out of the gravel concrete or the asphalt concrete, and the solar energy collecting components, a heat conduction medium, a medium pipeline, a protective sleeve, an anti-collision pad, a compression-resistant lock catch and a fixing buckle form the solar energy collecting system. The solar energy collecting method comprises the following steps that the solar energy collecting components are arranged on the medium pipeline according to a matrix, energy of sunlight is collected through the solar energy collecting components to be gathered and heated in the medium pipeline, the heat conduction medium in the medium pipeline is heated, and heat energy absorbed by the heat conduction medium is converted into other energy forms by connecting energy conversion equipment or is directly used for production and life.

title: Solar energy chip packaging method for solar energy automobile
abstract: The invention discloses a solar energy chip packaging method for a solar energy automobile. The method comprises: spraying and coating processing in which glue is evenly sprayed onto the back face of a solar energy chip; adhering the side of the solar energy chip with glue onto the top cover of the automobile body; performing solidification to the solar energy chip; covering a cover plate on the front face of the solar energy chip; and performing protection treatment to the upper surface of the cover plate. According to the solar energy chip packaging method for the solar energy automobile, through the spraying and coating processing, glue is formed on the solar energy chip, and then, the solar energy chip is adhered to the top cover of the automobile body for solidification treatment, and then, the solar energy chip is covered by a cover plate to form a packaging structure; and finally, the upper face of the cover plate of the packaging structure undergoes the protection treatment. With these steps, the purposes of water prevention and scraping prevention can be realized, and the packaging structure after the protection treatment is also easy to clean. The solar energy chip packaging method for a solar energy automobile proposed by the invention is also easy to operate and control.

title: Solar energy and ocean energy combined power generation system
abstract: A solar energy and ocean energy combined power generation system belongs to the technical field of new energy. The invention particularly relates to a solar energy and ocean energy combined power generation system and provides the solar energy and ocean energy combined power generation system capable of simultaneously employing ocean energy to generate power and solar energy to generate power. Thesolar energy and ocean energy combined power generation system comprises an ocean energy power generator, a solar module and an energy storage device, wherein the ocean energy power generator comprises at least one nanometer friction power generator, the at least one nanometer friction power generator is used for converting mechanical energy to electric energy, the solar module comprises a plurality of solar cells, the plurality of solar cells are connected in a series or parallel mode to form at least two output ends of the solar module, and each solar cell is a PN junction-structure photoelectric conversion unit formed from a semiconductor material.

title: Helicopter apron wind energy and solar energy generating system
abstract: The invention discloses a helicopter apron wind energy and solar energy generating system. The helicopter apron wind energy and solar energy generating system comprises a wind driven generator, a solar panel, a helicopter apron, a controller and a storage battery. The wind driven generator is a device which is used for converting the wind energy into the electric energy, the solar panel is a device which is used for converting the solar energy into the wind energy, and the helicopter apron is a platform which allows a helicopter to land. The controller is used for controlling the electric current of the wind driven generator and the solar panel, and the storage battery is used for storing the electric energy which is formed by the wind driven generator and the solar panel through conversion. According to the helicopter apron wind energy and solar energy generating system, the wind driven generator and the solar panel are adopted, the advantage of the solar energy and the wind energy ona high-rise building is made full use of, the solar energy and the wind energy are efficiently converted into the electric energy, and the electric energy is stored in the storage battery and used for providing a power source for lamplight on the helicopter apron.

title: Solar electricity generation system
abstract: A solar electricity generation system including a solar energy-to-electricity converter having a solar energy receiving surface including at least an electricity-generating solar energy receiving surface and a plurality of reflectors arranged to reflect solar energy directly onto the solar energy receiving surface, each of the plurality of reflectors having a reflecting surface which is configured and located and aligned with respect to the solar energy receiving surface to reflect specular solar radiation with a high degree of uniformity onto the solar energy receiving surface, the configuration, location and alignment of each of the reflectors being such that the geometrical projection of each reflecting surface is substantially coextensive with the electricity-generating solar energy receiving surface.

title: Solar energy panel heating mechanism for distiller
abstract: The invention provides a solar energy panel heating mechanism for a distiller. The mechanism is used for a distiller, the distiller is internally provided with a heating device, a current condenser isarranged below the heating device, the heating device and the current condenser are connected, and the current condenser and a solar energy panel which is arranged at the top of a tank are connected;the solar energy panel comprises multiple foldable solar energy modules, and a sprinkling apparatus, a cleaning manipulator and a cleaning pool are arranged below the solar energy panel; after the solar energy panel is folded, and the solar energy panel is vertical with the cleaning pool; the sprinkling apparatus is used for sprinkling cleaning fluid on the folded solar energy panel, and the endof the cleaning manipulator is provided with a cleaning turnplate, and the cleaning turnplate is provided with a sensor. The solar energy panel heating mechanism for the distiller is advantageous in that the product comprises the solar energy panel mechanism which can automatically store energy, and at the same time, an automatic cleaning mechanism for a solar energy panel is also provided in order to guarantee full utilization of solar energy.

title: Multifunctional solar energy cell panel device
abstract: The present utility model relates to a multifunctional solar energy cell panel device which comprises a solar energy cell panel device body and a solar energy meter, the device is characterized in that the solar energy meter is arranged on the solar energy cell panel device body, thus people can use the solar energy meter of the solar energy cell panel device body to check time. The device is simple in structure and easy to manufacture.

title: Steam injection type solar energy and thermal power station complementary power generation system
abstract: The utility model discloses a steam injection type solar energy and thermal power station complementary power generation system which comprises a first parabolic trough type solar energy heat collector, a solar energy steam generator, a flow divider, a second parabolic trough type solar energy heat collector, a solar energy superheater, a mixer, a solar energy preheater, a coal-fired boiler and a high-pressure cylinder, a medium-pressure cylinder and a low-pressure cylinder of a steam turbine. Feedwater can indirectly absorb solar energy by heat conduction oil through the solar energy preheater, the solar energy steam generator and the solar energy superheater or directly enter the solar energy heat collector to absorb the solar energy so as to become superheated steam. The superheated steam is injected into the high-pressure cylinder or the medium-pressure cylinder of the steam turbine, is mixed with the superheated steam generated by the coal-fired boiler at the position, is expanded to do work in the high-pressure cylinder or the medium-pressure cylinder of the steam turbine and is then output to a power generator for power generation. The steam injection type solar energy and thermal power station complementary power generation system realizes capacity expansion and consumption reduction of a thermal power station, solves the problem of instable and discontinuous solar energy and is beneficial for the large-scale popularization and application of the solar energy technology.

title: Reflection convergence solar-energy photo-thermal boiler
abstract: The utility model relates to a reflection convergence solar-energy photo-thermal boiler, which comprises a plurality of solar-energy vacuum tubes, a water tank and a boiler support, wherein the water tank is matched with the solar-energy vacuum tubes; the rear part of the boiler support is higher than the front part thereof; the water tank is arranged on the rear part of the boiler support; and the two ends of each of the solar-energy vacuum tubes are respectively and fixedly arranged at the front part and the rear part of the boiler support. The reflection convergence solar-energy photo-thermal boiler also comprises a solar-energy reflection plate that is arranged under the solar-energy vacuum tubes and is fixedly arranged on the boiler support. The reflection convergence solar-energy photo-thermal boiler adopts the reflection convergence mode for collecting solar energy, thereby greatly enlarging the daylighting area of the solar-energy vacuum tubes, so as to increase the energy flux density of a solar-energy device, improve the utilization ratio of the solar energy and improving the energy absorption intensity, therefore, the reflection convergence solar-energy photo-thermal boiler is mainly applicable to the heating for residents and the industrial production.

title: SOLAR POWER FORECASTING USING MIXTURE OF PROBABILISTIC PRINCIPAL COMPONENT ANALYZERS
abstract: A method for solar forecasting includes receiving a plurality of solar energy data as a function of time of day at a first time, forecasting (620) from the solar energy data a mode, where the mode is a sunny day, a cloudy day, or an overcast day, and the forecast predicts the mode for a next solar energy datum, receiving (622) the next solar energy datum, updating a probability distribution function (pdf) of the next solar energy datum given the mode, updating a pdf of the mode for the next solar energy datum from the updated pdf of the new solar energy datum given the mode, forecasting (624, 626) a plurality of future unobserved solar energy data from the updated pdf of the mode, where the plurality of future unobserved solar energy data and the plurality of solar energy data have a Gaussian distribution for a given mode determined from training data.

title: Solar energy landscape lamp
abstract: The utility model provides a solar energy landscape lamp which is mainly used for monitoring water levels of a reservoir or a watercourse. The solar energy landscape lamp comprises a shell body which presents the shape of a tree or a ball cactus or a lotus. The characteristics of the solar energy landscape lamp are as follows: a solar energy battery panel, a solar energy controller and a storage battery are arranged on a stem of the tree or at the top part of the ball cactus or on a lotus seed of the lotus; the solar energy battery panel is connected with the solar energy controller, the solar energy controller is connected with the storage battery and LED lamps, and a plurality of LED lamps are arranged on branches of the tree or at the periphery of a shell of the ball cactus or on petals of the lotus. Under the irradiation of sunshine in the daytime, the solar energy battery panel charges the storage battery by the solar energy controller; in the nighttime, power is supplied by the storage battery; the solar energy landscape lamp can be used not only for lighting, but also as a landscape.

title: Solar energy and wind energy magnetic levitation generator
abstract: The invention discloses a solar energy and wind energy magnetic levitation generator. The solar energy and wind energy magnetic levitation generator has the beneficial effects that a solar energy and wind energy generation technology is adopted, the problem of simplicity of current solar energy and wind energy power generation is solved, and two natural resources of solar energy and wind energy can be used for complementary power generation by fully utilizing the characteristics of the solar and the wind energy; meanwhile, the solar energy and wind energy power generation can be in a levitation state by utilizing a magnetic levitation technology, power generation can be carried out by a wind energy generator under the situation that wind power is less, and a solar panel can be more fully shined by sunlight. The solar energy and wind energy magnetic levitation generator disclosed by the invention has the advantages that the natural sources are utilized, no pollution is generated, the power generation cost is reduced, the generated energy is increased, and the economic benefit is increased; the solar energy and wind energy magnetic levitation generator is suitable for power generation of various regions.

title: Solar energy utilization system
abstract: The utility model provides a solar energy utilization system, it includes the frame and two at least solar energy installing on the frame utilize the subassembly, and this solar energy utilizes subassembly interval arrangement side by side, wherein, every solar energy utilizes subassembly rotation regulation in the frame to make every solar energy utilize the rotatory solar position of the tracking angle of subassembly, frame every single move on the direction of height is adjusted to make all solar energy utilize the subassembly to trail the solar altitude angle in step. The sun is trailed to its two dimension that can realize solar energy utilization system, and then improves this solar energy utilization system's sunlight utilization ratio.

title: SOLAR ELECTRICITY GENERATION SYSTEM
abstract: A solar electricity generation system including a solar energy-to-electricity converter having a solar energy receiving surface including at least an electricity-generating solar energy receiving surface and a plurality of reflectors arranged to reflect solar energy directly onto the solar energy receiving surface, each of the plurality of reflectors having a reflecting surface which is configured and located and aligned with respect to the solar energy receiving surface to reflect specular solar radiation with a high degree of uniformity onto the solar energy receiving surface, the configuration, location and alignment of each of the reflectors being such that the geometrical projection of each reflecting surface is substantially coextensive with the electricity-generating solar energy receiving surface.

title: SOLAR ENERGY CONVERTER
abstract: A solar energy converter comprises a solar energy absorber and a heat transfer device in thermal contact with the solar energy absorber. The heat transfer device is in thermal contact with the solar energy absorber and is arranged to transfer heat energy away from the solar energy absorber. The solar energy absorber is located within an envelope. The envelope is a tube, is at least partially transparent, and is at least partially evacuated.

title: Solar energy enhancing system
abstract: The utility model discloses a solar energy enhancing system, which is applied to a solar energy photovoltaic power generating system and comprises a reflecting device for reflecting sunlight refracted back, wherein the reflecting device is arranged on a solar cell component of the solar energy photovoltaic power generating system. The solar energy enhancing system enables the solar photovoltaic power generating system to collect more solar energy and further improves solar energy using efficiency.

title: Solar energy and geothermal energy combined energy resource system
abstract: The invention relates to a solar energy and geothermal energy combined energy resource system, and belongs to the technical field of new energy resources. The solar energy and geothermal energy combined energy resource system can effectively use solar energy and geothermal energy. The system comprises a solar energy heating device and a geothermal energy heat pipe power generation device; according to the solar energy heating device, a turbine power generator set is arranged at the bottom of a solar energy chimney, the solar energy chimney is in smooth transition connection with a solar heat collection shed, the solar energy heating device is installed below the solar heat collection shed, a water inlet of the solar energy heating device is connected with a water outlet of a geothermal water pump through a control valve I and a pipe, and a water sucking opening of the geothermal water pump is connected with a geothermal water source through a pipe; and a water outlet of the solar energy heating device is connected with a water inlet of a biomass oil burning boiler through a control valve II and a pipe, and the water inlet of the biomass oil burning boiler is connected with the water outlet of the geothermal water pump through a control valve III and a pipe.

title: Solar lighting device on lawn
abstract: The utility model relates to a solar energy lawn lamp, which comprises a lamp shade 3, a lamp post 5 and a solar energy photovoltaic electroluminescence device composed of a solar energy crystalline silicon battery 1, an electroluminescence sheet 2 and a solar energy charging and discharging processor 4, wherein the solar energy crystalline silicon battery 1 is connected with the solar energy charging and discharging processor 4. The solar energy charging and discharging processor 4 is connected with the electroluminescence sheet 2. The solar energy photovoltaic electroluminescence device which is composed of the solar energy crystalline silicon battery 1, the electroluminescence sheet 2 and the solar energy charging and discharging processor 4 is fixed to the lamp shade 3 fixed to the lamp post 5. The utility model has the advantages of environmental protection, saving for energy resource, and high brightness.

title: SMART LIGHTING SYSTEM USING SOLAR ENERGY
abstract: The present invention relates to a smart lighting system using solar energy. When green energy such as solar energy is used as LED operation energy, the solar energy is used during day time and general electricity energy is used during night time. The solar energy and the electricity energy are stored in a battery and the battery is used for operating an LED when the solar energy and the electricity energy cannot be charged. For this, the invention includes a power supply part; a solar energy receiving part receiving solar energy from sunlight; a battery charging power outputted through the solar energy receiving part and the power of the power supply part; an MCU supplying current from the power supply part or the solar energy receiving part to the LED driver according to the quantity of the solar energy, inputting the power of the solar energy receiving part to the LED driver during day time, and supplying the power of the power supply part to the LED driver during night time; and an LED driver operating the LED with the power supplied from the battery, the power supplied from the power supply part, or the power from the solar energy receiving part. [Reference numerals] (80) MCU controller

title: Low-temperature solar energy-saving system for assisting coal-fired power generation
abstract: The invention discloses a low-temperature solar energy-saving system for assisting coal-fired power generation. A coal-fired unit and a water circulation assembly are included, the water circulation assembly includes a solar energy fan heater, a solar energy gas-gas heater and a low-temperature solar thermal collector, a water outlet of the low-temperature solar thermal collector is connected withwater inlets of the solar energy fan heater and the solar energy gas-gas heater, and a water inlet of the low-temperature solar thermal collector is connected with water outlets of the solar energy fan heater and the solar energy gas-gas heater. According to the low-temperature solar energy-saving system for assisting coal-fired power generation, clean and efficient utilization of low-temperaturesolar energy is realized, and the gap in the technical field of coupling of the low-temperature solar energy and a coal-fired power generation system is made up.

title: Mounting structure of wall-mounted solar energy device without water tank
abstract: The invention discloses a mounting structure of a wall-mounted solar energy device without a water tank. The mounting structure comprises a support bottom plate, a solar energy fixing seat, a first support plate, a connecting disc, an angle adjusting device, an angle adjusting box, a mounting base and a counterbore hole, wherein the solar energy fixing seat and the first support plate are mountedon the support bottom plate; the solar energy fixing seat is perpendicularly mounted on the first support plate in a bolt connection manner; and the connecting disc is mounted at the upper end of thefirst support plate. The mounting structure is provided with the solar energy fixing seat, the solar energy device is in sliding fit with a T-shaped sliding rail in a snap ring to fix the solar energydevice in a clamping seat, and the angle adjusting box is controlled to adjust the pitching angle of the solar energy fixing seat, so that the orientation of the solar energy device to the sun can beadjusted, and solar energy is fully utilized. The mounting structure is easy to operate, the solar energy device is in sliding fit with the solar energy fixing seat, and when the solar energy deviceneeds to be repaired, the solar energy device is directly taken down and is convenient to repair.

title: SOLAR ELECTRICITY GENERATION SYSTEM
abstract: A solar electricity generation system including a solar energy-to-electricity converter having a solar energy receiving surface including at least an electricity-generating solar energy receiving surface and a plurality of reflectors arranged to reflect solar energy directly onto the solar energy receiving surface, each of the plurality of reflectors having a reflecting surface which is configured and located and aligned with respect to the solar energy receiving surface to reflect specular solar radiation with a high degree of uniformity onto the solar energy receiving surface, the configuration, location and alignment of each of the reflectors being such that the geometrical projection of each reflecting surface is substantially coextensive with the electricity-generating solar energy receiving surface.

title: Salor energy-accumulating energy supply device
abstract: The utility model relates to a solar energy-accumulating energy supplying device, which comprises a solar energy heat collector array capable of absorbing solar energy and also comprises an energy-accumulating energy supplying device capable of accumulating the solar energy, wherein, the energy-accumulating energy supplying device is communicated with the solar energy heat collector array through a pipeline. Water is filled in an energy-accumulating tank of the energy-accumulating energy supplying device, water in the solar energy heat collector array absorbs the heat of the sun and then is changed into hot water which is conveyed to the energy-accumulating tank to be accumulated, and then the utility model supplies the hot water to a heating system in the evening or rainy weather having no the sun. The utility model has the advantages of reliable operation, reasonable economy, convenient use, high efficiency, energy saving, cleanness, no pollution, etc. The utility model can be used for the fields of solar energy greenhouses, solar energy buildings, solar energy heating and cooling systems, etc.

title: Solar energy scroll battery
abstract: The invention discloses a solar energy scroll battery. The solar energy scroll battery consists of a solar energy surface, a USB interface, a battery shell and battery electrodes; the solar energy scroll battery is characterized in that the battery is formed by the scroll solar energy surface in a combination way; and the solar energy scroll battery can be used as a dry battery and a power supply.

title: SOLAR POWER SYSTEM AND SOLAR ENERGY TRACKING METHOD
abstract: A solar power system and a solar energy chasing method. Errors may be corrected in the installation area of a solar energy collecting plate with solar cells, particularly, in the installation direction thereof. Therefore, a control angle may be operated and determined, so that the solar cells or the solar energy collecting plate may be rotated precisely in the desired direction. In the case of disposing a plurality of solar energy collecting plates, the solar energy collecting plates may be controlled according to a predetermined rotation angle, thereby increasing solar energy absorbing efficiency.

title: Efficient heat collection solar energy converter
abstract: In order to overcome problems which are difficult to overcome in practical application, the invention researches an efficient heat collection solar energy converter according to the development situation of solar energy converters. The technical scheme adopted by the efficient heat collection solar energy converter for solving technical problems is a novel invention that solar energy is directly converted into thermal air energy, and a third application mode of sunlight energy is exploited. The invention aims to make up the disadvantages of the existing solar energy converters, a potential market of the solar energy technology is developed, and the level of the solar energy technology advances to a more advance direction, so that the solar energy does not depend on a photovoltaic panel technology, traditional high technology is replaced and the commercial profits of solar energy are promoted to be maximized.

title: Air energy heat pump and solar energy complementary hot-water heating device
abstract: The utility model discloses an air energy heat pump solar energy complementary hot-water installation which comprises an air energy heat pump, a heat storage exchanger, a heat pump heat exchanger, a hot-water output heat exchanger, a solar energy hot-water heat exchanger, a solar energy hot-water circulating pipe, a solar energy heat collector and an expansion water tank. A heater of the air energy heat pump is connected with the heat storage exchanger. The solar energy hot-water heat exchanger and the hot-water output heat exchanger are arranged on the heat storage exchanger, and the solar energy hot-water heat exchanger is connected with the solar energy heat collector through the solar energy hot-water circulating pipe. A solar energy lower circulating pipeline is connected with the expansion water tank. The air energy heat pump solar energy complementary hot-water installation utilizes the air energy heat pump and the solar energy hot-water system to form a double energy source hot-water system. The air heat pump solar energy complementary hot-water installation not only makes full use of air heat energy, changes a direct utilization of solar energy hot-water into an indirect utilization of solar energy hot-water, improves a use ratio of the air heat energy, and meanwhile exchanges indoor air timely to keep the air fresh, but also guarantees quality of solar energy hot-water, can be heated when needing using, avoids breeding of bacteria and keeps a hot water health standard.

title: Quartz and array solar-thermal converter and method
abstract: The invention discloses a quartz and array solar-thermal converter suitable for different temperatures and a method for solar-thermal conversion by utilizing a quartz device. The solar energy is collected by fully utilizing the physicochemical properties of the quartz device, and a new technical means and method is provided for the utilization of the solar energy. The quartz device is adopted as a solar energy collecting device so as to collect solar energy at different temperatures. The quartz and array solar-thermal converter comprises a quartz device; and at least partial shell of the quartz device is provided with a solar coating to convert the solar energy into thermal energy. The invention aims to provide a solar-thermal converter suitable for different temperatures, in particular a solar-thermal converter suitable for medium and high temperature solar energy and tower and butterfly solar-thermal converters.

title: Solar Energy Substrate Aerodynamic Flaps
abstract: Methods and systems for solar energy capture. One of the systems includes a solar energy substrate mounted on a support member and one or more flap assemblies coupled to the solar energy substrate. The solar energy substrate is configured to receive solar rays from the Sun and is further configured to move in at least one direction such that an orientation of the solar energy substrate can be adjusted in accordance with a direction of the solar rays. The support member is configured to support the solar energy substrate. The one or more flap assemblies each include a flap and an actuator that is configured to move the flap relative to the solar energy substrate. Movement of the flap is controllable to counter a wind-induced moment acting on the solar energy substrate.

title: Photoelectric and photo-thermal integrated assembly
abstract: At present, in the field of solar energy application, two modes are mainly adopted, one mode is to absorb solar energy to generate electricity, and the other mode is to absorb solar heat to heat water, but the two modes cannot be combined, and precious clean energy of solar energy is wasted to a great extent. The utility model relates to the field of solar energy application, in particular to a device for converting solar energy absorbed by a solar power generation panel and a heat absorber into electric energy and heat energy, and can be widely applied to various occasions with sufficient illumination. The device is mainly composed of a solar power generation panel 1, adhesive strips 2, heat absorbers 3, heat absorption pipes 4 and a back plate 5, the adhesive strips 2 are distributed on the periphery and the middle of the back face of the solar power generation panel 1 in a strip shape, the back plate 5 is bonded to the back face of the solar power generation panel 1 to form a whole, and the heat absorbers 3 are arranged in gaps of the adhesive strips 2 and sealed between the solar power generation panel 1 and the back plate 5; when the sun exists, the solar power generation panel 1 absorbs solar energy and converts the solar energy into electric energy, and the heat absorber 3 absorbs solar heat energy and stores the solar heat energy.

title: Solar storage battery grass cutter
abstract: The utility model relates to a solar energy battery lawn cropper. A solar energy battery panel and a controlling device of the solar energy battery panel are added to traditional electric lawn cropper. The solar energy battery panel and the controlling device of the solar energy battery are fixed on a walking frame of the cropper. The current output terminal of the solar energy battery panel is connected with the input terminal of the controlling device of the solar energy battery. The output terminal of the controlling device of the solar energy battery is connected with the charging terminal of a storage battery. To obtain optimal output effect from the solar energy battery and convenient dissembling when the cropper is not used, a stand which supports the solar energy battery panel is made into an adjustable one. The utility model realizes that the solar energy battery continuously charges the storage battery when the pruning is in operation without increase to the weight capacity ratio of the storage battery of the cropper.

title: Automatic track solar energy generation device
abstract: The utility model relates to an automatic track solar energy generation device, which comprises a solar energy cell and a solar energy cell support, wherein the solar energy cell is arranged on the solar energy cell support, the east-west direction on the upper portion of the solar energy cell is provided with a photoreceptor, the photoreceptor outputs signals through the shading of a baffle plate, and output signals are used to control a step motor which horizontally rotates. The step motor drives the solar energy cell support through a gear and a semicircle rack to rotatablely adjust an east-west angle of the solar energy cell and the sun. The angle of an elevation angle of the solar energy cell support and the sun leads the pressure to increase and reduce through energy storage media phase transition to lead an expansion device to expand and change the angle of the elevation angle of a solar energy plate, thereby achieving the omnidirectional tracking of solar energy generation, and increasing 30-50 percent sunlight use ratio compared with a fixing type solar energy generation device.

title: Solar energy heat pump-photoelectricity combined building energy-saving system
abstract: The utility model relates to a solar energy building energy-saving system and aims to provide a solar energy heat pump-photoelectricity combined building energy-saving system. The solar energy heat pump-photoelectricity combined building energy-saving system comprises a solar photovoltaic system and an intelligent control system which is connected with the solar photovoltaic system. The solar energy heat pump-photoelectricity combined building energy-saving system further comprises a hot-cold source composite system, wherein the solar photovoltaic system and the intelligent control system are respectively connected with the hot-cold source composite system, the hot-cold source composite system comprises a solar heat collection subsystem, a heat pump heating subsystem and a heat storage or change subsystem, wherein the heat pump heating subsystem and the heat storage or change subsystem are respectively connected with the solar heat collection subsystem. The solar energy heat pump-photoelectric combined building energy-saving system realizes the combination of the solar energy heat pump and the photoelectricity in the solar energy building energy-saving system, and is a novel solar energy building energy-saving system which is efficient and energy-saving, safe and environmental-friendly, stable in operation, and convenient to implement and popularize.

title: Foldable solar energy charger
abstract: The invention provides a foldable solar energy charger which comprises a base, a solar energy main panel, two solar energy auxiliary panels, two telescopic rods and an upper cover. The base is provided with a circuit board therein. The solar energy main panel is arranged above the base, and its middle part at the bottom is mounted in the middle part of the base in an elastic manner through a spring. The two solar energy auxiliary panels are symmetrically hinged at two sides of the solar energy main panel and can be folded under the solar energy main panel. The two telescopic rods are hinged on the base and at two sides of the solar energy main panel. The ends far from the base correspond to one side of edges far from the solar energy main panel for two solar energy auxiliary panels are hinged. The upper cover is mounted at the top of the base in a rotation manner and has the ability to cover the solar energy main panel, the two solar energy auxiliary panels, and the two telescopic rods. The solar energy main panel is connected to the circuit board through wires. The solar energy charger of the invention is simple in structure and convenient to use. With a changeable charging area, the charger is flexible in use and has strong practicality.

title: Solar energy light-emitting diode (LED) light advertising board
abstract: The utility model discloses a solar energy light-emitting diode (LED) light advertising board. The solar energy LED light advertising board comprises a solar energy power supply device, an LED light, a circuit board, a resistor and an electronic circuit. The solar energy LED light advertising board is characterized in that the solar energy power supply device comprises four parts, namely, a solar energy battery pack, a controller, a storage battery and an inverter, the LED light is connected with the circuit board through the electronic circuit, the resistor is installed on the circuit board and solar panels are arranged in the solar energy battery pack. When the solar energy LED light advertising board is used, the solar energy is converted into electric energy through the solar energy power supply device to supply electric energy needed by the LED light advertising board, and the controller is arranged in the solar energy power supply device to enable the LED light advertising board to have special effects. The solar energy LED light advertising board is simple in structure, convenient to use and install, easy to operate, saving in labor, free in rising and falling, reliable and safe.

title: Solar Power System and Solar Energy Chasing Method Thereof
abstract: A solar power system and a solar energy chasing method. Errors may be corrected in the installation area of a solar energy collecting plate with solar cells, particularly, in the installation direction thereof. Therefore, a control angle may be operated and determined, so that the solar cells or the solar energy collecting plate may be rotated precisely in the desired direction. In the case of disposing a plurality of solar energy collecting plates, the solar energy collecting plates may be controlled according to a predetermined rotation angle, thereby increasing solar energy absorbing efficiency.

title: SOLAR ELECTRICITY GENERATION SYSTEM
abstract: A solar electricity generation system including a solar energy-to-electricity converter having a solar energy receiving surface including at least an electricity-generating solar energy receiving surface and a plurality of reflectors arranged to reflect solar energy directly onto the solar energy receiving surface, each of the plurality of reflectors having a reflecting surface which is configured and located and aligned with respect to the solar energy receiving surface to reflect specular solar radiation with a high degree of uniformity onto the solar energy receiving surface, the configuration, location and alignment of each of the reflectors being such that the geometrical projection of each reflecting surface is substantially coextensive with the electricity-generating solar energy receiving surface.

title: SOLAR ENERGY GENERATING SYSTEM FOR HIGH TEMPERATURE ENVIRONMENTS
abstract: A solar energy generation system for high temperature environment includes a solar cell and a first filter. The solar cell is disposed for photovoltaic generation. The first filter is disposed on an incident surface of the solar cell, transmits a first solar energy of an incident solar energy having a first spectrum range suitable for photovoltaic generation to the solar cell, and reflects a second solar energy having a second spectrum range except for the first spectrum range of the incident solar energy.

title: HEATING INSTALLATION OF SOLAR HEATER ASSISTED BY STOVE
abstract: The utility model discloses a heating device of solar heater assisted by stove, relating to a solar energy water heater and a stove and being composed of a heat collector, a stove, a water tank and a pipeline. The utility model combines the solar energy water heater and the stove to combine the solar energy utilization and the conventional energy or waste heat utilization to stabilize the solar energy utilization, prolonging the time of solar energy utilization and improve the solar energy utilization rate.

title: Tent structure with solar energy panels
abstract: An tent structure includes a tent, at least one solar energy panel placed on the tent structure for absorbing sunlight or other light, and a switching device, for switching solar energy to electric energy, connected to the at least one solar energy panel for transforming solar energy supplied by the solar energy panels into electric energy.

title: Solar energy-saving lamp box
abstract: The utility model discloses a solar energy-saving lamp box and mainly aims to provide the solar energy-saving lamp box which is powered based on solar energy. The solar energy-saving lamp box comprises a lamp box body and a solar power supply system electrically connected with the lamp box body, wherein the lamp box body is internally provided with a strip lamp, the solar power supply system is composed of a solar panel, a storage battery and a control circuit, the solar panel is used for covering the solar energy into electric energy, the storage battery is electrically connected with the solar panel and used for storing the electric energy, the storage battery is electrically connected with the strip lamp arranged in the lamp box body, the control circuit is electrically connected with the solar panel and the storage battery and used for regulating the quantity of electricity converted by the solar panel according to the electric quantity in the storage battery. The solar energy-saving lamp box disclosed by the utility model is simple and compact in structure, and power is saved as the solar energy is used as power-supply energy.

title: Method and device for applying solar energy to moxibustion therapy
abstract: The invention discloses a device for applying solar energy to moxibustion therapy, which comprises a focusing device, the focusing device gathers the solar energy to the input end of a solar energy conveying pipeline, the solar energy conveying pipeline extends into a treatment room and is connected with the treatment room, and the output end of the solar energy conveying pipeline is connected with a mounting cavity. And an adjusting assembly is mounted at the front end of the mounting cavity. The focusing device is adopted for focusing, and the solar energy is conveyed through the solar energy conveying pipeline and is finally used for moxibustion therapy, so that solar energy is used for moxibustion therapy.

title: Solar cooling and drying equipment for premounting transformer substation
abstract: The utility model discloses a solar-energy cooling moisture-removing device of a prepackage type transformer substation, which comprises a humiture control system, a solar energy power supply comprises a solar energy battery plate, a solar energy controller, an accumulator and an inverter, wherein the solar energy battery plate is connected with the solar energy controller, the solar energy controller is connected with the inverter and the accumulator, and the inverter is connected with the humiture control system. The solar-energy cooling moisture-removing device adopts solar energy which is a green energy source, and the solar energy is inexhaustible, which can be regenerated, reduces the emission of contaminant, and is beneficial for environmental protection and sustainable development. When an electrified wire netting is in service interruption or a prepackage type transformer substation running, electrical equipment in a station can be normally cooled down and dehumidified, the solar-energy cooling moisture-removing device prevents dewing, improves the reliability of prepackage type transformer substation equipment, and guarantees the safe operation of an electrified wire netting.

title: Novel solar energy heat collection module
abstract: A novel solar energy heat collection module comprises a solar energy heat collection and heat storage sub-module and a water replenishment sub-module; the solar energy heat collection and heat storage sub-module has the functions of absorbing solar energy sunlight-heat resources, gathering heat and storing hot water, and the water replenishment sub-module has the functions of replenishing water and storing the hot water for the solar energy heat collection and heat storage sub-module. By utilizing the novel solar energy heat collection module, a solar energy water heater single machine or a solar energy heat collection engineering system can be assembled, and by utilizing the solar energy heat collection and heat storage sub-module, the solar energy water heater single machine and the solar energy heat collection engineering system can be assembled as well. The novel solar energy heat collection module has the advantages of being rigorous and simple in structure, small in size, and beneficial to overall insulation treatment.

title: Solar strong effect extension concentration apparatus
abstract: The invention discloses a powerful solar energy extending photospot device; a shell is internally provided with a group of solar energy collecting devices and an extension condenser lens. The upper part of the solar energy integrator is provided with an extension condenser lens which is fixedly arranged on an adjustable frame; the adjustable frame can adjust the extension condenser lens towards the solar source; the extension condenser lens can integrate solar energy into the solar energy collecting devices and can effectively shorten the distance between the condenser and the solar energy collecting devices to lead a solar energy generator or a collector to emit times of electric energy and heat energy.

title: Photovoltaic module's snow removing awakening device
abstract: The utility model belongs to the technical field of the solar facilities and specifically relates to a photovoltaic module's snow removing awakening device, including preventing snow solar energy electroplax, main solar energy electroplax and electric fan heater, prevent the special angle of snow solar energy electroplax, it all installs in the support frame to prevent snow solar energy electroplax and main solar energy electroplax, the electric fan heater with prevent that snow solar energy electroplax passes through the wire and links to each other, just the main solar energy electroplax of air outlet orientation of electric fan heater. This device, it is with low costs, and can clear away the snow on the main solar energy electroplax effectively, in time, and guarantee the normal work of main solar energy electroplax, improve life.

title: Solar energy advertising board
abstract: The utility model provides a solar energy advertising board, and relates to the technical field of outdoor advertising boards. The solar energy advertising board comprises a supporting pillar, a lower transverse rod is transversely installed at the top end of the supporting pillar, a tabulate supporting frame is installed on the lower transverse rod in the vertical direction, an upper transverse rod is transversely installed on the supporting frame, and a solar energy cell panel is installed at the top end of the upper transverse rod in the horizontal direction. A lamp holder is installed on the bottom of the solar energy cell panel, an energy-saving lamp is installed on the lamp holder, and the solar energy cell panel is connected with the energy-saving lamp through a conducting wire and a switch. The solar energy advertising board is provided with the solar energy cell panel, electricity can be generated through solar energy to provide a power supply for the illuminating lamp on the solar energy advertising board, and therefore, energy conservation and environment protection are achieved. Besides, the solar energy cell panel is installed horizontally, part of the solar energy advertising board, located below the solar energy cell panel, is prevented from being exposed to the sun and rain, and the service life of advertising paper on the solar energy advertising board is prolonged.

title: Solar energy electric fan
abstract: The invention discloses a solar energy electric fan. The solar energy electric fan comprises a fan body and a base, wherein the fan body is connected with the base through a vertical column. title: Umbrella-shaped solar energy sailboard catamaran
abstract: The invention relates to an umbrella-shaped solar energy sailboard catamaran which belongs to the technical field of ship architecture and ocean engineering equipment. The umbrella-shaped solar energy sailboard catamaran comprises a single hull, a hull connecting frame, a universal joint, a main upright rod, an umbrella-shaped framework, a pull rod, a sleeve, a pulling cable, an umbrella-shaped solar energy sailboard, solar energy photovoltaic arrays, a windlass, a hydraulic oil cylinder, a solar energy sail, a support bracket, a sunlight sensor and a direction controller. The umbrella-shaped solar energy sailboard and the solar energy sail are installed on the catamaran, and the solar energy photovoltaic arrays are respectively installed on the umbrella-shaped solar energy sailboard and the solar energy sail. The wind energy and the solar energy are cooperatively utilized for the ship propelling, and the catamaran is driven completely by green energy resources without conventional energy resource consumption and is a green ship without discharging pollution. The invention has great scientific research value, great industrial application prospect and great economic and social benefits.

title: Wind energy and solar energy combined power generation device of new energy
abstract: The utility model provides a wind energy and solar energy combined power generation device of new energy, belongs to the technical field of new energy, and solves the problem that a traditional wind energy and solar energy combined power generation device of new energy is low in efficiency. The new energy wind energy and solar energy combined power generation device comprises a fixed seat, and a fixed column is fixed to the center of the top of the fixed seat. Through the arrangement of the adjusting mechanism, the angle of the solar receiver is conveniently adjusted, the solar receiver is always kept perpendicular to the sun, solar rays are received to the maximum extent, solar energy is converted into electric energy, and the conversion rate of the solar energy is improved; and the situation that after the angle of the equipment box is adjusted, the position of the solar receiver is changed is avoided, rotation adjustment is conducted in cooperation with the solar receiver, fan blades are conveniently adjusted to receive surrounding wind energy through arrangement of a third motor, and the wind power generation efficiency is improved.

title: TARPAULIN SOLAR ENERGY GENERATION SYSTEM AND SOLAR TENT
abstract: The embodiments of the present disclosure provide a tarpaulin solar energy generation system and a solar tent. In the tarpaulin solar energy generation system, one or more solar components are fixed on the tarpaulin and adapted to receive light energy, and a controller is connected to each of the solar components and an energy storage battery and adapted to convert electrical energy generated by the solar components and to store the converted electrical energy in the energy storage battery.

title: Concentration type solar energy cogeneration device
abstract: The utility model relates to a concentration type solar energy cogeneration device, which belongs to the technical field of solar energy photovoltaic power generation and solar energy heat collection. The concentration type solar energy cogeneration device comprises a multifunctional solar energy conversion plate and a group of plain mirrors, wherein the solar energy conversion plate comprises a piece of protection glass, a solar energy battery, an electrode lead wire, a binder layer, a tube type heat absorption plate, a heat insulation layer and a housing. In the utility model, radiation quantity irradiated on unit area of a solar energy battery board is increased by more than three times through the four plain mirrors at first, so that the actual photoelectric conversion efficiency of the solar energy battery can reach the maximum value; and then the heat of the solar energy battery board is rapidly absorbed through the tube type heat absorption plate at the back of the solar energy battery board, not only is the working temperature of the solar energy battery reduced, but also domestic water can be heated. Therefore, the recycling of waste heat generated during operation of the solar energy battery board can be realized, and the comprehensive utilization efficiency of solar energy can be substantially improved.

title: Solar energy traffic warning board
abstract: The invention discloses a solar energy traffic warning board, belonging to the technical field of traffic signal. The solar energy traffic warning board comprises a solar cell module, a solar energy intelligent controller, a energy storage accumulator and a light emitting diode group, wherein, the solar cell module is arranged on the top of the traffic warning board and faces to the best directionwhich can receive the sun light, the solar cell module is connected with the solar energy intelligent controller through wires and the solar energy intelligent controller is connected with the energystorage accumulator and the light emitting diode group through wires. The solar cell module charges the energy storage accumulator through the solar energy intelligent controller and the electrical energy of the energy storage accumulator is output to the light emitting diode group through the solar energy intelligent controller and is used to control the light emitting diode group to generate warning and illuminating effects. The invention does not need commercial power, can run only by the electrical energy generated from solar energy and has the advantages of long service life, energy-saving, environmental friend, low cost and the like.

title: Method of heat collection of landscape solar energy
abstract: The invention provides a method of heat collection of landscape solar energy. A rattan-type plant is planted below the solar energy heat collector in spring. The rattan-type plant continues to grow by climbing on the solar energy heat collector through a gap of the solar energy heat collector after the plant grows in summer. Part of the sunlight can be blocked by leaves of the plant. The sunlight irradiating on the solar energy heat collector is reduced. Heat production of the solar energy heat collector is proper. According to the method of the heat collection of the landscape solar energy, the solar energy can be fully used for collecting heat. Redundant sunlight in summer can further be used for planting the plant at the same time. In summer, the solar energy heat collector can be used for collecting the heat. The redundant sunlight can be used for planting the plant and absorbing the carbon dioxide, thus the fault rate of the solar energy heat collector is reduced. Service life is prolonged. The complete solar energy heat collector area is exposed. The solar energy plays the largest role.
