title: Solar alternating-current battery capable of improving six-time absorption, storage and release of solar energy
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of utilization of space solar energy, particularly relates to a solar alternating current battery capable of improving 6 times of absorption, storage and release of solar energy, and aims to solve the problems that the solar energy absorbed, stored and released by the existing solar energy cannot be effectively converted and the utilization rate of the solar energy is reduced. The solar power generation panel is of a hexagonal pyramid-shaped structure, and the bottom of the solar power generation panel is connected with a solar cell main body; a solar (alternating current) cell panel which is in a hexagonal pyramid shape and can absorb solar energy by 6 times is butted to the surface of a hexagonal solar cell body, so that the solar energy can be absorbed, stored and released by 6 times. The six-prismatic-shaped solar cell is adopted to improve the solar cell characteristics of absorbing, storing and releasing solar energy by 6 times, creativity, permanency, cleanness, environment friendliness, safety, flexibility and long service life are achieved, electric energy can be generated as long as solar radiation and lamplight exist, and charging is not needed.

title: Asphalt processing method using solar energy for heating
abstract: The invention discloses an asphalt processing method using solar energy for heating. A solar cell panel, a solar heat absorption coating and a heat collector are included, and the solar cell panel isused for absorbing solar energy; the heat collector is coated with a solar heat absorption coating, and solar energy is converted into heat energy through the heat collector. The asphalt processing method comprises the steps that 1 the solar cell panel absorbs solar energy, the heat collector is coated with the solar heat absorption coating, and the solar energy is converted into heat energy through the heat collector; 2 the asphalt stored in a large tank is heated; and 3 heat energy in the tank body is focused, so that the asphalt flows, and the flowing asphalt flows into a small tank body. The asphalt processing method has the advantages that air pollution caused by combustion of coal and natural gas is reduced, the solar heat absorption coating with the model of RLHY-2337 is used, the heat collector is helped to absorb solar heat, the efficiency of converting solar energy into heat energy is improved, and the production cost is reduced.

abstract: In the present invention, there is disclosed a device for utilization of solar energy. particularly for conversion thereof to thermal energy or electric power, said device comprising a solar energy absorber (A) and an optical means (OM) arranged upstream said solar energy absorber (A) and intended for concentration of solar energy. Said solar energy concentrating optical means (OM), comprising a system of side-by-side arranged optical converging lenses (1), is arranged reversibly adjustable between the position in front of the solar energy absorber (A) and outside of said solar energy absorber (A).

abstract: The invention discloses a heating method for a solar floor. The heating method can comprise the steps that solar energy is absorbed through an energy absorbing unit; the absorbed solar energy is transmitted to an energy receiving unit through an energy transmitting unit; the solar energy received by the energy receiving unit is stored through an energy storage unit; and the energy storage unit releases heat to heat a solar base plate. The heating method has the advantages that the solar energy is convenient to collect and free of pollution; solar energy resources are abundant and can be used for a long time; and air pollution is reduced, and air quality is improved.

title: PORTABLE MODULAR SUN-TRACKING SOLAR ENERGY RECEIVER SYSTEM
abstract: A portable solar energy generation system has a solar energy receiver having a plurality of solar cells for converting solar energy into a DC voltage. A solar tracking mechanism enables the solar energy receiver to track a position of the sun with respect to the solar cells and to position the solar cells responsive thereto. Power circuitry generates at least one output voltage to power an electronic device responsive to the DC voltage. A housing contains each of the solar energy receiver, the solar tracking mechanism and the power circuitry in a portable configuration.

title: Solar energy collector
abstract: A solar energy collector comprises a glass membrane, a solar energy collecting device and a window frame, and is characterized in that the glass membrane is connected with the solar energy collecting device, solar energy collecting wires are implanted in the inner layer of the glass membrane for collecting solar energy, the solar energy is transmitted to a conversion device, the conversion device converts the solar energy into electric energy, the electric energy is stored in an electricity storage device connected with the conversion device, the electricity storage device is provided with a switch, and the electric energy is transmitted to electricity-utilization equipment by switching on the switch. Compared with the prior art, the solar energy collector has significant advantages and beneficial effects that the solar energy collected by the solar energy collecting wires are converted into electric energy in the conversion device, the electric energy is transmitted to the electricity storage device, the electricity storage device is provided with the switch, the electric energy transmitted by the conversion device is stored in the electricity storage device when the switch is switched off, and the stored electric energy is transmitted the electricity-utilization equipment when the switch is switched on.

title: Solar electric source device of super capacitor
abstract: The utility model discloses a solar energy power device for a super capacitor, which relates to a solar power generation. The method is that the maximum power of the solar power system is traced in dynamic balance way. An intelligence type charging and discharging mechanism is added according to the method to form an intelligence type coordination style solar energy device. The utility model at least comprises a solar energy board, an ultra-capacitor, a direct-current/step-up step-down converter, a pulse width modulation driver, an accumulator cell, a logic controller, and a load. The electric energy produced by the solar energy board is converted into the capacitor form electric energy to calculate the maximum power, and the calculation procedure can be simplified greatly. The real-time and the reliability degree of the tracing calculation are promoted, and the solar energy system efficiency is gained. The utility model can be widely applied to a solar energy LED lamp and a solar energy lamp, in particular to a solar energy street lamp, a street lamp, a solar energy traffic signal lamp, and a solar energy project light, etc.

title: Solar energy sunlight shining device capable of promoting solar radiation energy
abstract: A solar energy sunlight shining device capable of promoting solar radiation energy is composed of a solar energy support. A solar energy facility is installed within the range of the solar energy support. A sunlight receiving screen and a sunlight shining device are installed on the periphery of the solar energy support. Angles of the sunlight shining device are capable of being adjusted. The sunlight shining device is composed of a connecting support and a sunlight shining screen. Angles of the connecting support and the sunlight shining screen are capable of being adjusted. The sunlight receiving screen and the sunlight shining screen are made of metal mirror materials. The solar energy sunlight shining device is characterized in that the solar energy facility is directly shined by sunlight and can be shined by radiation light reflected by the sunlight shining screen at the same time, and therefore the solar energy facility can be radiated by dual lights of the sunlight and the sunlight shining. When in extreme weather in winter, the solar energy sunlight shining device is capable of receiving a strong heat value effect like in summer. The solar energy sunlight shining device is widely applied for devices such as solar energy battery electricity generation and solar water heater.

title: SOLAR ENERGY PHOTOVOLTAIC CONTROL SYSTEM
abstract: A solar energy photovoltaic (PV) control system includes a solar energy absorption board configured to receive solar energy from solar rays and transfer solar energy to voltage/current signals, a motor, a voltage/current collecting circuit connected to the solar energy absorption board to receive the voltage/current signals therefrom, a micro control unit (MCU) connected to the voltage/current collecting circuit to receive the voltage/current signals therefrom, and a motor driver connected between the MCU and the motor. The solar energy absorption board is fixed on the motor and the motor drives the solar energy absorption board to pivot. The MCU controls the motor driver to drive the motor to adjust the angle between incoming solar rays and the solar energy absorption board to place the solar energy absorption board to directly face the sun according to the collected voltage/current signals.

title: Solar stepping stone
abstract: A solar stepping stone comprises a housing having an upper surface, side walls and a lower surface, the housing defining a chamber. A solar energy collector is associated with the housing for collecting solar energy. A solar power storage device is provided in the chamber for receiving and storing solar energy received from the solar energy collectors. An illuminator for illuminating at least a portion of the upper surface of the solar stepping stone is contained in the chamber and is powered by solar energy stored by the solar power member.

title: Solar air conditioner
abstract: The invention provides a solar air conditioner. The solar air conditioner comprises an indoor unit, an outdoor unit, a compressor and an evaporator; the solar air conditioner further comprises a solarpipeline, a photovoltaic module arranged on the top of the solar pipeline, a heat collection pipe assembly arranged at the bottom of the solar pipeline and a heat collection sheet arranged on the heat collection pipe assembly; the solar pipeline is used for enabling a refrigerant to circulate; the photovoltaic module is used for converting solar energy into electric energy; and the heat collection pipe assembly and the heat collection sheet are used for absorbing solar energy and converting the solar energy into heat energy. By adopting the solar air conditioner, a large amount of solar energy can be converted into electric energy, not only can enough energy be supplied to the air conditioner for use, but also a large amount of redundant electric energy can be generated and output to theoutside, and the economic benefit of the solar air conditioner is improved.

title: Solar energy lighting lamp
abstract: The invention discloses a solar energy lighting lamp. The solar energy lighting lamp mainly comprises a solar panel, a processor and an led lamp. The solar energy lighting lamp is characterized in that the processor is arranged in the lighting lamp, the solar panel is arranged on the surface of the lighting lamp, the led lamp is arranged in the middle of the lighting lamp, during using, the solarpanel absorbs solar energy, the processor converts the solar energy into electrical energy and supplies the electrical energy for the led light, and convenience is brought to people.

title: Solar energy corn thresher
abstract: The invention relates to a solar energy corn thresher. The corn thresher is characterized by including a solar energy battery plate, an inverter, a storage battery, a controller and a spiral thresher,and the solar energy corn thresher can convert the solar energy into electric energy to be stored in the storage battery so as to supply electric energy for the thresher; when the solar energy corn thresher is not used, the solar energy assemblies can supply electric energy for domestic lighting and other devices and input the electric energy into a power network. The thresher has the advantagesthat all energy consumption is from the solar energy, which is clean and safe, when the solar energy corn thresher is not used, the thresher can supply electric energy to other equipment or input theelectric energy into power network, and the problem of energy shortage can be efficiently solved.

title: Adjustable solar streetlight
abstract: The utility model relates to an adjustable solar energy road lamp, which belongs to a municipal illuminating device. The utility model comprises a road lamp and a road lamp post thereof which is provided with a solar energy board, a solar energy charging battery and a photosensitizing controllable switch, wherein the solar energy board is arranged on the top part of the road lamp post and the surface of the upper part, the solar energy charging battery is arranged on the upper part of the road lamp post, the photosensitizing controllable switch is arranged under the solar energy board, the solar energy board is connected with the solar energy charging battery by conducting wires, and the solar energy charging battery, the photosensitizing controllable switch and the road lamp are connected in series on a control circuit of the road lamp by conducting wires. The utility model uses the reproducible green energy resource which is solar energy as a power source. The utility model absorbs the solar energy at daytime with sufficient light irradiation and converts the solar energy into electric energy for storage. The utility model releases the electric energy after dusk for the illumination of the road lamp. The utility model has the characteristics of energy saving and environment protection.

title: Solar camera
abstract: The utility model belongs to the technical field of monitoring equipment, and particularly relates to a solar camera. The camera comprises a camera body and a solar cell panel. The solar cell panel is arranged on the upper end face of the camera body, and the solar cell panel is electrically connected with a battery assembly in the camera body; the solar cell panel can convert solar energy into electric energy and store the converted electric energy in the cell module. The solar panel in the solar camera can absorb solar energy, convert the solar energy into electric energy and charge the converted electric energy into the battery assembly of the camera body, so that the camera body is provided with the electric energy required by the camera body during working, and the solar camera can operate normally without pulling a lead; therefore, the installation of the solar camera is simpler and more convenient.

title: IMPROVED SOLAR ENERGY COLLECTORS AND METHODS FOR SOLAR ENERGY SYSTEMS
abstract: The present invention offers improved absorber plates for solar energy collectors, improved cover glazings for solar energy collectors, improved concentrating solar energy collectors, and solar energy collection methods that use one or more of the improved solar energy collectors for useful residential, commercial, and industrial applications. The improved absorber plate solar energy collectors utilize a 3-dimensional porous metal to improve solar radiant absorption collection and utilization, the improved concentrating solar energy collectors are Fresnel lens faced ducts of various geometries that enable efficient axial length solar energy collection, and the improved cover glazings utilize transparent front and back faces with other insulating property improvements to enable increased solar radiant energy harvest per unit front face cover area of solar collector.

title: MOUNTING STRUCTURE FOR SOLAR ENERGY COLLECTING PIPE

SOLUTION: The mounting structure for the solar energy collecting pipe comprises the solar energy collecting pipe 3 arranged on the reverse of the solar energy collecting plate 1, a fin 2 placed covering the solar energy collecting pipe 3, and a box 4 covering the solar energy collecting plate 1 at its reverse. The expandable foam solar energy insulating material is filled in a closed space formed by the heat collecting plate 1 and the box 4 and foamed, and the pressure of volume expansion due to the foaming is used for press bonding the solar energy collecting pipe 3 to the reverse of the solar energy collecting plate 1 via the fin 2.

By adopting the vertical light reflecting plates which are arranged at the left side, the right side and the back side of the energy collecting plate, the solar rays in different seasons and times are reflected to the energy collecting plate, thereby efficiently increasing the energy collecting efficiency of the energy collecting plate, meanwhile, the high-efficiency solar energy collecting plate has the advantages of simple structure, convenient operation, reliable performance and the like, therefore, the high-efficiency solar energy collecting plate is an effective way to increase the efficiency of the solar energy collecting plate with low cost and can provide enough solar thermal energy for a solar energy generator and a solar energy water heater.

title: Solar air conditioning and water heating system

Wherein, said solar-energy collector can be solar-energy collector or the solar-energy photo-voltaic cell; the solar-energy collector is matched with the air conditioner hot water device, to be managed by the microcomputer controller. The invention realizes the intelligent integration and compensation between solar-energy technique and central air conditioning technique.

title: Solar energy charging battery
abstract: The solar energy charging battery comprises a casing, at least one solar energy plate, a circuit plate, a battery core, the solar enery plate is arranged on the casing for absorbing the solar energy and converting to the electric energy, the circuit plate is provided with a boosted circuit and a charging circuit, the boosted circuit is electrically connected with the solar energy plate and the charging circuit, the battery core is electrically connected with the charging circuit for storing the electric energy. The solar energy charging battery absorbs the solar energy and converts to the electric energy, then stores the electric energy in the battery core through the charging circuit, with simple structure, and is convenient for compensating the electric energy.

title: Solar energy monitoring system
abstract: The invention discloses a solar energy monitoring system which comprises a solar panel, monitoring equipment, a solar energy controller and a power transformation controller. The solar panel is located at the front end of the solar energy monitoring system and is used for supplying power to the solar energy monitoring system. The monitoring equipment is electrically connected with the terminal ofthe solar energy monitoring system. The solar energy controller comprises an input end and an output end. The power transformation controller comprises an input module and an output module. One end ofthe input module is electrically connected with the solar panel, and the other end of the input module is electrically connected with the input end of the solar controller. One end of the output module is electrically connected with the output end of the solar energy controller, and the other end of the output module is electrically connected with the monitoring equipment. The solar energy monitoring system has the characteristics of simple structure, less energy consumption and higher efficiency.

title: Solar panel charging display device and use method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a solar panel charging display device and a use method thereof. The solar panel charging display device comprises a solar panel, an energy storage module, a measuring module and a display module, wherein the solar panel can convert solar energy into electric energy; the energy storage module is connected with the solar panel so as to store the electric energy generated by the solar panel; the measuring module is connected with the solar panel and the energy storage module; the measuring module is used for measuring an electric signal value of the electric energy transmitted to the energy storage module by the solar panel; the display module is connected with the measuring module and dynamically displays the electric signal value measured by the measuring module, and therefore, a user can easily know the relation between the placing position or the angle of the solar panel and the electric energy quantity generated by the solar panel.

title: Solar energy collecting board
abstract: The invention discloses a solar energy collecting board, belonging to the field of solar energy utilization. The solar energy collecting board comprises a bracket and a solar collecting board arranged on the bracket, wherein the outside surface of the solar collecting board is conical. The solar energy collecting board is designed to an array configuration. By adopting the invention, the collecting area of the solar energy and the output power of the solar power generation device are increased on the limited floor space; and most of the scattered light and reflected light of the sunlight are absorbed by the neighboring surface of the solar collecting board, thus increasing the utilization rate of the solar energy.

title: Solar energy comprehensive utilization device and control method
abstract: The invention provides a solar energy comprehensive utilization device and a control method, and relates to the technical field of new energy. According to the invention, the fixing frame is arranged around the solar photovoltaic panel, so that the solar photovoltaic panel can rotate around the central axis of the fixing frame, and therefore, when power grid absorption is difficult, the solar photovoltaic panel can be rotated, direct radiation of the solar photovoltaic panel can be reduced, output power of the solar photovoltaic panel can be reduced, and adjustment capability of new energy can be improved; when the power grid supply is insufficient, the solar photovoltaic panel can be rotated to increase the direct radiation of the solar photovoltaic panel, increase the output power of the solar photovoltaic panel, and improve the adjustment capability of the new energy. A water tank is further arranged on the back face of the solar photovoltaic panel, when the solar photovoltaic panel inclines or turns over, the water tank absorbs solar energy and converts the solar energy into heat energy and chemical energy, the solar energy is fully utilized, and the utilization rate of the solar energy is increased.

title: Solar bicycle
abstract: The invention provides a solar bicycle, which comprises a bicycle body, a DC motor and a storage battery, wherein the DC motor and the storage battery are arranged on the bicycle body; the solar bicycle further comprises an automatically-adjusting solar energy collection system, wherein the automatically-adjusting solar energy collection system is arranged on the bicycle body, and the automatically-adjusting solar energy collection system is connected with the storage battery by means of a control circuit. Compared with the prior art, electric energy is provided to a power system of the solarbicycle finally by means of the automatically-adjusting solar energy collection system, efficient conversion of solar energy is realized, the utilization efficiency of solar energy is improved, the energy recourse is saved, the structure is simple, energy consumption can be reduced, and the cost is saved. The automatically-adjusting solar energy collection system can automatically complete the collection of solar energy; a solar tube can be adjusted according to time and sunlight illumination angles, and the utilization and conversion efficiency of the solar energy can be effectively improved;and the solar bicycle has the advantages of simple structure, low manufacturing cost, high popularization performance, and wide application range.

title: PORTABLE MODULAR SUN TRACKING SOLAR ENERGY RECEIVER SYSTEM
abstract: A portable solar energy generation system has a solar energy receiver having a plurality of solar cells for converting solar energy into a DC voltage. A solar tracking mechanism enables the solar energy receiver to track a position of the sun with respect to the solar cells and to position the solar cells responsive thereto. Power circuitry generates at least one output voltage to power an electronic device responsive to the DC voltage. A housing contains each of the solar energy receiver the solar tracking mechanism and the power circuitry in a portable configuration.

title: Solar hollow brick
abstract: The utility model discloses a solar hollow brick which comprises a cavity and solar cells, and at least part of the solar cells are located in the cavity. The utility model provides a solar hollow brick. The solar cells are arranged in the solar hollow brick; at least part of the solar cell pieces are located in the cavity, solar energy is radiated to the solar cell pieces through the solar hollowbrick, and the solar cell pieces convert the solar energy into electric energy for use, so that the solar hollow brick has the function of converting the solar energy into the electric energy, and the functions of the solar hollow brick are enriched. Meanwhile, the cavity of the solar hollow brick can protect the solar cells in the cavity, such as water resistance, dust resistance and the like.

title: Solar energy photovoltaic panel having timing clean function
abstract: The utility model provides a solar energy photovoltaic panel having a timing clean function. The solar energy photovoltaic panel aims at solving problems that sand and dust are easily gathered on the solar energy photovoltaic panel as the solar energy photovoltaic panel is long exposed to field environment when working, and the output power of the solar energy photovoltaic panel is reduced after the sand and the dust are gathered on the solar energy photovoltaic panel, so that the solar energy photovoltaic panel needs to be cleaned at regular intervals. The solar energy photovoltaic panel having the timing clean function comprises a solar energy photovoltaic panel body. The solar energy photovoltaic panel body is connected with a storage battery, and the storage battery is connected with an inverter. The solar energy photovoltaic panel is characterized in that the inverter is connected with a driving motor, the driving motor is connected with a leading screw, a nut is arranged on the leading screw, the nut is connected with a long brush, the driving motor is connected with a timing controller, and dust gathering grooves are arranged on the two sides of the solar energy photovoltaic panel body. By employing the solar energy photovoltaic panel having the timing clean function, extra energy is not needed, and manual cleaning is also not needed, so that labor force is saved. The solar energy photovoltaic panel having the timing clean function is of simple structure and low cost, and is applicable to being popularized and used in a large scope.

title: Solar energy storage and conversion system
abstract: The invention relates to a solar energy storage and conversion system. The solar energy storage and conversion system includes a control device, a solar energy heat collector, a drilling energy storage device, a layered circulation device and an absorbent refrigeration device, the solar energy heat collector, the drilling energy storage device and the layered circulation device are connected, thelayered circulation device is connected with the absorbent refrigeration unit, and the control device are electrically connected with the solar energy heat collector, the drilling energy storage device, the layered circulation device and the absorbent refrigeration device. The solar energy is collected through the solar energy heat collector and converted into the heat energy, the heat energy is transmitted to the layered circulation device to supply the heat to users, the layered circulation device can also transmit the heat energy to the absorption refrigeration device, the absorbent refrigeration device absorbs the heat energy for cooling, the excess heat energy is stored through the drilling energy storage device, the drilling energy storage device can store the heat energy for a longtime, in the absence of the sufficient solar energy, the heat energy of the drilling energy storage device flows back to the solar energy heat collector, and the utilization rate of the solar energy is increased.

title: Solar energy heating pad and controlling means thereof
abstract: The utility model discloses a solar energy heating pad and controlling means thereof, wherein, solar energy heating pad's controlling means includes solar panel, battery, solar charging module, control module and heating module and USB output module, solar charging module, heating module and USB output module all connect control module, USB output module still connects battery and heating module,the solar charging module is still connected solar panel and battery, solar energy heating pad's controlling means utilize solar panel with solar energy transformation after for the electric energy through the storage of solar charging module in the battery to according to control module's control, make USB output module supply power in the heating module, and then make solar energy heating pad generate heat, realize that solar energy heating pad utilizes solar energy power generation's function, increase the duration of product, reach solar energy heating pad function diversified actual effect.

title: ROOF STRUCTURE WITH SOLAR BATTERY AND ROOF PANEL WITH SOLAR BATTERY
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To effectively use solar energy by providing a solar energy collector in a place of the roof surface where a solar battery module is not installed. SOLUTION: Solar battery modules 3 are sequentially fitted to the surface of a panel main body 2 through connecting frames stretched to longitudinal bars 11, 13 from the solar battery module 3 in the downstream of the flow direction. On the other hand, a solar energy collector 4 is stretched between the longitudinal bars 12, 13 by utilizing the fitting structure of the solar battery modules 3 to be fitted to the panel main body 2. When solar energy is given, the solar energy collector 4 can elevate the water temperature, whereby it is installed in a place where there is no solar battery module 3 to be effectively used for using solar energy. The solar energy collector 4 does not always need light quantity unlike the solar battery module 3, so that even if it is disposed in a place where the quantity of light is insufficient, the solar energy can be effectively used by function of the solar energy collector 4.

title: Systems and method for producing mechanical energy
abstract: A system is provided for producing mechanical energy. The system may include a solar collector configured to receive solar energy and an external heater configured to provide secondary thermal energy. Furthermore, the system may include an engine disposed in communication with the solar collector and the external heater. To this end, the engine may be operable to receive the solar energy from the solar collector, receive the secondary thermal energy from the external heater, and convert the solar energy and the secondary thermal energy to mechanical energy. Additionally, the system may include a controller in communication with the solar collector, the engine, and the external heater. The controller may be configured to control an amount of solar energy and an amount of secondary thermal energy received by the engine.

title: Portable modular sun-tracking solar energy receiver system
abstract: A portable solar energy generation system has a solar energy receiver having a plurality of solar cells for converting solar energy into a DC voltage. A solar tracking mechanism enables the solar energy receiver to track a position of the sun with respect to the solar cells and to position the solar cells responsive thereto. Power circuitry generates at least one output voltage to power an electronic device responsive to the DC voltage. A housing contains each of the solar energy receiver, the solar tracking mechanism and the power circuitry in a portable configuration.

title: Solar plateau surface temperature compensation device
abstract: The embodiment of the utility model relates to the technical field of energy equipment, and discloses a solar plateau surface temperature compensation device. The solar plateau surface temperature compensation device comprises a solar conversion module, an energy storage module and a temperature compensation module, wherein the temperature compensation module is arranged in soil on the ground surface; the solar energy conversion module is a solar energy thin film battery used for converting light energy into electric energy. the energy storage module is connected with the solar energy conversion module; the storage module is used for storing the electric energy output by the solar energy conversion module; the temperature compensation module is connected with the solar energy conversion module and the energy storage module; the solar energy conversion module or the energy storage module is used for converting electric energy output by the solar energy conversion module or electric energy stored by the energy storage module into heat energy and conducting the heat energy to earth surface soil, so that the earth surface temperature is increased, the growth temperature of plants in the young stage can be met, and the overwintering survival rate of plant seedlings is increased.

title: High -efficient heat pump device of two return circuits of absorption formula solar energy
abstract: The utility model discloses a high -efficient heat pump device of two return circuits of absorption formula solar energy, including solar panel, heat accumulation device, solar energy absorbed refrigeration device, the direct heating device of solar energy and solar thermal energy pump unit, solar panel passes through heat conduction solution loop pipe way intercommunication heat accumulation device, and the heat accumulation device passes through the loop pipe way and communicates solar energy absorbed refrigeration device and the direct heating device of solar energy respectively, and solar panel passes through refrigerant loop pipe way intercommunication solar thermal energy pump unit, solar energy absorbed refrigeration device, the direct heating device of solar energy and solar thermal energy pump unit are all through pipeline and air conditioning system intercommunication. The device sets up the heat accumulation device, has improved the heat -retaining volume of solar energy, and the heat supply is more stable, compressor system efficiency relative altitude, more power saving, application solar energy heat conduction refrigeration, it is power consumptive hardly to refrigerate, is power saving, economizes the refrigerating system of expense most.

title: SOLAR ENERGY UTILIZING APPARATUS
abstract: PURPOSE:To receive the sunlight in the maximum amount throughout a year, by inclining a solar energy receiving surface and fixing it such that the angle between the solar energy receiving surface and a horizontal plane is specified for the latitude of the installed position of the captioned apparatus. CONSTITUTION:In the solar energy utilizing apparatus wherein the solar energy receiving surface is fixed for receiving the solar energy, the angle alpha between the solar energy receiving surface and a horizontal plane is defined as (0.88+0.05)phi>= alpha>=(0.88-0.05)phi for the latitude phi of the installed position of the solar energy utilizing apparatus so that the solar energy receiving surface may be inclined. This is, as apparent from the characteristic chart that shows integrated values of electric power obtained for various solar energy receiving angles of a solar cell, based on the fact that the electric power is maximum at a solar energy receiving angle phi' that is a product of 0.88 multiplied by the latitude phi of the installed position.

title: Internal quartz solar energy light and heat converter
abstract: The utility model discloses an internal quartz solar energy light and heat converter suitable for different temperatures and a solar energy light and heat converting method by quartz devices. The utility model can sufficiently utilize the physical chemical performances of the quartz devices to implement the collection of the solar energy, and provides a new technology means and method for the solar energy. When the quartz devices are used as the solar energy collecting devices, the collections of the solar energy of different temperatures can be implemented, at least one quartz device is provided, one translucent device is arranged outside the quartz devices, a solar energy coating layer capable of converting the solar energy into the heat energy is arranged at the inner wall of the translucent device or the outer surface of the quartz device, the quartz devices transfer and/ or exchange the heat energy to the outside of the translucent device, thereby implementing the light and heat conversion of the solar energy and the final utilization of the heat energy. The objective of the utility model is to provide a solar energy light and heat converter suitable for different temperatures, especially a light and heat converter device for implementing the middle and high temperatures of the solar energy, and a solar energy light and heat converting device applied to tower type and butterfly type.

title: Solar battery
abstract: The invention provides a solar energy battery which comprises a solar energy battery module array, and the solar energy battery is characterized in that the solar energy battery module array comprises at least two adjacent arc solar energy battery modules in the row direction; arc faces of the adjacent arc solar energy battery modules in the row direction form adjacent overlapping or tangent overlapping on taper angles; and the arc faces are mutually parallel. The solar energy battery has the advantages of enhancing output of the solar energy battery under the condition of without increasing the investment of underlay materials and providing a compact arrangement program of the arc solar energy battery module to make adjacent arcs be mutually crossed; and the distance between the arc solar energy battery module array and the modules formed by adopting the mode is shortened, and the arrangement is compact.

title: reflector to assist in effecting a collection of solar energy
abstract: PURPOSE: A reflecting plate for collecting solar energy is provided to recollect solar energy discharged caused by reflection and to efficiently collect the solar energy. CONSTITUTION: A reflecting plate for collecting solar energy comprises a collector(1) collecting the solar energy; a collecting plate(2) mounted on the collector; a heat insulating plate(3) minimizing heat loss of the collector by being mounted on a rear portion of the collecting plate; upper and lower reflecting plates(5,6) installed on both end portions of the collector; and a hinge(7) combing the lower reflecting plate to the collector. The upper and lower reflecting plates inducing the solar energy to heat the collecting plate. Thereby, the reflecting plate for collecting the solar energy recollects the solar energy discharged caused by reflection. Moreover, the reflecting plate for collecting the solar energy efficiently collects the solar energy.

title: SOLAR ELECTRICITY GENERATION SYSTEM
abstract: 65148 abstract 10/09/08 ABSTRACT A solar electricity generation system including a solar energy-to-electricity converter having a solar energy receiving surface including at least an electricity-generating solar energy receiving surface and a plurality of reflectors arranged to reflect solar energy directly onto the solar energy receiving surface, each of the plurality of reflectors having a reflecting surface which is configured and located and aligned with respect to the solar energy receiving surface to reflect specular solar radiation with a high degree of uniformity onto the solar energy receiving surface, the configuration, location and alignment of each of the reflectors being such that the geometrical projection of each reflecting surface is substantially coextensive with the electricity-generating solar energy receiving surface. 1

title: Solar energy down jacket
abstract: The invention discloses a solar energy down jacket. The down jacket comprises a jacket main body, a hood, a collar and gussets, wherein a solar energy electric heating device is arranged in the jacket main body. The solar energy electric heating device is composed of a solar energy panel, a solar energy heat radiation assembly, a solar energy storage battery, a conversion interface, relevant circuits and a switch. The solar energy down jacket is special in function, solar energy absorbed by the surface of a down jacket is utilized reasonably and is transformed into electric energy, and people are enabled to increase the temperature of the down jacket according to utilization needs. The solar energy down jacket is convenient to operate, safe in operation, moderate in cost and capable of bringing convenience to life and work of the people.

title: An apparatus for converting solar energy into thermal energy
abstract: The utility model provides equipment for converting solar energy into heat energy, and the equipment comprises a rotary table which is provided with a rotatable rotating part; the rotary supporting focusing device is connected with the rotating part and can focus solar rays to form heat energy; the solar ray refraction tracking device is connected with the rotary support focusing device and can track solar rays so as to keep refracting the solar rays to the rotary support focusing device; and the solar tracking controller is connected with the rotary table and enables the solar ray refractiontracking device to track solar rays. The device for converting solar energy into heat energy converts solar energy into heat energy by mainly utilizing the principle of refraction, reflection and focusing of solar rays, and has the advantages of saving traditional energy, being free of environmental pollution, saving cost, reducing energy consumption and the like.

title: Pyramid building with solar power generator and solar water heater
abstract: The invention relates to a pyramid building with solar-energy generator and solar-energy water heater. Wherein, the solar-energy generator (2) and the solar-energy water heater (3) are mounted on the pyramid building (1) that toward to the sun; when using the electricity generated by solar-energy generator (2) and the hot water supplied by solar-energy water heater (3), it can supply energy and hot water to pyramid building (1) to save energy.

title: Greenhouse type agricultural product solar drying equipment
abstract: The utility model discloses a greenhouse type agricultural product solar drying equipment, its structure includes solar collector no. 1, solar collector no. 2, solar collector no. 3, solar energy fan no. 1, solar energy fan no. 2, solar energy fan no. 3, blast gate, expansion valve, condenser, hot dry wind entry, heat pump evaporator, check valve, compressor, dehumidification evaporation machine, humid air export, drying chamber, a solar collector no. 1 and a solar energy fan fixed connection, solar collector no. 2 and two fixed connection of solar energy fan, solar collector no. 3 and three fixed connection of solar energy fan, solar energy fan no. 1 and dehumidification evaporation machine fixed connection, the police dispatch newspaper through the alarm device who installs, just can be sent out to solar energy fan no. 2 and dehumidification evaporation machine fixed connection when equipment is attacked or is stolen.

title: Solar energy, air energy and geothermal device switching energy-saving compensation system
abstract: The invention relates to an energy-saving device, in particular to a solar energy, air energy and geothermal device switching energy-saving compensation system. The energy-saving compensation system mainly comprises a photovoltaic solar-thermal plate, an air source heat pump, a ground source heat pump, a water tank, a solar energy vacuum pipe, a steam storing tank and an electromagnetic heater. According to the solar energy, air energy and geothermal device switching energy-saving compensation system, the problem that the comprehensive usage rate is low in the prior art is solved, usage technologies of solar energy, air energy and geothermal devices are organically combined together, and a solar energy comprehensive usage system capable of effectively transforming the solar energy to electric energy and steam energy and sufficiently using solar thermal energy is provided.

title: Flexible transparent display screen powered by solar energy
abstract: The invention provides a flexible transparent display screen powered by solar energy. The flexible transparent display screen comprises a flexible transparent display screen body, a solar substrate, a solar energy storage device and a dual-power-supply automatic change-over switch. Wherein the solar energy storage device is respectively connected with the flexible transparent display screen and the solar substrate through conductive circuits; the dual-power-supply automatic change-over switch is connected with the solar energy storage device and the flexible transparent display screen through wires. The solar substrate is used for absorbing solar energy and converting the solar energy into electric energy, and the solar energy storage device stores the electric energy converted by the solar substrate and supplies power to the flexible transparent display screen; and the dual-power-supply automatic change-over switch is used for switching to mains supply to supply power to the flexible transparent display screen when the power supplied by the solar energy storage device is insufficient.

title: Energy storage battery box
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of energy storage, and discloses an energy storage battery box which comprises a device main body, the device main body comprises an energy storage battery box body, a box body handle is further fixedly installed on the energy storage battery box body, anti-skid lines are installed on the outer surface of the box body handle in a sleeved mode, and the device main body further comprises a solar energy supplementing mechanism. The solar energy supplementing mechanism comprises a first solar panel, a second solar panel and a third solar panel, and the first solar panel is fixedly mounted at the top end of the energy storage battery box body. Through the arrangement of the solar energy complementing mechanism, in actual use, solar energy is converted into electric energy through the first solar panel, the second solar panel and the third solar panel, and the electric energy is stored in the energy storage battery box body for unexpected needs; the problem that most of traditional energy storage battery boxes cannot utilize solar energy to complement energy and can only be charged by an external power supply, so that the practicability is poor is effectively solved.

title: Application method for solar collector array
abstract: The invention provides an application method for a solar collector array. Each solar collector in the solar collector array is fixed onto an outer wall and consists of a solar energy collector and a solar energy receiver, and each solar energy collector is connected with the corresponding solar energy receiver by a supporting frame. By the aid of the application method for the solar collector array, land conservation is realized to the greatest extent, and users can use heat energy generated by the solar collector array conveniently.

abstract: The utility model provides a flexible panel of solar energy, including first solar energy flexible board, second solar energy flexible board, bale of cloth and solar control ware, first solar energy flexible board with second solar energy flexible board all includes and concatenates the single crystal battery lamella that forms by monocrystalline silicon battery the piece complete or cutting, first solar energy flexible board with second solar energy flexible board uses connecting wire to connect, first solar energy flexible board with second solar energy flexible board is fixed in the bale of cloth, and through the electric wire with the solar control ware is connected, first solar energy flexible board is fixed in the bale of cloth with first solar energy flexible board to can fold each other, and have the zip fastener to bring together, convenient closely folding, folded sheet light in weight can conveniently carry, and the solar control ware is integrative with solar panel to having connect the line, having opened behind the bale of cloth openly and to press from both sides the support towards solar battery and directly link the battery and can give storage battery charging, easy operation conveniently.

title: Solar power generation equipment capable of tracking sun movement
abstract: The utility mode discloses a solar energy generating device tracking the solar movement, comprising a supporting bracket, a multi-layer solar energy cell plate installed on the supporting bracket, cable used for transmitting the power connected to the solar energy cell plate; the solar energy cell plate is rotatablely connected to the supporting bracket; thee solar energy cell plate is connected to the driving mechanism; the driving mechanism controls the solar energy cell plate to rotate via the controller. The utility model tracks the solar energy generating device of the solar movement to enhance the using rate of the solar energy, which has a simple structure, convenient installation, full automatic operation, security, waterproofing and leakage proofing.

title: Solar energy powered lift
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of lifts, in particular to a solar energy powered lift. The solar energy powered lift comprises a mains supply, a lift control device and a solar energy power supply device, wherein the lift control device comprises a power-transfer module, the power-transfer module is provided with two power input terminals, one of the terminals is connected with the mains supply, and the other terminal is connected with a storage battery. The storage battery is connected with the solar energy power supply device. The solar energy power supply device comprises a solar collector plate and a solar controller, wherein the solar collector plate is connected with the solar controller, and the solar controller is connected with the storage battery. By means of the solar energy powered lift, the solar energy can be fully transferred into electric energy to supply power to the lift, energy-saving and environment protecting performance are good, and the normal operation of the lift is guaranteed.

title: Light energy heat gathering device of solar energy water heater and method for eliminating fogs thereon
abstract: The invention discloses a method for eliminating mist on a light energy heat gathering device of a solar energy water heater, including a solar energy photoheating layer in the light energy heat gathering device for adsorbing the solar energy and generating heat. The solar energy photoheating layer transmits the heat on a glass body which has mist on an inner surface and heats the glass body. The glass body absorbs the heat generated by the solar energy pohotoheating layer. The mist one the inner surface of the glass is evaporated. Because the technical scheme that the solar energy photoheating layer is arranged on the glass body out of a solar energy collector tube is adopted, even if a thermal insulation layer is a gas insulating layer under a non-vacuum state, at the same time that the solar energy collector tube absorbs the solar energy and exchanges heat with liquid in the tube, the solar energy photoheating layer on the glass body can also absorb the solar energy and heat the glass body to lead the temperature to rise. The rising of the temperature also evaporates the mist condensed on the inner surface of the glass body.

title: Solar stepping stone
abstract: A solar stepping stone comprises a housing having an upper surface, side walls and a lower surface, the housing defining a chamber. A solar energy collector is associated with the housing for collecting solar energy. A solar power storage device is provided in the chamber for receiving and storing solar energy received from the solar energy collectors. An illuminator for illuminating at least a portion of the upper surface of the solar stepping stone is contained in the chamber and is powered by solar energy stored by the solar power member.

title: Wind energy/solar energy complementary stepless street lamp
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of conversion of wind energy and solar energy to electric energy, particularly to a wind energy/solar energy complementary stepless street lamp, which comprises a solar energy battery panel, a wind energy generator and a control circuit for controlling conversion of wind energy/solar energy to electric energy. The control circuit comprises a power inverter, a power storage unit, and a charging current controller. The wind energy/solar energy complementary stepless street lamp integrates wind energy power generation and solar energy power generation, and takes full use of natural resources to obtain energy.

title: Wind energy and solar energy supplementary power generation system
abstract: A wind energy and solar energy supplementary power generation system belongs to the field of wind energy and solar energy utilization equipment. The wind energy and solar energy supplementary power generation system comprises a wind driven generator (1), a solar cell panel (2), a wind power generator controller, a solar power generation controller, an inverter and a storage battery; and the wind driven generator (1) and the solar cell panel (2) are respectively connected with the wind power generator controller and the solar power generation controller, and the wind power generator controller and the solar power generation controller are connected with the storage battery and/or the inverter. The wind energy and solar energy supplementary power generation system is characterized in that the wind energy and solar energy supplementary power generation system is provided with an operation condition control box (3), and the wind power generator controller, the solar power generation controller, the storage battery and the inverter are fixed into the operation condition control box (3). Through the wind energy and solar energy supplementary power generation system, the energy storage element and the controllers of the wind energy and solar energy supplementary power generation system can be in suitable working conditions, and system work is more stable and reliable.

title: Moving point array solar focusing building energy supply system
abstract: The invention relates to solar energy utilization, in particular to solar energy collection by using a point focusing solar mirror and application of the point focusing solar mirror to a moving point array solar focusing building energy supply system. The moving point array solar focusing building energy supply system at least comprises one or one group of point focusing solar mirrors, at least one solar photothremal conversion device and a tracking control device for control, wherein the solar mirrors are arranged on a solar mirror support; solar photothermal conversion devices are arranged on a solar photothermal conversion device support, and are arranged in a punctiform area focused by the solar mirrors; and the tracking control device controls the solar mirrors to focus sunlight to at least one solar photothermal conversion device when the sunlight changes, the solar photothermal conversion devices move in the process that the solar mirrors track solar energy, and each or each group of solar mirrors select the solar photothermal conversion device capable of reaching the highest solar energy utilization efficiency for focusing, so that the solar energy is tracked, focused and utilized.

title: Solar energy ceramic tile that discolours
abstract: The utility model discloses a solar energy ceramic tile that discolours, include: solar energy top layer, mucigel, solar energy energy storing board and magnet layer, confined space in the besieged city between solar energy top layer and the magnet layer, solar energy energy storing board be located between solar energy top layer and the magnet layer besieged city the enclosure space in, be connected through the mucigel between solar energy energy storing board and the solar energy top layer. In this way, the utility model provides a solar energy ceramic tile that discolours, it is good to provide a practicality, and the building material who has better use value, saves the labour when people construct to the fine environmental protection of ability idol, the life of giving people brings very big facility.

title: Solar energy absorption coating
abstract: A solar energy absorption coating is characterized by being prepared from the following raw materials: resin, an absorbent, an extender pigment, an auxiliary agent and a solvent. The solar energy utilization degree of the existing solar energy absorption coating is low, the solar energy can be converted into heat energy efficiently, the weather resistance of the coating is good, and the light-retaining and color-retaining property is excellent. The solar energy absorption coating is mainly used for converting solar energy into heat energy, and is particularly suitable for a solar water heater,a thermos room and the like.

title: Solar energy and electric energy combined energy-saving water heater
abstract: The invention discloses a solar energy and electric energy combined energy-saving water heater which comprises a solar energy main body bracket; a solar energy water tank is arranged at the top of the solar energy main body bracket; a power supply interface is formed in the bottom surface of the solar energy water tank; the interior of the solar energy water tank is connected with electric heating pipes through connecting rods; and connecting holes are formed in the lower surface of the solar energy water tank. The power supply interface is formed in the bottom surface of the solar energy water tank, and the interior of the solar energy water tank is connected with the electric heating pipes through the connecting rods, so that the water heater can heat water in the solar energy water tank through electric heating during overcast and rainy days, and thus is wider in application scope and higher in practicability. Supporting upright rods are arranged on bases through connecting threaded rod, so that the overall height of the water heater can be adjusted, angles of solar heat collecting pipes in the water heater can be adjusted, the solar heat collecting pipes can absorb solar energy better, and the heating efficiency is higher.

The invention discloses a colored solar energy module structure which comprises a solar energy module; a packaging layer is arranged on the surface of the solar energy module and has color so that the solar energy module can be combined on the surface to form a colored packaging layer; the decoration and the simulation ability of the arrangement of the solar energy module are increased; and the colored solar energy module structure also has the power generation function of a solar panel.

title: System and Method for Creating a Networked Vehicle Infrastructure Distribution Platform of Solar Energy Gathering Devices
abstract: A vehicle for gathering solar energy into a roadway system electricity grid. In one embodiment of the invention, the vehicle comprises an energy storage system; and at least one solar energy generating device coupled to the vehicle. The at least one solar energy generating device is configured to generate electricity from sunlight. The at least one solar energy generating device is configured to electrically connect to a roadway system electricity grid. In another embodiment of the present invention is a method for a vehicle gathering solar energy and providing the same to the roadway system electricity grid. The method comprises the step of harnessing solar energy from a vehicle-based solar energy gathering device; converting solar energy into electrical energy; storing the electrical energy; and discharging the stored electrical energy to a roadway system electricity grid.

title: High-concentration solar energy receiving module
abstract: The invention relates to a high-concentration solar energy receiving module which comprises a solar energy receiving module; the solar energy receiving module is arranged in a high-concentration solar energy module and comprises a non-imaging solar energy concentrator, a solar energy cell receiver and a heat radiator which are arranged from top to bottom; the solar energy receiving module also comprises an enclosed housing which is sleeved outside the non-imaging solar energy concentrator and the solar energy cell receiver; and at least the top of the enclosed housing is provided with an opening or a perspective window corresponding to the top surface of the non-imaging solar energy concentrator. The enclosed housing is sleeved outside the non-imaging solar energy concentrator and the solar energy cell receiver to form an enclosed high-concentration photovoltaic (HCPV) module so that all components inside the enclosed housing can be prevented from pollutions and interferences of substances, such as dust, vapor, compounds in air, humidity, and the like in the external environment and the blockage to the presentation of all the components is avoided, and therefore the service life of each component is prolonged and the photoelectric conversion efficiency and the reliability of the solar energy receiving module are improved.

title: Solar energy window structure
abstract: The utility model relates to a solar energy window structure which comprises a main frame with an opening fitted at the top of the building. The main frame is provided with a modular solar energy light penetrating window plate and a driver, wherein the modular solar energy light penetrating window plate receives solar energy and converts solar energy into electric energy which can be output, and the driver connects with the modular solar energy light penetrating window plate and drives the modular solar energy light penetrating window plate to move on the main frame to close or open the opening. The solar energy window structure is fitted at the top of the building to light, generate electricity, and ventilate.

title: Flexible transparent display screen powered by solar energy
abstract: The utility model provides a flexible transparent display screen powered by solar energy. The flexible transparent display screen comprises a flexible transparent display screen body, a solar substrate, a solar energy storage device and a dual-power-supply automatic change-over switch. Wherein the solar energy storage device is respectively connected with the flexible transparent display screen and the solar substrate through conductive circuits; the dual-power-supply automatic change-over switch is connected with the solar energy storage device and the flexible transparent display screen through wires. The solar substrate is used for absorbing solar energy and converting the solar energy into electric energy, and the solar energy storage device stores the electric energy converted by the solar substrate and supplies power to the flexible transparent display screen; and the dual-power-supply automatic change-over switch is used for switching to mains supply to supply power to the flexible transparent display screen when the power supplied by the solar energy storage device is insufficient.

title: Electric motor car with solar energy sound box
abstract: The utility model discloses an electric motor car with a solar energy sound box, which comprises a car main body, wherein the tail part of the car main body is provided with a sound box, the outer surface of a front shell of the car main body is provided with a solar energy cell panel, a solar energy controller and a solar energy battery are arranged on the car main body, a charging loop is formed by the solar energy cell panel, the solar energy controller and the solar energy battery, and a power supply loop is formed by the solar energy battery and the sound box. According to the utility model, the sound box is powered-on by the energy collected by the solar energy cell panel without using a motive power battery of the electric motor car, the whole system is environmental, and the cost is low.

title: HYBRID SOLAR ENERGY CONCENTRATOR INSTALLATION
abstract: The hybrid solar energy concentrator installation comprises a supporting and turning device, a solar energy concentrator and a solar energy converter. As an additional solar energy converter, it comprises a solar energy to electrical energy converter assembly, which is mounted on a movable part of the supporting and turning device and which is movable together with the concentrator.

title: Portable solar semiconductor lighting device
abstract: The utility model provides a separated solar energy lamp which comprises a solar energy polar plate and a lamp body which is integrated with the solar energy polar plate, wherein an accumulator which is communicated with a circuit of the solar energy pole plate and a luminous body which is electrically connected with the accumulator are arranged in the lamp body. The connecting part of the accumulator and the solar energy polar plate is provided with an electric circuit jack, and an electric plug which corresponds to the circuit jack is arranged at the free end of an electric connection line which is led out from the solar energy polar plate. The lamp body and the solar energy pole plate can be separated or integrated by the jack, the plug and the connecting line, the lamp absorbs solar energy by the solar energy pole plate, the solar energy is converted into electric energy and the electric energy is stored into the accumulator. When occasion demands, the plug is pulled off from the jack to make the lamp body and the solar energy pole plate separate and the lamp can be used for a large range or big efficiency.

title: Solar gas turbine power generation system based on photo-thermal principle
abstract: The utility model provides a solar gas turbine power generation system based on a photo-thermal principle. The solar gas turbine power generation system comprises a gas turbine, a solar energy collecting device, a solar energy reflecting mirror, a mounting table and an adjusting device, wherein the solar energy collecting device is arranged on the gas turbine and used for heating a circulating medium on a working medium channel of the gas turbine, and the gas turbine is fixed above the solar energy reflecting mirror and enables the solar energy collecting device to be located at a sunlight reflection gathering point; and the solar reflector is mounted on the mounting table through an adjusting device for adjusting the angle of the solar reflector. Solar energy, the gas turbine and the sunlight tracking technology are combined, it can be guaranteed that a solar energy gas turbine power generation system efficiently absorbs solar energy, and therefore the utilization rate of energy is increased.

title: Solar stepping stone
abstract: A solar stepping stone comprises a housing having an upper surface, side walls and a lower surface, the housing defining a chamber. A solar energy collector is associated with the housing for collecting solar energy. A solar power storage device is provided in the chamber for receiving and storing solar energy received from the solar energy collectors. An illuminator for illuminating at least a portion of the upper surface of the solar stepping stone is contained in the chamber and is powered by solar energy stored by the solar power member.

title: Solar energy umbrella
abstract: The embodiment of the utility model provides a solar energy umbrella, umbrella pole including covering the umbrella face on the rib and linking to each other with the rib is equipped with film solar energy component on the umbrella face, can charge for the electric energy solar energy transformation for the electronic product. Solar energy umbrella still including setting up the sombrero in umbrella pole one end, is provided with solar energy umbrella control circuit and energy storage battery in the sombrero, make the distance between solar energy umbrella control circuit and the energy storage battery very little, has not only effectively utilized the space in the sombrero, also makes solar energy umbrella overall structure compact reasonable. The two reduces solar energy umbrella control circuit and energy storage battery with film solar energy component distance, has not only reduced the electric energy excess loss who leads to because of the circuit overlength effectively, has still avoided the wire to expose the life -span that influences electronic component outward and solar energy umbrella's aesthetic property. The embodiment of the utility model provides a solar energy umbrella easily makes and the assembly, has improved the holistic processing performance of solar energy umbrella.

title: Solar energy drive shutter
abstract: The utility model relates to a solar energy drive shutter. The solar energy drive shutter comprises blades, ladder bands and a drive mechanism of the blades. A solar cell panel is connected with the blades in a welded mode, a binder mode or a clamp groove mode. The solar cell pane collects solar energy, and accesses electric energy which is converted from the solar energy into a solar energy drive system through wires in the conductive ladder bands. The electric energy is used for driving lifting and overturn of the solar energy drive shutter. Redundant electric energy is stored for other use. The solar energy drive shutter has the advantages of being ingenious in structural design, novel in conception, creative and capable of collecting ignored energy sources in daily life to use, and achieving purposes of environment protection and energy saving.

title: Solar energy lamp
abstract: The utility model relates to a solar energy lamp, which is characterized in that the solar energy lamp comprises a lampshade with an interface, a solar energy lamp and a connecting device for connecting the lampshade and the solar energy lamp, wherein the solar energy lamp comprises a solar energy power supplying device, an LED lamp, a base of the LED lamp and a connecting wire for connecting the solar energy power supplying device and the LED lamp. The lampshade, the solar energy lamp and the connecting device of the solar energy lamp provided by the utility model can all be disassembled and replaced so that the using convenience of the solar energy lamp and the reutilization rate of resources are enhanced, and meanwhile, the assembling height of the LED lamp can be carried out with adaptive regulation according to the different shapes and sizes of the lampshade so that the utility model obtains the optimum illuminating effect. The solar energy lamp of the utility model has the advantages of safety and beautiful appearance and is suitable for using as an illuminating or decorating lamp inside and outside rooms of different occasions.

title: Foldable solar energy assembly and mobile vehicle having the same
abstract: The present invention relates to a solar energy assembly having a main frame, at least one solar energy panel frame, a driving device, and an electrical assembly. The at least one solar energy panel frame is pivotally and foldablly connected with the main frame. Each solar energy panel frame has multiple solar energy panels mounted thereon. The driving device is mounted on the main frame and connected to the at least one solar energy panel frame to pivot the at least one solar energy panel frame related to the main frame. The electrical assembly has a battery electrically connected to the solar energy panels on the at least one solar panel energy frame and a distribution box electrically connected with the battery.

title: Factory agricultural multi-stage solar energy and other energy compensation thermal power generation system
abstract: The utility model aims to provide a factory agricultural multi-stage solar energy and other energy compensation thermal power generation system which comprises solar energy collecting systems and power generator sets. The solar energy collecting system and the power generator set form a set of solar energy power generation system. The factory agricultural multi-stage solar energy and other energy compensation thermal power generation system comprises at least two sets of solar energy power generation system and at least a set of energy system provided by the energy except for the solar energy. Supplementary energy is supplied for the solar energy power generation system. One set of solar energy power generation system can be connected with another set of solar energy power generation system in series and/or in parallel. The waste heat after power generation of one set of power generation system is used by another set of power generation system, thereby realizing power generation with multi-stage waste heat utilization. Two sets of solar energy power generation systems can be composed of a set of solar energy low-temperature power generation system and a set of solar energy high-temperature power generation system. The waste heat of the double-stage power generation system can be used by the other stage, thereby performing step collection and utilization on the solar system with different collection temperatures.

title: Sheathing solar energy system and construction method thereof
abstract: The present invention relates to a sheathing solar energy system and a method for constructing the same. The sheathing solar energy system comprises: a solar rack; and a sheathing framework, and the solar rack includes a solar energy panel. According to the invention, the spread of solar energy can be expanded.

title: Solar energy glass energy supply automatic watering device
abstract: The utility model discloses a solar energy glass energy supply automatic watering device, including the support, locate the support top the flowerpot, locate support bottom water bottle, locate medialwater pump of support and controlling means, install solar energy glass and solar cell strip on the window frame, the solar cell strip is connected with solar energy glass, is used for utilizing theabsorptive light of solar energy glass turns into the electric energy and stores, water pump and controlling means connect the solar cell strip. Solar energy glass has replaced traditional ordinary glass, makes to project the solar energy that does not have utilized on the glass originally and obtained effective utilization, solar energy glass stores solar energy transformation for the electric energy, for controlling means and water pump are supplied power, have reduced traditional automatic control and have watered the device to the consumption of family's electric energy, and be energy -concerving and environment -protective, needs other installation not only to install loaded down with trivial detailsly and need occupy big space in addition for traditional solar cell panel simultaneously.

title: IN-VEHICLE SOLAR ENERGY CHARGING SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR CONTROLLING THE SAME
abstract: An in-vehicle solar energy charging system and a method for controlling the same are disclosed. The in-vehicle solar energy charging system comprises a solar energy cell panel (110), a solar energy charger (120), a starting battery (130), a power battery (140) and a controller (150), in which the solar energy cell panel (110) is electrically connected to the solar energy charger (120), the starting battery (130) and the power battery (140) are electrically connected to the solar energy charger (120) respectively, the solar energy charger (120), the starting battery (130) and the power battery (140) are electrically connected to the controller (150) respectively, and the controller (150) is configured for performing a maximum photovoltaic power tracking algorithm so as to control the output power of the solar energy charger (120). The system may realize flexible control and maximize the output power of the solar energy.

title: Systems and Method for Producing Mechanical Energy
abstract: A system is provided for producing mechanical energy. The system may include a solar collector configured to receive solar energy and an external heater configured to provide secondary thermal energy. Furthermore, the system may include an engine disposed in communication with the solar collector and the external heater. To this end, the engine may be operable to receive the solar energy from the solar collector, receive the secondary thermal energy from the external heater, and convert the solar energy and the secondary thermal energy to mechanical energy. Additionally, the system may include a controller in communication with the solar collector, the engine, and the external heater. The controller may be configured to control an amount of solar energy and an amount of secondary thermal energy received by the engine.

title: Flying assisting device and kite
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of solar energy, and particularly discloses a flying assisting device and a kite, the flying assisting device comprises a solar energy assembly, an energy storage assembly, a solar energy controller and a flying assembly; the solar module is used for converting solar energy into electric energy; the energy storage assembly is connected with the solar assembly and used for storing electric energy. The solar assembly and the energy storage assembly are connected with the flight assembly through the solar controller. Wherein the solar controller isused for switching connection between the solar assembly and the energy storage assembly and the flight assembly; the flight assembly is connected with the solar controller and used for achieving flight of the flight assisting device. According to the flight assisting device, the solar assembly and the energy storage assembly are used for providing electric energy needed by work for the flight assembly, self-sufficiency of the electric energy is achieved, normal work of the flight assembly can be guaranteed, under the condition that the flight assembly works normally, the influence of the environment or human factors on the flight assisting device is avoided, and the flight effect of the flight assisting device is improved.

title: Optical energy integrated test system
