abstract: The invention discloses an optical energy integrated test system, and relates to the technical field of solar energy application. The optical energy integrated test system is mainly composed of a solar energy collecting assembly, an electric energy measuring device and a timer. The solar energy collecting assembly is composed of a solar cell panel, a controller and a storage battery, wherein the solar cell panel is connected with the storage battery through the controller, and the electric energy measuring device and the timer are respectively connected with the storage battery. Due to the fact that the electric energy measuring device and the timer are connected with the storage battery of the solar energy collecting assembly, optical energy data of the solar energy are measured and collected in the process of collecting the solar energy, solar energy illumination intensity data of solar energy illumination engineering installation sites are obtained, and accurate guide data are provided for engineering installation, a good foundation is laid for the stable operation of the illuminating engineering. The optical energy integrated test system has the advantages of being low in manufacturing cost, short in measurement period, and accurate in data measurement.

title: Air energy heat pump and solar energy complementary type hot water device
abstract: The invention discloses an air energy heat pump and solar energy complementary type hot water device, which comprises an air energy heat pump, a regenerative heat exchanger, a heat pump heat exchanger, a hot water output heat exchanger, a solar energy hot water heat exchanger, a solar energy hot water circulating pipe, a solar energy heat collector and an expansion water tank, wherein a heating unit of the air energy heat pump is connected with the regenerative heat exchanger, the regenerative heat exchanger is provided with the solar energy hot water heat exchanger and the hot water output heat exchanger, the solar energy hot water heat exchanger is connected with a solar energy heat collector through the solar energy hot water circulating pipe, and a solar energy lower circulating pipeline is connected with the expansion water tank. The air energy heat pump and solar energy complementary type hot water device uses the air energy heat pump and a solar energy hot water system to form a double-energy hot water system, fully uses air heat energy, also change direct using of solar energy hot water into indirect using of the solar energy hot water, increases use rate of air heat energy and exchanges air indoor in time at the same time, keeps air fresh, further guarantees quality of the solar energy hot water, can heat at once when using, prevents bacteria growth, and keeps hot water to be used in health standard.

title: Solar energy sightseeing elevator
abstract: The utility model discloses a solar energy sightseeing elevator, comprising an elevator body, a solar energy control system, an inversion system, a power-off detection system, and a power supply transition system, the solar energy control system comprises: a solar energy receiving panel, a solar energy converter, and a storage battery set, the solar energy control system, the inversion system, the power supply transition system, and the power-off detection system are successively connected with a motor in the elevator body. The solar energy sightseeing elevator can effectively uses solar energy, is advantaged by environmental protection, and is worthy of popularization.

title: Energy management system associated with solar generation
abstract: The present invention relates to an energy management system associated with solar energy generation and, more specifically, to an energy management system associated with solar energy generation which is optimized for an individual building performing solar energy generation, which may easily calculate the amount of solar energy generation and which may accurately diagnose a state of a solar energy generation device by providing a comprehensive analysis of status information of a power plant associated with power supply of a solar energy generation device, the amount of electricity used of an individual building where a solar energy generation device is installed and weather information.

title: Solar stepping stone
abstract: A solar stepping stone comprises a housing having an upper surface, side walls and a lower surface, the housing defining a chamber. A solar energy collector is associated with the housing for collecting solar energy. A solar power storage device is provided in the chamber for receiving and storing solar energy received from the solar energy collectors. An illuminator for illuminating at least a portion of the upper surface of the solar stepping stone is contained in the chamber and is powered by solar energy stored by the solar power member.

title: Solar energy component's solidification equipment
abstract: The utility model discloses a solar energy component's solidification equipment, place board and support including device body, solar energy component, the top of support is provided with the device body, this internal solar energy component of being provided with of device places the board, the top that solar energy component placed the board is provided with first heating member, the top of first heating member is provided with first hot -blast fan, the below that solar energy component placed the board is provided with the second heating member, the hot -blast fan of below second of secondheating member solar energy component places the board and is connected with solar energy component transmission track. The utility model provides a solar energy component's solidification equipment through the position of adjusting solar energy component, has improved solar energy component's solidification quality, through transmitting orbital conveying, can damage in transport and solidification process by the effectual solar energy component of preventing.

title: Solar energy automobile
abstract: The invention discloses a solar energy automobile. The solar energy automobile comprises an electric automobile body and a solar energy device, wherein the solar energy device comprises a plurality of solar energy panels, a plurality of charging control circuits connected with the solar energy panels, and a plurality of sets of independent battery sets connected with the charging control circuits, wherein the sets of independent battery sets are connected with an electric motor through change-over switches; the electric motor is used for driving the automobile; and the solar energy panels are mounted on the surface of the box body of the automobile. According to the solar energy automobile disclosed by the invention, automobile body area and bottom space are sufficiently utilized, the sets of independent battery sets and sets of charging control electric circuits are arranged, so that, storage of the solar energy is realized, the endurance capability of the solar energy automobile is greatly improved, and the solar energy automobile is especially suitable for a small-scale truck, a small-scale passenger car and a bus.

title: All-weather solar energy heat accumulation and consumption method and device
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of solar energy equipment and discloses an all-weather solar energy heat accumulation and consumption method and device. The solar energy heat accumulation and consumption device comprises at least one sunlight thermal energy collecting system, a stored energy heat exchanger, an energy heat exchanger and conducting oil, wherein the at least one sunlight thermal energy collecting system consists of a solar energy reflector and a solar energy heat exchanger; the solar energy heat exchanger located at the focus of the solar energy reflector is communicated with the stored energy heat exchanger by an oil conduit; the stored energy heat exchanger is communicated with the energy heat exchanger by the oil conduit; the sunny exposure direction of the solar energy reflector with a paraboloid baffle-board corresponds to the sun direction by a solar energy tracking system. The all-weather solar energy heat accumulation and consumption method and device are used for collecting and storing thermal energy of sun, the thermal energy is used for processing food, heating, bathing and baking, energy is saved, fuel consumption and greenhouse gas emission are reduced, the problem of current gradual energy lack can be relieved, and the effects of protecting environment and saving energy are achieved.

title: SOLAR ENERGY UTILIZATION DEVICE
abstract: A solar energy utilization device, which comprises at least one solar light condenser unit, the solar light condenser unit comprises a condenser lens, a first solar energy utilization unit, and a second solar energy utilization unit. The condenser lens comprises a first lens portion and a second lens portion, where connection regions of the first lens portion and the second lens portion have been configured as more narrow, and the condenser lens forms an hourglass-shaped structure; the first solar energy utilization unit is located at a first end of the first lens portion, and the second solar energy utilization unit is located at a second end of the second lens portion, i.e., the first solar energy utilization unit and the second solar energy utilization unit are located at two respective ends of the condenser lens; the first lens portion can focus light to the first solar energy utilization unit, and the second lens portion can focus light to the second solar energy utilization unit, so that two faces and two sides of the first solar energy utilization unit and the second solar energy utilization unit can all be used to collect light, thereby increasing the light collection area of the first solar energy utilization unit and the second solar energy utilization, and consequently improving power generation capacity and power generation efficiency.

title: Rotary solar generating device
abstract: The utility model relates to a rotary solar generating device, which solves the problem that solar energy cannot be fully and effectively utilized by the present fixed solar device. The rotary solar generating device includes a pedestal; the pedestal is provided with a rotating disk with a pulley; the rotating disk is fixedly provided with a rotating shaft; the top of the rotating shaft is hinged to a solar energy plate; the solar energy plate is hinged to the rotating shaft through an electric telescopic rod; and the output terminal of the solar energy plate is connected with a solar energy controller, a storage battery, a solar energy inverter and a time controller in sequence. The rotating disk in the device enables the solar energy plate to rotate automatically, and the elevation angle of the solar energy plate can be adjusted by the electric telescopic rod. According to the rotary solar generating device, the structure is simple, the design is ingenious, mounting and dismounting are rapid, solar energy is fully utilized, the solar generating efficiency is substantially raised, investment cost is reduced, production benefit is raised, and much investment value is provided.

title: BIFACIAL PHOTOVOLTAIC SOLAR ENERGY APPARATUS
abstract: A bifacial photovoltaic solar energy apparatus is provided to receive solar light under an optimum condition by improving the structure of a reflector and prevent increase of load of a solar tracking system by minimizing the weight of the reflector. A bifacial photovoltaic solar energy apparatus includes a double-sided solar energy unit(30), a first reflector(40), and a second reflector(50). The double-sided solar energy unit has a front surface and a rear surface for receiving solar light, and is inclined in one direction by 40 to 50 degrees. The first reflector is arranged at the right side of the double-sided solar energy unit, and inclined by 85 to 95 degrees from the double-sided solar energy unit. The first reflector is arranged to reflect solar light to the front surface of the double-sided solar energy unit. The second reflector is spaced apart from the left side of the double-sided solar energy unit, and inclined by 40 to 50 degrees in the direction opposite to the first reflector such that the second reflector reflects solar light to the rear surface of the double-sides solar energy unit.

title: Energy-saving greenhouse system based on solar energy
abstract: The invention provides an energy-saving greenhouse system based on solar energy. The system comprises a solar power generation subsystem and an energy-saving control subsystem; the solar power generation subsystem is used for converting solar energy into electric energy and supplying power to the energy-saving control subsystem; and the energy-saving control subsystem is used for adjusting the environment of a greenhouse by utilizing the electric energy provided by the solar power generation subsystem. The energy-saving greenhouse system based on solar energy has the beneficial effects that the energy-saving greenhouse system based on solar energy is provided, and power support is provided for the environment adjustment of the greenhouse through solar energy, so that full utilization of solar energy and accurate control of the environment of the greenhouse are realized, the environment is protected to the maximum extent, and the system is of great significance for sustainable development of the greenhouse and for the construction and protection of the environment of beautiful homeland of humans.

title: Photoelectric and photo-thermal integrated assembly
abstract: At present, in the field of solar energy application, two modes are mainly adopted, one mode is to absorb solar energy to generate electricity, and the other mode is to absorb solar heat to heat water, but the two modes cannot be combined, and precious clean energy of solar energy is wasted to a great extent. The invention relates to the field of solar energy application, and especially relates to a device for converting solar energy absorbed by a solar power generation panel and a heat absorber into electric energy and heat energy. The device can be widely applied to various occasions with sufficient illumination.

title: Solar energy mouse
abstract: The invention relates to a solar energy mouse comprising a mouse body, an optical sensor, an internal light source, a battery, a lens, a solar module and an energy management device. The solar energy mouse uses the lens arranged on the mouse body to focus rays; the solar module receives the rays; and the energy management device transforms the rays into electrical energy and then carries out the management of charging the battery of the mouse. The solar energy mouse can solve the problem that the traditional solar energy mouse is required to wait for the solar module to absorb enough solar energy to continue the operation when electrical power for maintaining action is insufficient.

title: Solar chemical heat storage system for heating
abstract: The invention relates to a solar chemical heat storage system for heating. The solar chemical heat storage system for heating comprises an energy storage assembly, a storage battery and a boiler body,wherein the energy storage assembly is used for absorbing solar energy and adjusting the absorption amount of the solar energy, the storage battery is used for storing the solar energy for chemical energy conversion, and the boiler body is used for outputting heat for heating; and the energy storage assembly comprises a solar main board and solar auxiliary boards movably arranged on two sides ofthe solar main board, the solar auxiliary boards are rotationally accommodated at the bottom of the solar main board through fixing pieces, and the solar auxiliary boards are rotationally supported ontwo sides of the solar main board through locking pieces to form the same horizontal plane with the solar main board. In short, by means of the technical scheme, through a coherent and compact structure, the problems that scale is prone to generation and high-temperature steam cannot be generated greatly when traditional solar energy chemical energy storage is applied to a heating system are solved, and the problem that the solar energy absorption amount cannot be adjusted according to the requirement of a real-time situation when the traditional solar energy chemical energy storage is applied to the heating system is further solved.

title: Solar power energy system in a bicycle
abstract: A solar power energy system in a bicycle, which comprises: a first solar energy transferring unit with electric connection, an electric energy storage unit and an output unit. The first solar energy transferring unit is formed with several solar energy plates on the topside of a mudguard, or it is set several solar energy plates on a sliding plate, which is pivoted under the carriage frame of the bicycle, to collect the solar energy in the daytime by solar energy plates on the mudguard or sliding plate and then transfer to electric power stored in the electric energy storage unit to provide to output unit. It has a regular appearance and convenient application.

title: Portable solar energy charger
abstract: The utility model discloses a portable solar energy charger comprising a shell and a solar panel arranged on the shell. A groove used for installing a charging module is arranged on the shell, the charging module is adapted with the groove, and a solar energy output interface is arranged in the groove; the charging module comprises a charge-discharge storage battery, a solar energy charging input interface and a solar energy charging output interface; the charge-discharge storage battery is arranged in a box body, the solar energy charging input interface and the solar energy charging output interface are arranged on the box body, the solar panel is electrically connected with the solar energy output interface by a control circuit, and the solar energy output interface is electrically connected with the solar energy charging input interface. A solar energy charger main body and the charging module can be conveniently disassembled; the charging module carries out charging, and the using is more convenient; under the condition that both an electrical appliance and the charging module are not electrified and AC electricity charging is inconvenient, the solar energy charger only needs to be placed in the sun, and then the charge-discharge storage battery can be directly charged.

title: Foldable solar energy assembly and mobile vehicle having the same
abstract: The present utility model relates to a solar energy assembly having a main frame, at least one solar energy panel frame, a driving device, and an electrical assembly. The at least one solar energy panel frame is pivotally and foldablly connected with the main frame. Each solar energy panel frame has multiple solar energy panels mounted thereon. The driving device is mounted on the main frame and connected to the at least one solar energy panel frame to pivot the at least one solar energy panel frame related to the main frame. The electrical assembly has a battery electrically connected to the solar energy panels on the at least one solar panel energy frame and a distribution box electrically connected with the battery.

title: Solar energy power generation system for power grid
abstract: The invention relates to a solar energy power generation system for a power grid. The system comprises a substrate, solar energy cells and leads, wherein the substrate is laid on the ground, an upper end surface of the substrate is provided with a sunlight reflection layer, the sunlight reflection layer on the substrate is provided with multiple solar energy cells arranged in an array mode, the solar energy cells are cylindrical, the solar energy cells are vertically mounted on the substrate, an outer wall of the solar energy cells is provided with a mirror reflection layer, height of the solar energy cells is in a range of 1-10mm, the solar energy cells are respectively provided with the leads, and current generated by the solar energy cells are conducted to electrical storage equipment of a power grid system through the leads.

title: Embedded wearable solar power supply system and control method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses an embedded wearable solar power supply system and a control method thereof. The system comprises a solar cell module, an energy storage module and a controller, wherein the solar cell module is a flexible solar cell array and is used for converting solar energy into electric energy; the energy storage module is composed of multiple super capacitors and is used for storing the electric energy; the controller is used for calculating a continuously changing maximum power point according to a maximum power point tracking algorithm when outside illumination intensity changes. Charging and discharging management is conducted according to the magnitude of energy needed by a load, and if the energy needed by the load is less than energy provided by the solar cell module, the solar cell module supplies power to the load and the energy storage module simultaneously; when the energy needed by the load is larger than the energy provided by the solar cell module, the solar cell module and an energy storage element supply power to the load simultaneously. According to the embedded wearable solar power supply system and the control method thereof, the solar energy can be effectively collected, and the efficiency of collecting the solar energy by the system is improved through the maximum power point tracking algorithm.

title: Mobile solar energy storage device
abstract: The utility model discloses a mobile solar energy storage device which comprises a solar controller, a mobile box, a solar mounting rack, a bottom supporting mechanism, an angle supporting mechanism and two solar charging mechanisms. According to the mobile solar energy storage device, the solar charging mechanism is used for charging the storage battery through the solar controller, and the requirements of solar power generation and energy storage are met; the two solar charging mechanisms are stored in the moving box, and the solar energy storage device is convenient to move or store due to the foldable structure of the solar energy mounting frame; the solar energy mounting rack provides mounting conditions for the two groups of solar energy charging mechanisms, and the solar energy collection effect is good; the lower end of the bottom supporting mechanism is supported on the ground so that the moving box can be positioned, the lower ends of the angle supporting mechanism and the bottom supporting mechanism are supported on the ground, and the angle between the solar mounting frame and the two solar charging mechanisms can be adjusted by adjusting the length of the angle supporting mechanism.

title: Solar energy multidirectional tracking photovoltaic power generating system
abstract: The utility model discloses a solar energy multidirectional tracking photovoltaic power generating system, which adopts a group of solar energy optical lenses consisting of a plurality of reflecting mirrors, a Fresnel lens and a plane mirror; a rotating shaft of each solar energy optical lens is arranged on a solar energy lens support frame with different shapes; each solar energy optical lens can rotate around the shaft; the solar energy lens support frame also can move simultaneously so as to achieve the multidirectional tracking of the solar energy lenses rotating around the rotating shaft and moving along with the solar energy lens support frame; because the multidirectional tracking reduces the difficulty of single-shaft tracking, the scope of a focus in a cylinder region is simultaneously reduced, the focal time is improved, and the use temperature is improved; because a solar energy photovoltaic battery board is arranged within the cylinder region and can be arranged on the ground or a building and keep unchanged during the movement of the solar energy lenses, the focus of the solar energy photovoltaic battery board adopts changed focus tracking; and various utilization of focus tracking solar energy can be achieved through arranging the solar energy photovoltaic battery board in a cylinder. The utility model provides an array structure, is suitable for systems with different scales and is also suitable for the large-scale utilization of the solar energy simultaneously, in particular to the photovoltaic power generation and the heat utilization of the solar energy.

title: Solar energy mouse
abstract: The invention relates to a solar energy mouse comprising a mouse body, an optical sensor, an internal light source, a battery, a lens, a solar module and an energy management device. The solar energy mouse uses the lens arranged on the mouse body to focus rays; the solar module receives the rays; and the energy management device transforms the rays into electrical energy and then carries out the management of charging the battery of the mouse. The solar energy mouse can solve the problem that the traditional solar energy mouse is required to wait for the solar module to absorb enough solar energy to continue the operation when electrical power for maintaining action is insufficient.

title: High temp and capacity vacuum solar accumulator
abstract: A high-temperature high-volume vacuum solar energy-accumulating device having a solar energy heat collection system, a solar energy transmission system, a solar energy storage system and a solar energy vacuum heat insulation system inside. The device can accumulate the solar energy in a high-temperature, high-volume and high-intensity manner, and keep the temperature in a vacuum manner.

title: Solar voltage-stabilized power supply circuit
abstract: The utility model discloses a solar voltage-stabilized power supply circuit, which relates to the technical field of solar power supplies and comprises a solar module used for solar power generation and voltage stabilization by an output control module; the voltage detection module is used for carrying out undervoltage judgment on the solar energy, controlling the first energy storage module to discharge and controlling the second energy storage module to charge when the solar energy is undervoltage, and controlling the first energy storage module to store energy and controlling the second energy storage module to discharge when the solar energy is not undervoltage; and the illumination detection module is used for detecting illumination and controlling the operation of the voltage detection module. According to the solar voltage-stabilized power supply circuit, the output control module carries out voltage stabilization processing on the input electric energy, the voltage detection module judges whether the solar voltage is under-voltage, when the solar voltage is not under-voltage, the second energy storage module and the solar module supply power to the first energy storage module together, and when the solar voltage is under-voltage, the second energy storage module supplies power to the second energy storage module. The first energy storage module is used for auxiliary power supply, and the second energy storage module is used for storing solar energy.

title: NEW CONCEPT SMART PHOTOVOLTAIC POWER GENERATIOR
abstract: The present invention relates to an advanced concept intelligent solar power plant. The advanced concept intelligent solar power plant includes: a rotation reflector (10) transmitting solar energy to an upper plate condensing mirror (20); the upper plate condensing mirror (20) collecting the solar energy and transmitting the same toward the inner side; an upper plate scattering mirror (40) scattering the solar energy transmitted from the upper plate condensing mirror (20) and transmitting each of the scattered solar energy to each solar module (50); the solar module (50) generating electricity by using the solar energy; a lower plate reflecting mirror (70) reflecting the solar energy which is not allowed to be adsorbed in the solar module (50) and transmitting the same to the solar module (50); and a control box (80) in which a battery (82) storing electric energy is installed, thereby maximizing generating efficiency of the solar energy.

title: Energy-saving solar electric motorcycle
abstract: The utility model relates to a motorcycle, in particular to an energy-saving solar electric motorcycle. The energy-saving solar electric motorcycle comprises an electric motorcycle, a solar battery, a supporting plate, a supporting rod, a supporting pipe, a solar controller, a storage battery, a charger and an automatic changeover switch, wherein solar energy is converted into electric energy through the solar battery, so as to be stored in the storage battery and serve as the power source of the energy-saving solar electric motorcycle; and electric energy supply is used for supplementation. The energy-saving solar electric motorcycle has the advantages of original conception, compact structure, easiness in manufacture, and convenience in use, develops solar energy, saves electric energy, achieves energy conservation and consumption reduction, has obvious economic benefits, can be widely popularized and applied, and is also suitable for the energy-saving improvement of the conventional electric motorcycle.

title: Maximum power tracing method for solar power system and solar power device
abstract: The invention discloses a maximum power tracking method for a solar energy power supply system and the solar energy power supply unit thereof, relating to solar power generation technical field. And the method tracks the maximum power of the solar energy system by dynamic balancing. According to the method, it adds in intelligent charging-discharing mechanism to form an intelligent coordination solar energy device, comprising at least a solar panel, super capacitor, DC/DC buck-boost converter, pulse width modulation driver, storage battery, logic controller and load; and the method is characterized in that an instant power type super capacitor is connected between the solar panel and the DC/DC buck-boost converter to act as an energy dynamic balancer; it converts the electric energy produced by the solar panel into capacitor type electric energy to make the maximum power calculation, able to largely simplify calculation program, improving tracking calculation real-timeness and reliability and raising solar energy system efficiency. And the invention can be widely applied to solar LED lamps, and solar energy lamps, especially solar energy street lamps, solar traffic signal lamps, solar energy engineering lamps, etc.

title: Solar power system
abstract: The invention discloses a solar power system. The solar power system comprises a solar energy collecting device, a solar energy collecting unit, a controller, a load circuit, a storage battery and a remote management server, wherein the solar energy collecting device is used for collecting sunlight beams and converting solar energy into electric energy; the solar energy collecting unit comprises a plurality of photosensitive elements, a microprocessor and a driving module; the controller is used for controlling the electric energy to supply power to the load circuit or charge and discharge the storage battery, monitoring the states of the storage battery and the solar energy collecting device, and transmitting monitored state information to the remote management server; and the storage battery is electrically connected with the controller, and used for storing or releasing electric energy. Through adoption of the solar power system disclosed by the invention, the sunlight beams can be tracked automatically; the solar energy is utilized at maximum efficiency; real-time monitoring of the storage battery and the solar energy collecting device is realized; and the occurrence of faults of the solar power system is prevented.

title: STEREOSCOPIC SOLAR AND SOUND ENERGY ABSORPTION AND CONVERSION DEVIECE
abstract: A stereoscopic solar and sound energy absorption and conversion device includes a base, a solar energy absorption converter, a sound energy absorption converter, a storage battery and an execution device. The base is stereoscopic. The solar energy absorption converter, the sound energy absorption converter, the storage battery and the execution device are installed on the base. The solar energy absorption converter and the sound energy absorption converter are connected with the storage battery, so as to absorb solar energy and sound energy and convert them into electric energy. The storage battery supplies power for the execution device. The solar and sound energy absorption and conversion device absorbs solar and sound energy in the daytime, then converts them into electric energy, and at night, the electric energy is used for illumination or music playing and so on.

title: Solar charging station with automatically function of charging
abstract: The utility model provides a solar charging station with automatically function of charging, including the solar charging system and the fixing device that charges, the solar charging system with the fixing device that charges links to each other, solar charging head with the first telescopic link of solar charging links to each other, the solar energy protective sheath sets up the first telescopic link of the solar charging outside, solar energy butt joint connecting block is fixed solar energy protective sheath both sides, solar energy butt joint connecting block passes through solar energy butt joint axis of rotation with solar energy butt joint pole with solar energy butt joint dead lever links to each other, solar energy butt joint pole with solar energy butt joint dead lever links to each other, solar energy butt joint pole free end with solar energy butt joint movable pulley links to each other. The beneficial effects of the utility model are that effectively improving the automation of charging station and dismantling the function, the resource of the charging station of being convenient for is allocated, and the self-calibration function has effectively improved the automatic charging capability of charging station moreover, has effectively saved the manpower.

title: Solar energy photovoltaic device of vacuum glass tube and method
abstract: The invention aims to provide a solar energy photovoltaic device of a vacuum glass tube. Solar energy optical to electrical material is arranged and processed in the vacuum layer of the vacuum glass tube to convert solar energy into electric energy; after the vacuum glass tube is sealed, the vacuum glass tube can be directly used and does not need to be packaged so as to lower the cost of the existing optical to electrical material; meanwhile, fluid or a heat pipe can be arranged in the cavity of a vacuum glass tube transmitting device to control the temperature of the solar energy optical to electrical material, so that the solar energy optical to electrical material can always keep high-efficiency conversion effect, and heat energy is comprehensively utilized after being transferred by the fluid or the heat pipe, and thus, solar energy generation and temperature control are realized, solar energy conversion efficiency is improved, and solar energy heat is comprehensively and integrally utilized. In order to improve solar energy utilization efficiency, a solar energy mirror is arranged out of the device to focus solar energy, i.e. reflect, refract, project solar energy, and in order to reduce heat waste, an insulating layer is added out of the device.

title: Method for incubation and production through combination of solar energy and air energy or through application of solar energy in series connection with boiler
abstract: The invention discloses a method for incubation and production through combination of solar energy and air energy or through application of the solar energy in series connection with a boiler. A solar energy heat collecting device (2) is combined with an air energy hot water device (12) for use, or the solar energy heat collecting device is connected with the boiler in series for use. Water is used as a carrier, heat energy is transmitted to an incubation and production workshop (9), and therefore an incubation temperature is obtained in incubation. The solar energy is combined with the air energy for use or the solar energy is connected with the boiler in series for use, when it becomes cloudy and solar heat energy cannot meet the requirement for production, the air energy hot water device is started or the boiler performs heating to overcome the defects of the solar heat energy, and therefore energy is saved, emission is reduced and efficiency is improved.

title: Solar energy water heater of a compact structure
abstract: The utility model relates to a solar energy water heater of a compact structure, characterized in that; the solar energy water heater comprises a set of solar energy battery arrays capable of conversing the solar energy into the electric energy and an electric heater connected with the solar energy battery arrays by wires, the electric heater is arranged in a heat collection plate to heat the water in the heat collection plate, the solar energy battery arrays are laid on the upper surface of a hot water tank. Because a set of the solar energy battery arrays on the upper surface of the hot water tank and the matched electric heater are added, the hot water heated by the solar energy is heated for the second time and the solar energy is completely used. Even though in the winter in serious lack of sunniness, the solar energy can fully satisfy the operation requirements for heating water and simultaneously the structure of the water heater is compact and the whole floor space of the water heater is saved.

title: Solar indicator panel
abstract: The invention provides a solar indicator panel. The solar indicator panel comprises a controller, light emitting units, a supporting structure and indicating baseplates; the supporting structure and the indicating baseplates are fixedly connected into a main body, the controller and the light emitting units are disposed in the main body, and the solar indicator panel further includes an automaticadjustment solar energy collection system, wherein the automatic adjustment solar energy collection system is disposed on the main body and separately connected to an energy storage unit and the controller through a control circuit. Compared with the prior art, the solar indicator panel has the advantages that the automatic adjustment solar energy collection system provides electric energy for thelight emitting units of an indicator panel body, efficient conversion of solar energy is achieved, the utilization rate of the solar energy is increased, energy is saved, the solar indicator pane issimple in structure and easy to install and maintain, energy consumption can be reduced, and the cost is saved. The automatic adjustment solar energy collection system of the solar indicator panel canautomatically complete collection of the solar energy and is simple in structure, low in manufacturing cost, high in popularization and wide in application range.

title: HIgh efficiency reflecting solar cell collector
abstract: A solar energy battery glistening high efficiency gathering device, characterized in that, comprising a solar energy battery collector [1] and a solar energy tracking platform [2]; The solar energy battery collector [1] comprises a reflection focusing basin [20], a solar energy battery board [21] and a cooler [19]; The solar energy battery board [21] is jointed by the solar energy battery plate. Light receiving surface of the solar energy battery board [21] faces to the reflection basin [22] of the reflection focusing basin [20], the light receiving surface is located in the focusing plane of the reflection basin [22], cable is lead from the solar energy battery board [21] to transmit signal; A cooler [19] is arranged on the backside of the solar energy battery board [21], cooler [19] contacts the back surface of the each solar energy battery board, so the heat radiation structure is formed. The utility model can save 99% consumption of the solar energy battery board under the same lighting area and improve efficiency of power generation and reduce greatly manufacture cost.

title: Hybrid-control solar tracking device
abstract: The invention relates to a hybrid-control solar tracking device. The hybrid-control solar tracking device comprises a solar energy focusing platform, a mechanical control module and an MCU main control module, wherein the solar energy focusing platform is used for focusing solar energy and directly converting solar energy into heat energy; the mechanical control module is used for controlling rotation of the solar energy focusing platform, so that sun tracking of the solar energy focusing platform is achieved; and the MCU main control module is used for calculating the position coordinates of the sun automatically according to the time and a light signal which is received currently, and driving the mechanical control module to control rotation of the solar energy focusing platform. Compared with the prior art, the hybrid-control solar tracking device has the advantages that light energy is directly converted into heat energy, the conversion efficiency is high, a system is stable, tracking is accurate, and the solar energy utilization rate is increased.

title: Trailer motor home
abstract: The utility model discloses a trailer motor home. The trailer comprises a trailer body, an energy storage battery pack and a solar module, and the energy storage battery pack is mounted at the bottom of the trailer body; the solar assembly comprises a solar panel, the solar panel is arranged on the surface of the vehicle body, the angle of the solar panel can be adjusted, the solar assembly is electrically connected with the energy storage battery pack, and the solar assembly is configured to charge the energy storage battery pack through electric energy output by the solar panel. According to the trailer motor home, the energy storage battery pack is charged through the electric energy output by the solar panel, the power supply capacity of the energy storage battery pack can be improved, the user experience is improved, the angle of the solar panel can be adjusted, the light utilization rate can be increased, and electric energy supply is increased.

title: Compressed gas energy storage solar position tracer
abstract: The utility model belongs to the technical field of solar energy is collected and the energy storage, a compressed gas energy storage sun direction tracer is provided. Installing solar energy collection device in air -bag unit's upper surface, controlling solar energy collection device's deflection angle through adjusting in the air -bag unit the intracapsular atmospheric pressure of each gas andtolerance, messenger's solar energy collection device moves towards solar position all the time, reaches the effect that can follow the trail of solar position, can store the energy again. The advantage: solar energy collection device and the integration of sun tracer, not extra occupation space, can enough track the solar energy position, can save the solar energy of collection again, adjust thepower supply peak valley value of solar energy, it is reliable and stable to supply power, improves power supply quality.

title: Solar energy photothermal converter
abstract: The invention discloses a solar energy conversion device which converts solar energy into thermal energy. The invention uses at least one solar energy mirror, at least one endothermic device, thermal insulation material, sunlight transmission material, wherein the sunlight transmission material induces the sunlight having transmitted to the endothermic device which convert the solar energy into thermal energy thereby realizing novel solar energy conversion, especially the intermediate/high temperature application of solar energy.

title: Solar window shutter device
abstract: The utility model provides a solar energy shutter device, comprising at least one solar energy vane and an electric device. Wherein, the solar energy vane adopts a solar energy generating board for transforming the sunshine irradiating on into the electric energy, and the electric device takes the electric energy as the power supply. Moreover, the solar energy shutter device is further provided with a socket for the electric connection of the electric device and the electric using; and a battery is also arranged for storing the electric energy. For the best, the solar energy shutter device can include a transfer switch used for transferring the electric device to directly use the electric energy radiated by the solar energy vane or the electric energy stored in the battery.

title: Router
abstract: The utility model is applicable to the communication field and provides a router. The router comprises a solar energy reception conversion board and a wireless router, wherein the solar energy reception conversion board and the wireless router are in power supply connection in a wireless mode. According to the router, the solar energy reception conversion board receives solar energy and converts the solar energy into electromagnetic energy, the electromagnetic energy is further sent to the wireless router through the wireless electric power transmission technology to realize solar energy power supply of the wireless router, and shortage of electric power resources is alleviated, moreover, the solar energy reception conversion board and the wireless router are connected without a wire, so the solar energy reception conversion board is convenient to mount.

title: METHOD AND APPARATUS FOR PROMPTING AMOUNT OF SOLAR-AIR-ENERGY REFRIGERANT, AND DEVICE
abstract: Provided in the present application are a method and apparatus for prompting the amount of a solar-air-energy refrigerant, and a device. The method comprises: acquiring temperature data of solar-air energy, wherein the temperature data comprises a temperature value of an environment where the solar-air energy is located, an actual water temperature value in a solar-air-energy water tank, and an exhaust temperature value of a solar-air-energy compressor; determining function information of the solar-air energy according to the temperature data, wherein the function information represents whether the amount of a solar-air-energy refrigerant is normal; and outputting prompt information according to the function information. Such a process improves the reliability of the determination of the amount of a solar-air-energy refrigerant, such that solar-air energy can be effectively protected.

title: Solar lighting system
abstract: The invention provides a solar lighting system. The solar lighting system comprises a solar absorbing module, an energy converter, an energy storer, a detection circuit, a control circuit and a lighting device, wherein the solar absorbing module is used for absorbing solar energy; the energy converter is connected to the solar absorbing module; the energy storer is connected to the energy converter; the detection circuit is used for detecting lighting switch instructions and outputting detection signals according to the lighting switch instructions; the control circuit is connected to the detection circuit so as to receive the detection signals and is used for outputting the control signals to the energy storer; and the lighting device is connected to the energy storer. By the aid of the solar lighting system, the solar energy can be converted into electric energy for lighting, so that the electric energy is saved.

title: Automobile with solar energy and wind energy power supply system
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of new energy automobiles, in particular to an automobile with a solar energy and wind energy power supply system. The automobile comprises the solar energy and windenergy power supply system, wherein the solar energy and wind energy power supply system is composed of a solar energy power supply system and a wind energy power supply system, the solar energy power supply system comprises a solar panel arranged at the roof position, the wind energy power supply system comprises a wind driven generator arranged at the roof or the head position, the solar paneland the wind driven generator are connected with an inverter, the inverter is connected with a storage battery, and the storage battery is connected with an automobile motor. According to the automobile with the solar energy and wind energy power supply system, the two power generation systems of solar energy and wind energy are arranged, electric energy obtained by the power generation systems isstored in the storage battery, and energy supply to the motor is achieved, so that the solar energy and the wind energy are mixed and utilized, and when sunlight exists, the solar panel generates electricity for charging; in the processes of automobile running, downhill, braking, steering and the like, the wind driven generator generates electricity, so that the multiple utilization of the energyis realized, and the effects of the energy conservation and the environmental protection are achieved.

title: Distributed energy and energy storage equipment
abstract: According to the distributed energy source and energy storage equipment, a first solar panel and a second solar panel are arranged on a rotating limiting rod in a sleeving mode, a third solar panel is installed in a solar collecting groove, and lifting driving pieces are symmetrically installed on the two sides of the third solar panel; the output end of the lifting driving piece is connected with the first solar panel and the second solar panel in a swinging mode, the first solar panel, the second solar panel and the lifting driving piece are connected with wires, the outer ends of the wires are connected with the solar converter, an energy storage piece installation groove is formed in the energy storage equipment body, and the solar converter is installed on the energy storage piece installation groove. A first energy storage battery is installed at the bottom of the solar converter, a second energy storage battery is installed at the bottom of the first energy storage battery, the solar converter is connected with the first energy storage battery and the second energy storage battery through wires, continuous and stable operation of the energy storage equipment body is effectively guaranteed, and the problem of function interruption caused by power failure of a single battery is thoroughly avoided.

title: Wind energy and solar energy hybrid power generating system
abstract: The utility model discloses a wind energy and solar energy hybrid power generating system. The system comprises a wind power generation portion, a solar energy generation portion and an electric energy storage portion. A solar energy photoelectric panel is cooled through the heat exchange technology, kinetic energy generated by air convection and natural wind energy are fully used, and not only the photoelectric effects of the solar energy but also heat energy in the solar energy are used. The system has the advantages that the generating efficiency of the solar energy photoelectric panel is improved through cooling; both the natural wind and the kinetic energy generated by air convection are fully used, and the disadvantage of discontinuous wind energy is overcome; and energy complement of the wind energy and the solar energy is used.

title: Solar energy lamp with heat dissipation device
abstract: The utility model discloses a solar energy lamp with a heat dissipation device. The solar energy lamp with the heat dissipation device is characterized by comprising a lamp cover, a light source, a storage battery, a solar energy control chip, a circuit board and a supporting rod, wherein the circuit board is connected with the heat dissipation device, the storage battery is arranged on the bottom of the lamp cover and is closely connected with the solar energy control chip, the circuit board is arranged on the end portion of the supporting rod and is connected with the light source, and the circuit board is in electric connection with the solar energy control chip through the supporting rod. The solar energy lamp can be charged, convenience is brought to the charging of the solar energy lamp, operation is simple and easy, and attractive performance of the overall design of the solar energy lamp is guaranteed. In addition, due to the fact that solar energy and a universal series bus (USB) are used for charging, a charge mode is environment-friendly and energy-saving. The solar energy lamp is a green, energy-saving and environment-friendly product.

title: Solar wheelchair
abstract: The utility model discloses a solar energy wheelchair which comprises a body, wherein, wheels are arranged on the body. The solar energy wheelchair is characterized in that the surface of the body is provided with a solar energy cell panel which is connected with a photoelectric conversion device that is connected with an accumulator, the solar energy wheelchair also comprises a motor which is powered by the accumulator and the motor drives the wheels. The solar energy wheelchair in the utility model can make fully use of the solar energy and utilize the solar energy to generate electricity to drive the rotation of the wheelchair with convenient use and energy source conservation.

title: Solar energy storage device
abstract: The invention discloses a solar energy storage device. The device comprises a solar energy receiving module, an electric energy conversion module, a judgment module and an electric energy storage module, wherein the solar energy receiving module is a transparent glass plate and used for projecting light rays into the electric energy conversion module; the electric energy conversion module is crystalline silicon, connected between the solar energy receiving module and the judgment module and used for converting solar energy to electric energy; the judgment module is an inductive switch, is in an on state when on-load running in a circuit is sensed and is in an off state when no-load running in the circuit is sensed; the electric energy storage module is a capacitor and used for storing and releasing electric energy. Through the manner, the solar energy storage device is capable of storing electric energy for standby application after converting solar energy to electric energy, so that the purpose of solar energy storage is realized.

title: Solar energy-storage device and solar energy application device
abstract: The utility model discloses a solar energy-storage device and a solar energy application device, relates to the technical field of solar energy application and is invented in order to increase energy storage efficiency of the energy-storage device. The solar energy-storage device comprises an energy-storage tank, wherein an opening is disposed on the energy-storage tank, an insulation structure is disposed around outside of the energy-storage tank, the opening is disposed inside room enclosed by the insulation structure, a pipeline is connected to the opening and the pipeline is extended from the opening to outside the insulation structure. The solar energy-storage device is installed inside the solar energy application device. The utility model is applicable to occasions with solar energy application.

title: Novel solar energy device tent lamp
abstract: A novel solar energy device tent lamp is composed of a solar energy silicon light board, an energy storage device and a light emitting diode (LED) lamp. The energy storage device comprises a solar energy controller, a storage battery and a control circuit board. The energy storage device is provided with an input interface, an output interface, a power source indicating lamp and a power source switch. The solar energy silicon light board is electrically connected with the input interface on the energy storage device. An LED light source is electrically connected with the output interface of the energy storage device. Power is supplied by solar energy so that the novel solar energy device tent lamp is environment-friendly, safe and energy-saving. The solar energy is absorbed by the solar energy silicon light board, converted to electric energy through the solar energy controller, stored in the storage battery and used for lighting at night. Due to adoption of the LED lamp, the novel solar energy device tent lamp is simple in structure, convenient to install, capable of being used for emergency charging of digital products such as a mobile phone or a digital camera and high in practicality in outdoor use.

title: Vehicle-mounted storable solar cell panel assembly capable of easily collecting sunlight at multiple angles
abstract: The invention relates to a vehicle-mounted storable solar cell panel assembly, in particular to a vehicle-mounted storable solar cell panel assembly capable of easily collecting sunlight at multiple angles. The assembly comprises a storage frame, a first solar energy collection mechanism, a second solar energy collection mechanism and the like; first solar energy collecting mechanisms are symmetrically arranged on the two sides of the storage frame, and second solar energy collecting mechanisms are arranged in the storage frame. Through the first solar energy collection mechanism, the second solar energy collection mechanism, the third solar energy collection mechanism and the fourth solar energy collection mechanism, the vehicle-mounted storable solar cell panel can easily collect sunlight at multiple angles, the irradiation area is wide, and an automobile can be irradiated by the sun in different directions when moving.

title: Solar-based multifunctional food cooking system
abstract: The invention discloses a solar-based multifunctional food cooking system, comprising: a solar high-temperature air module, a solar photovoltaic energy module, application modules and a control module. The solar high-temperature air module is used for converting solar energy into heat energy to cook food materials; the solar photovoltaic energy module is used for converting solar energy into electric energy that is stored to power the other modules; the application modules include various domestic appliances; the control module is used for controlling operation of the solar high-temperature air module, the solar photovoltaic energy module, and the application modules. The solar-based multifunctional food cooking system is suitable for cooking food in plateau regions, providing heat and electricity on plateau, and is energy efficient and environmentally friendly.

title: Adsorption type solar energy refrigerator
abstract: The utility model discloses an adsorption type solar energy refrigerator which comprises an adsorption type refrigerator body. The adsorption type solar energy refrigerator further comprises a heating circulation pump and at least one solar heat collector, the heating circulation pump is connected with the adsorption type refrigerator body, and the solar heat collector is connected with the heating circulation pump. According to the adsorption type solar energy refrigerator, the solar heat collector is used for colleting the solar heat energy, a generator of the adsorption type solar energy refrigerator is heated through the heating circulation pump, work of the adsorption type solar energy refrigerator is further achieved, and the adsorption type solar energy refrigerator has the advantages of energy saving and environmental protection.

title: Solar energy charging umbrella
abstract: The utility model discloses an umbrella, in particular to a solar energy charging umbrella. The solar energy charging umbrella comprises an umbrella body and an electric wire, and is characterized in that a solar energy absorbing film is stuck on the periphery of the umbrella cover of the upper end of the umbrella body and connected with a solar energy converter arranged on the inner side of the upper end of the umbrella body; the solar energy converter is connected with a charging socket at the bottom end of the umbrella through the electric wire; and the solar energy absorbing film and the solar energy converter are manufactured integrally.

title: Solar energy component lamination system
abstract: The utility model provides a solar energy component lamination system, include solar energy component, place in order to carry out the hot plate that heats to solar energy component and to be located the silica -gel plate of hot plate top in order to carry out the lamination to solar energy component below solar energy component, wherein, be equipped with the integrated silica gel strip that a plurality of intervals set up on the silica -gel plate to when the silica -gel plate carries out the lamination to solar energy component, solar energy component by spacing between adjacent two integrated silica gel strips. This practical solar energy component lamination system forms spacingly to solar energy component through the integrated silica gel strip that installs the interval additional set up on the silica -gel plate, solving solar energy component on the basis of the problem uneven, that the four corners approaches is partially arranged to the lamination in -process, has further improved the efficiency of solar energy component lamination, has realized the automated production of solar energy component lamination.

title: Metallization system used for solar energy cell and solar battery array
abstract: According to the invention, a cladding such as a polymer diaphragm (310) is used as a sender of a solar energy cell (130) during a metallization period. The polymer diaphragm (310) is adhered on the back side of the solar energy cell (130). A contact hole capable of passing through the polymer diaphragm (310) is formed to expose a doped zone of the solar energy cell (130). A metal is formed in the contact hole for electrically connecting to the doped zone exposed by the solar energy cell (130). The metal is electroplated to form the metal contacts (354 and 355) of the solar energy cell (130). The solar energy cell (130) is separated from other solar energy cells by metallization through supporting of the polymer diaphragm (310), thereby the solar energy cell strings or single solar energy cell can be formed.

title: Solar energy power generating system capable of adjusting directions
abstract: The utility model discloses a solar energy power generating system capable of adjusting directions. The solar energy power generating system capable of adjusting directions comprises a solar energy panel and a track device, wherein the track device is arranged below the solar energy panel; a plurality of supporting columns are arranged between the solar energy panel and the track device; and one ends of the supporting columns are fixed on the solar energy panel, and the other ends of the supporting columns are slidably connected with the track device. The solar energy power generating system is simple in structure, the position of the solar energy panel can be adjusted according to sunshine directions, so that a contact area of the solar energy panel and sunshine is maximized, the utilization rate of the sunshine is increased, and power generating efficiency is improved.

title: Roof solar energy assembly connection structure
abstract: The utility model belongs to the technical field of solar energy power generation, and provides a roof solar energy assembly connection structure, comprising a plurality of solar energy assemblies arranged on roof, wherein the solar energy assemblies are located at the sunny side of the roof, the solar energy assemblies are provided with positioning bodies, between two adjacent solar energy assemblies there is provided a connection body, and the connection bodies and the positioning bodies are cooperated with each other to connect two solar energy assemblies. The roof solar energy assembly connection structure has the advantages of convenient installation, stable and firm connection, and convenient and fast replacement and maintenance in later period, and the integral structure can play a good part in prevention of rainwater seepage, thereby prolonging the service life of the solar energy assembly.

title: SOLAR ENERGY WATER HEATING SYSTEM
abstract: In one aspect, the invention is directed to a solar energy water heating system for heating water in a water storage tank. In one particular embodiment, the system includes a controller, a solar energy collector whose energy contribution to water in the tank is controlled by the controller, and a non-solar heating system that is not controlled by the controller. Water in the tank may be heated by one or both of the non-solar heating system and energy from the solar energy collector. The controller can determine the amount of energy contributed by solar energy to the water in the tank. In another embodiment, the solar energy water heating system incorporates a controller that controls both the operation of the pump and the operation of the non-solar heating system. In another embodiment, a network of solar energy water heating systems is provided.

title: Automatic rotatory solar energy electroplax
abstract: The utility model provides an automatic rotatory solar energy electroplax, including solar energy electroplax, first screw, strutting arrangement and base, the solar energy electroplax still includes the induction receive device, the induction receive unit bit in the bottom intermediate position of solar energy electroplax, first screw with induction receive device fixed connection, first screw with strutting arrangement one end is connected, the strutting arrangement other end with the base is connected, the utility model discloses can be automatic according to the direction of illumination of sunlight and the autogiration guarantees that the exposure rate of sunlight is the biggest, is showing and is improving the solar energy utilization ratio, energy rotatory moreover comes from the absorptive solar energy of solar energy electroplax self and adorns the electric energy that trades, does not need external energy input, has improved the independence of solar energy electroplax work, the toughened glass board of solar energy electroplax can protect the solar energy electroplax not damage moreover, has prolonged the life -span of solar energy electroplax, has improved economic benefits.

title: MOBILE SOLAR ENERGY SYSTEM
abstract: A mobile solar energy system is disclosed, which comprises a case and a solar energy device received in a chamber of the case. A cover is disposed above the chamber. The solar energy device comprises solar panels and a controlling device, and a plurality of solar modules are disposed on the solar panels. A battery module electrically connected to the controlling device is connected to the solar panels so that, when the sunlight propagates through the cover to the solar panels, the solar energy can be transformed into electric energy for charging the battery module. Thus, the solar energy device can be put into a standard case and transported in the case by a means of transportation, which makes it convenient to move with improved mobility; and a pollution-free and noise-free power supply can be provided by the solar energy device, which makes it more competitive in the market.

title: Multistage thermal power generation and poly-generation system based on the complementation of solar energy and other energy sources
abstract: The present invention aims to provide a distributed multistage thermal power generation system based on the complementation of solar energy and other energy sources. The thermal power generation system comprises solar energy collection systems, solar energy generating units and non-solar energy systems, wherein the solar energy collection systems and the solar generating units form a group of solar power generation system. The thermal power generation system also comprises at least two groups of solar power generation systems and at least one group of non-solar energy systems to provide supplementary energy sources for the solar power generation systems. One group of solar power generation systems can be connected to the other group of solar power generation systems in series and/or in parallel, therefore, the waste heat generated by power generation of the group of power generation systems can be utilized by the other group of power generation systems to realize multistage power generation through utilization of the waste heat. Two groups of solar power generation systems consist of one group of solar low-temperature power generation systems and one group of solar high-temperature power generation systems. With the addition of the equipment for complementation of other energy sources, the thermal power generation system can ensure the supplement and adjustment of energy when the solar energy changes, so as to realize stable and sustainable power generation.

title: Solar efficient power generation device
abstract: The utility model discloses a solar energy high-efficiency power generation device, which comprises a solar energy box body, a solar energy panel, a first condensing lens, a second condensing lens and an angle adjusting device, the solar energy panel is arranged in the solar energy box body, the first condensing lens is arranged in the solar energy box body, the first condensing lens is arranged above the solar energy panel, and the second condensing lens is arranged above the solar energy panel. The first condensing lens is arranged on the solar panel, the second condensing lens is overlapped on the first condensing lens, the second condensing lens is clamped on the solar box body, and the angle adjusting device is connected to the bottom of the solar box body. And by arranging the angle adjusting device, people can adjust the orientation of the solar panel according to the moving direction of the sun, so that the solar panel always faces the sun, and the power generation time and the power generation efficiency of the solar panel are improved.

title: Solar ceramic metal halide lamp
abstract: The utility model relates to a solar ceramic metal halide lamp, which comprises a solar panel, a charging current controller, an electric energy storage, an inversion converter and a lamp load, wherein the solar panel is connected with the charging current controller for converting the solar energy radiation into the electric energy; the charging current controller is used for transmitting and storing the electric energy on the solar panel into the electric energy storage, for isolating the electric energy and the commercial-frequency power supply in the electric energy storage and for transmitting the electric energy reversely to the solar panel; the electric energy storage is used for storing the electric energy, and the solar panel and the charging current controller form an electricitytransmission loop; the inversion converter, the electric energy storage and the lamp load form the other loop; the inversion converter is used for converting the DC of the solar panel or the electriccurrent storage into the AC of the standard voltage to supply power for the lamp load. In the utility model, by combining the solar energy and the commercial-frequency power supply organically, the solar energy can be used fully, thereby not only protecting the environment but also saving the energy.

title: Solar energy soundproof wall device
abstract: This invention relates to a solar energy soundproof wall device. It includes at least one soundproof wall and at least one solar energy structure. The soundproof structure contains a bottom frame and a soundproof panel. The bottom frame is disposed on a side of a highway. The soundproof is secured on the bottom frame. This solar energy structure has many solar energy bases and many solar panels. The solar energy bases are mounted on the soundproof panel. The solar panels are pivoted on the solar energy bases. So, the function of these soundproof panels is to reduce the lateral noise's transmission. Also, the pivoted angle of the solar panel can be adjusted so as to increase the power generating effect and to minimize the reflective light for drivers' eyes. Therefore, this invention can achieve the soundproof and eco-friendly solar energy generation functions. It can save the energy for lights by the road. The angle can be adjusted for increasing the solar energy absorption as well as minimizing the reflective light for drivers' eyes.

title: Solar energy mobile power supply monitoring system
abstract: The utility model discloses a solar energy mobile power supply monitoring system comprising a solar energy mobile power supply and a hand-held terminal connected with the solar energy mobile power supply; the solar energy mobile power supply comprises the following elements: a solar panel used for converting solar energy into power energy; a charging module used for storing or releasing power energy; a control module controlled by the hand-held terminal and used for adjusting a solar panel horizontal angle and charging module output current. The hand-held terminal is connected with the control module; the control module is connected with the solar panel and the charging module; a current output end of the solar panel is connected with a current input end of the charging module. The hand-held terminal is connected with the solar energy mobile power supply, so a user can use the hand-held terminal to control the solar energy mobile power supply.

title: Solar energy lighting tank
abstract: The utility model discloses a solar energy lighting tank, which includes a lighting tank body, wherein a solar energy lighting device is arranged in the tank body and includes a solar energy battery board, a storage battery and a light body; a control switch is further arranged on the solar energy lighting tank; the solar energy battery board and the control switch are arranged on the upper end surface of the solar energy lighting device and positioned at the port of the tank body; the storage battery and the light body are arranged below the solar energy battery board and the control switch; the solar energy lighting tank further includes a cover matched with the tank body, a photosensitive switch is arranged on the upper end surface of the solar energy lighting device; a connecting piece is arranged on the tank body and the cover body to connect the cover body with the tank body movably; and the upper end surface of the solar energy lighting device is clamped on the port of the tank body. By arranging the solar energy lighting device, the solar energy lighting tank not only provides romantic lighting effect, but also is environment-friendly and convenient to carry.

title: Solar aircraft safety control method based on longitudinal flight path
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles and relates to a solar aircraft safety control method based on a longitudinal flight path. The method includes the steps that a solar aircraft power system is started and a solar aircraft flies to the preset height through energy supplied by an energy storage battery and sun illumination; a solar cell panel receives sun illumination to generate electric energy, and an energy management system loaded on the solar aircraft detects the power of the solar cell panel; the level flight power and the level flight speed are obtained through a thrust and resistance balance relationship; and according to the relationship between the input power of the solar aircraft and the level flight power, the flight mode of the solar aircraft is controlled. By the adoption of the method, according to the features of the solar aircraft and external energy input, the rotation speed of propellers is controlled, the solar aircraft climbs up or conducts level flight when solar energy is sufficient, and potential energy is effectively stored; and the solar aircraft slides down when solar energy is insufficient, the flight speed of the solar aircraft is changed by conversion of potential energy and kinetic energy, and safe flight of the solar aircraft is achieved.

title: SOLAR POWER GENERATING APPARATUS AND ITS TRACKING METHOD
abstract: Disclosed are a solar power system and a solar energy chasing method thereof. According to the present invention, errors may be corrected in the installation area of a solar energy collecting plate with solar cells, particularly, in the installation direction thereof. Therefore, a control angle may be operated and determined, so that the solar cells or the solar energy collecting plate may be rotated precisely in the desired direction. In the case of disposing a plurality of solar energy collecting plates, the solar energy collecting plates may be controlled according to a predetermined rotation angle, thereby increasing solar energy absorbing efficiency.

title: Anti -wind solar energy, wind energy navigation mark lamp
abstract: The utility model relates to an anti -wind solar energy, wind energy navigation mark lamp, including cylinder, lamp body, solar energy component and accumulate device, the cylinder top is equipped with the lamp body, the cylinder is by the last wind generating set body, cylinder platform and the solar energy component of being equipped with in proper order under to, and wherein the wind generating set body uses the cylinder as axle center base setting, the circumferencial direction of cylinder is evenly sealed to be equipped with solar energy component, and solar energy component is the tile form, and wherein the solar energy component top connects with the cylinder hinge, and the solar energy component bottom is equipped with the regulation pole, it connects with the solar energy component hinge to adjust the pole, wherein adjust the pole other end and cylinder sliding connection, the accumulate device is connected with the wind generating set body, solar energy component electricity, the utility model discloses beneficial effect: but its make full use of solar energy, wind energy avoid the energy extravagant, guarantee the navigation mark lamp and normally work, and when wind -force is great, can reduce the harm that causes solar energy component to minimum, do benefit to the life -span that prolongs solar energy component.

title: Solar electric power supply system
abstract: The utility model relates to a solar energy power supply system, which is designed by aiming at the problem that the solar cell panel is not separated from the accumulator cell in the prior energy power supply system. The solar energy power supply system comprises a solar panel and an electric equipment, the solar panel is radiated by the sun and converts the solar energy into the electrical energy, the solar energy power supply system also comprises a solar cell box, the solar cell box comprises a box body and cells arranged in the box body, the cells is connected with the solar panel electrically for storing the electrical energy.
