The utility model proposes the solar energy power supply system, the solar cell box is arranged, which can store electric power when the sunlight is sufficient and release the electric power for driving the electric equipment. Simultaneously, the solar cell box not only can be arranged outdoors after being fixed with the solar cell panel, but also can be arranged indoors, thus being convenient for use.

title: Winter warming system with solar energy complementary to air energy heat pump
abstract: The utility model discloses a winter warming system with solar energy complementary to an air energy heat pump. The winter warming system with the solar energy complementary to the air energy heat pump comprises a cold water source, a hot water tank, a caliduct which is connected with the hot water tank, a solar energy warming circuit and an air energy heat pump warming circuit. The solar energy warming circuit comprises a first solar energy warming pipeline, a solar energy heat collecting board, a second solar energy warming pipeline and a third solar energy warming pipeline. The second solar energy warming pipeline is connected with a first circulation pump and a third valve, the third solar energy warming pipeline is connected with a second circulation pump and a fourth valve; the air energy heap pump warming circuit comprises the air energy heat pump, a first air energy heat pump warming pipeline and a second air energy heat pump warming pipeline, the first air energy heat pump warming pipeline is connected with a second valve, and the second air energy heat pump warming pipeline is connected with a first valve. The winter warming system with the solar energy complementary to the air energy heat pump is novel and reasonable in design, and rapid and convenient to use and operate, fully utilizes solar energy, and is good in family energy conservation and emission reduction effects, strong in practical applicability and in favor of popularizing and use.

title: Solar energy auxiliary charging system and new energy automobile
abstract: The utility model discloses a solar energy auxiliary charging system comprising a solar energy storage battery with a solar cell panel, a to-be-charged battery connected with the solar energy storage battery through a power switch, a whole automobile controller connected respectively with the solar energy storage battery and the to-be-charged battery, and an electric quantity feedback device connected with the whole automobile controller. The solar energy auxiliary charging system can store the solar energy through the solar energy storage battery with the solar cell panel at ordinary times, and can charge the to-be-charged battery of the automobile when necessary, so that the times of the new energy automobile being charged in the charging station are reduced, and the indirect pollution to the environment is further reduced.

title: Remote intelligent distributed control system and method for solar energy power generating streetlamp
abstract: The invention relates to a remote intelligent distributed control system and a remote intelligent distributed control method for a solar energy power generating streetlamp, which are applicable to a plurality of independent solar energy power generating streetlamps and provide service to remote distributed control solar energy power generating streetlamps and intelligent control solar energy power generating streetlamps. The remote intelligent distributed control system for the solar energy power generating streetlamp consists of a plurality of solar energy power generating streetlamps and a remote intelligent distributed control center, wherein the solar energy power generating streetlamps comprise streetlamp posts and solar energy power generating streetlamp bodies; the solar energy power generating streetlamp bodies comprise solar panels, solar energy streetlamp controllers, accumulators, streetlamps and microprocessors with a wireless internet access function; and the solar energystreetlamp controllers are connected with the solar panels, the accumulators, the streetlamps and the microprocessors with the wireless internet access function respectively; and the remote intelligent distributed control center consists of a server and a neutral network control system and the two-way communication is realized between the remote intelligent distributed control centre and all the solar energy power generating streetlamps by an internet network.

title: Disconnect -type solar street lamp
abstract: The utility model discloses a disconnect -type solar street lamp, it includes the lamp pole, sets up solar charging device, support frame, setting the illuminator support frame below of setting belowsolar charging device on the lamp pole, wherein, solar charging device and illuminator pass through power cord electric connection, solar charging device includes the solar energy stores pylon, sets up solar energy bottom plate, single crystal solar panel, setting the solar energy bearer bar on single crystal solar panel of setting on the solar energy bottom plate on the solar energy stores pylon,the solar energy bottom plate passes through the bolt and is connected with the cooperation of solar energy stores pylon. The utility model relates to an ingenious, rational in infrastructure, its solar charging device and illuminator separate, can let the abundant sunlight that obtains of solar charging device turn into the electric energy and supply power to illuminator like this, let illuminator is luminous to shine, illuminate the road surface under it.

title: Dual-purpose water heater of solar energy and wind energy
abstract: A dual-purpose water heater of solar energy and wind energy relates to a daily-use water heater, in particular to a water heater which can heat water by both solar energy and wind energy. The dual-purpose water heater of solar energy and wind energy comprises an aerogenerator, a bracket, a power storing device, an electroluminescent piece, a water tank, a glass tube, a solar-energy reflector plateand a control switch, wherein the aerogenerator is arranged on the bracket; the bracket is arranged on the water tank; the water tank is communicated with the glass tube; the glass tube is matched with the solar-energy reflector plate to be arranged for receiving the solar energy to heat water in the glass tube; the electroluminescent piece is arranged in the water tank; and the control switch isconnected to the power storing device and the electroluminescent piece is series. The utility model has the advantages of that the dual-purpose water heater of solar energy and wind energy can use both the solar energy and the wind energy; the solar energy is used to heat water in sunny weather, and the wind energy is used to heat the water in cloud-rainy days, so the problem that a water heaterof solar energy must be heated by power can be solved completely; only one dual-purpose water heater of solar energy and wind energy needs to be arranged every home; the dual-purpose water heater of solar energy and wind energy is multipurpose, and not only is suitable for families, but also for hotels, schools, barracks, hospitals, and the like; the dual-purpose water heater of solar energy and wind energy is good for saving non-renewable energy resource.

title: Fixed point array solar energy smelting system
abstract: The invention relates to the focusing utilization of solar energy, in particular to a solar energy smelting system which realizes solar energy acquisition by adopting point focused solar mirrors and is applied to a fixed point array. The solar energy smelting system comprises at least one or at least one group of point focused solar mirrors, at least one smelting device and tracking control devices, wherein the solar mirrors are arranged on a solar mirror support, the smelting devices are arranged in solar mirror focused punctate areas and are above or below the solar mirrors, the solar mirrors change in focal length in the process of tracking solar energy, and the focal lengths of the solar mirrors are maintained to be always positioned in punctate areas of the smelting devices; and the tracking control devices are used for controlling the solar mirrors to focus sunlight to at least one smelting device when the sunlight changes, and the smelting devices do not move together with the solar mirrors in the process that the solar mirrors track the solar energy but maintain relative rest with the ground so as to realize the tracked focusing utilization of the solar energy.

title: Vacuum plate glass solar energy collection cluster
abstract: The utility model relates to a vacuum plate glass solar energy collection cluster, belonging to the technical filed of the solar energy utilization. The vacuum plate glass solar energy collection cluster is characterized by being provided with groups of vacuum plate glass box type solar energy collectors; the groups of vacuum plate glass box type solar energy collectors are sequentially connected in parallel by pipes to form a solar energy collection cluster; and the connecting pipes are internally provided with water pumps so that water heated by the solar energy collectors and cold water are circulated to promote heat energy absorption and utilization. The vacuum plate glass solar energy collection cluster has simple and reasonable structure, easy production and manufacturing, convenient installation and low manufacturing cost of unit solar energy collection area, improves the solar energy collection efficiency in unit area by over 30 percent compared with the prior solar energy collector and can be widely applied to family heat supply and large-scale centralized heat supply.

title: Novel garbage can
abstract: The invention relates to a novel garbage can. The novel garbage can comprises a can body and a solar energy device, and is characterized in that the solar energy device is positioned above the can body, wherein a garbage can opening is formed in the can body, is provided with a lead, and is connected with the solar energy device; the solar energy device comprises an LED lamp, solar battery panels, an accumulator, a control panel and a speaker; the speaker is used for giving a sound to tell people to classify garbage; the solar battery panels are arranged at the top and two sides of the solar energy device; and the LED lamp is arranged on the solar energy device opposite to the lower side of the garbage can opening. The garbage can converts solar energy to electric energy so as to achieve the effects of energy conservation and environmental protection.

title: Solar energy lamp
abstract: The utility model relates to a solar energy lamp which comprises a pot body and a wick, wherein the pot body is made of frosted glass; the wick is wedged in the pot body through extension; and a cover is arranged at the upper part of the pot body. A solar energy plate is arranged in the solar energy lamp of the utility model, a circumscribed power supply is not needed, and the whole solar energy lamp is designed into a pot shape so that the solar energy lamp is beautiful and novel. The design of the solar energy lamp has certain waterproofness, and the solar energy lamp can be used outdoors. Meanwhile, the solar energy lamp has the function of ray induction. After outside ray intensity reaches the needed generation power of a solar energy battery board, lamplight is automatically switched off to charge.

title: Multifunctional solar lighter
abstract: The utility model relates to a lighter, in particular to a multifunctional solar lighter, which includes an electronic storage device and a lighter main body butted with the storage device, wherein the lighter main body includes a solar plane used for converting solar energy into electric energy, and an electronic lighting device electrically connected with the solar plane. The multifunctional solar lighter can utilize solar energy, convert solar energy into electric energy, save energy, protect environment, and play the function of storing information.

title: Solar energy comprehensive utilization system
abstract: The invention relates to a solar energy comprehensive utilization system, which comprises a plurality of diversion pipes, a solar energy conversion device, an ascension accelerating tube, an energy output device and medium. The diversion pipes are communicated with the solar energy conversion device, the ascension accelerating tube and the energy output device to form a circulation loop; the medium is arranged in the loop; the solar energy conversion device absorbs solar energy and converts the solar energy to thermal energy to heat the medium in the solar energy conversion device and circulates the medium in the loop; the heated medium is accelerated by the ascension accelerating tube and outputs energy via the energy output device. The system has the advantages of low cost and environmental friendliness, and is capable of outputting different energy via the energy output device according to the needs.

title: Fixed-point array solar-energy concentrating photovoltaic power generation system
abstract: The utility model relates to concentration and utilization of the solar energy, in particular to a fixed-point array solar-energy concentrating photovoltaic power generation system which adopts a point-concentrating solar mirror to realize collection of the solar energy. The fixed-point array solar-energy concentrating photovoltaic power generation system comprises at least one or a group of point-concentrating solar mirrors, at least one solar photovoltaic cell panel and a tracking control unit. The solar mirror is arranged on a solar mirror bracket. The solar photovoltaic cell panel is arranged within a concentrating point-shaped area of the solar mirror. While the solar mirror tracks the solar energy, the focal length of the solar mirror is changed and is always maintained within the point-shaped area of the solar photovoltaic cell panel. The tracking control unit controls the solar mirror to concentrate the sunlight to the at least one solar photovoltaic cell panel when the sunlight changes. While the solar mirror tracks the solar energy, the solar photovoltaic cell panel and the solar mirror do not move together, and the solar photovoltaic cell panel remains stationary relative to the ground, thereby realizing tracking, concentration and utilization of the solar energy.

title: Method and device to control the energy production in a solar thermal power plant
abstract: The method involves transporting solar energy with a solar energy yield between a solar array (2) of a solar power station section (8) and a solar power station section (9) by a heat transfer medium e.g. air or water vapor. The section (9) is designed for a maximum permitted energy input. The energy in the section (8) is characterized as excess energy upon exceeding the maximum permitted energy input. A part of flow of the heat transfer medium is bypassed around the station section (9) in the case of excess production of solar energy. An independent claim is also included for a device for regulating solar energy yield in a solar thermal power station.

title: Simple solar charging umbrella
abstract: The utility model discloses a simple solar charging umbrella. The charging umbrella comprises an umbrella cover, an umbrella handle, a solar absorbing film, an electric energy conversion circuit and a charging battery. The solar absorbing film is arranged on the outer side of the umbrella cover, the electric energy conversion circuit is connected with the solar absorbing film and the charging battery, and the solar energy absorbed by the solar absorbing film is converted into electric energy stored in the charging battery. The simple solar charging umbrella can sufficiently utilize solar energy to store electric energy, charging at any time is facilitated, and energy source is saved. The solar energy is converted into the electric energy in time, so that the simple solar charging umbrella is energy saving, environment friendly and applicable to various people groups. Meanwhile, according to the design of a sun umbrella, size of a common sun umbrella cannot be increased and users can accept easily.

title: Solar energy component and solar energy system that adopts this solar energy component
abstract: The utility model provides a solar energy component and solar energy system that adopts this solar energy component, relates to solar energy power generation technical field. Wherein, solar energy component includes solar energy glass and radiating basal plate, solar energy glass set firmly in radiating basal plate, radiating basal plate is equipped with the heat dissipation channel who buckles and extend, heat dissipation channel has medium inlet and medium export. The beneficial effects of the utility model are that: through set up heat dissipation channel on solar energy component's base plate for coolant can realize the cooling to solar energy component at the heat dissipation channel's that flows through in -process and base plate heat exchange.

title: Solar energy lawn lamp
abstract: The utility model discloses a solar energy lawn lamp, including casing and solar energy module, the top of casing is provided with the recess, and the bottom of recess is provided with a plurality of through -hole, the shape of solar energy module is the same with the shape of recess, and the solar energy module is fixed in the recess, be provided with human induction switch in the solar energy module, the bottom surface of solar energy module is provided with a plurality of lamp, the quantity of lamp is the same with the quantity of through -hole, and the position of lamp is corresponding with the position of through -hole, the utility model discloses solar energy lawn lamp adopts the power supply of solar energy module, need not external power supply line, and not only simple to operate practices thrift the energy consumption moreover, stores the energy through the solar energy module in the daytime, and is luminous during evening, the utility model discloses solar energy lawn lamp adopts human induction switch, has realized intelligent, energy -conservation management, just the utility model discloses solar energy lawn lamp has that outward appearance novelty, color are various, simple structure, simple to operate's characteristics.

title: Integrated test system for light energy
abstract: The utility model discloses an integrated test system for light energy, and relates to the technical field of solar energy application. The integrated test system for light energy comprises a solar energy collecting assembly, an electric power measuring instrument and a timer. The solar energy collecting assembly includes a solar panel, a controller and an accumulator, wherein the solar panel is connected with the accumulator through the controller and the accumulator is connected with the electric power measuring instrument and the timer. The integrated test system for light energy, by connecting the power energy measuring instrument and the timer to the accumulator of the solar energy collecting assembly, achieves light energy data measurement and collection for solar energy in the process of solar energy collection, so that solar energy lighting intensity data of an installation site of a solar energy lighting engineering is obtained, precision direction data for engineering installation is acquired, and a good foundation for stable operation of a lighting engineering is laid. The integrated test system for light energy has advantages of low cost, short measuring period, and accurate measurement data.

title: Solar energy conservation and emission reduction system and method for intelligent copper smelting
abstract: The invention discloses a solar energy conservation and emission reduction system and method for intelligent copper smelting, and relates to the technical field of energy conservation and carbon emission reduction, and the solar energy conservation and emission reduction system comprises a solar energy collection unit, a solar power generation unit, a power storage unit, a battery management unit, a photovoltaic control unit, a conversion unit, a main control unit, a power utilization unit and a lightning protection unit, the solar energy collection unit collects solar radiation energy, the solar power generation unit generates power through the solar radiation energy collected by the solar energy collection unit, and the electric power storage unit is used for storing electric energy generated by the solar power generation unit. The photovoltaic control unit is used for automatically controlling the solar power generation unit to charge the power storage unit and the power storage unit to supply power to the solar power generation unit load; according to the invention, solar energy is fully utilized, the power consumption of a copper smelting plant is reduced, sustainable resources are fully utilized, the energy consumption and the production cost are reduced, and the effects of saving energy and reducing carbon emission are achieved.

title: SOLAR POWER SYSTEM AND SOLAR ENERGY CHASING METHOD THEREOF
abstract: Disclosed are a solar power system and a solar energy chasing method thereof. According to the present invention, errors may be corrected in the installation area of a solar energy collecting plate with solar cells, particularly, in the installation direction thereof. Therefore, a control angle may be operated and determined, so that the solar cells or the solar energy collecting plate may be rotated precisely in the desired direction. In the case of disposing a plurality of solar energy collecting plates, the solar energy collecting plates may be controlled according to a predetermined rotation angle, thereby increasing solar energy absorbing efficiency.

title: Solar supported micro energy grid
abstract: The invention relates to a solar supported micro energy grid. The solar supported micro energy grid comprises a solar photovoltaic and composite heat collection integrated device part, a solar heat pump heating part, a soil source heat pump heating part, a soil source refrigerating air conditioner part, a solar cross-season energy storage part, an indoor environment energy storage part, a photovoltaic conversion and intelligent control micro grid part and a micro energy grid controller. The solar supported micro energy grid is characterized in that the heating part, the refrigerating part, thesolar cross-season energy storage part and the indoor environment energy cross-season energy storage part share a ground heat exchanger; the solar heating part and the solar cross-season energy storage part share a tubular collector; the heating part and the indoor environment energy cross-season energy storage part share a heat dissipation system; and the micro energy grid controller controls the whole micro energy grid to efficiently absorb solar energy and reasonably distribute energy in the micro energy grid. The solar supported micro energy grid has the beneficial effects that the microenergy grid is formed through the solar energy, soil cold flow, soil stored energy, photovoltaic power generation and the like, and heating, cooling and power supplying in the whole system are achieved.

title: Rotational gardening showing stand adopting solar energy
abstract: The invention discloses a rotational gardening showing stand adopting solar energy. The rotational gardening showing stand comprises a first solar energy charging panel, a solar energy charging controller, a solar energy storage battery, a direct-current motor, a rotary rod, a showing stand body and a connection board, wherein the first solar energy charging panel, the solar energy charging controller, the solar energy storage battery and the direct-current motor are sequentially and electrically connected; the first solar energy charging panel is arranged above the solar energy storage battery; the direct-current motor is arranged below the solar energy storage battery; an output shaft of the direct-current motor is connected with one end of the connection board; the showing stand body is fixed at the other end of the connection board; the rotary rod is arranged below the direct-current motor. The motor is driven by solar energy to drive the showing stand body to rotate, the showing effect is vivid, and the showing stand is environment-friendly, energy-saving, solid and durable in structure, ingenious in design and easy to implement.

title: Solar backpack
abstract: The utility model discloses a solar backpack specifically includes the knapsack body a solar energy component is installed to positive, the left surface of knapsack body, right flank detachable respectively, and the 2nd solar energy component, the 3rd solar energy component are still including the USB who has voltage stabilizing circuit, a solar energy component, the 2nd solar energy component, the 3rd solar energy component are established ties by a plurality of battery pieces respectively and form, the 2nd solar energy component, a solar energy component, the mutual series connection of the 3rd solar energy component, series circuit's positive negative terminal connect in USB. This solar backpack adopts portable material to be the backplate to transparent waterproof film is as the front bezel membrane, encapsulates with monocrystalline silicon or polycrystalline silicon cell slice cooperation EVA glued membrane, has that the quality is light, convenient to carry and an advantage such as breakage that is difficult for bumping.

title: Automobile energy storage system utilizing solar energy and method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a renewable energy source technology, in particular to an automobile energy storage system utilizing solar energy and an automobile energy storage method thereof. The automobile energy storage system utilizing the solar energy comprises a solar cell unit, a primary energy storage unit, a secondary energy storage unit and a charging unit, wherein the charging unit is connected between the solar cell unit and the primary energy storage unit and between the solar cell unit and the secondary energy storage unit; and under the control of the charging unit, the solar cell unit can charge the primary and secondary energy storage units, and the secondary energy storage unit can charge the primary energy storage unit. According to the embodiment of the invention, the solar energy is stored in the primary and secondary energy storage units, so that the utilization efficiency of the solar energy is greatly improved. Moreover, redundant solar energy is stored in the primary energy storage unit, so that the phenomenon of deficiency of electric quantity after the long-term idleness of an automobile can be avoided.

title: Solar tracking system and method thereof
abstract: A solar tracking system and method thereof are provided. The solar tracking system includes a plurality of solar panels, a sensing unit, a storage unit and a control unit. The sensing unit detects a solar radiation energy. The storage unit stores reference data. The control unit determines if the solar radiation energy is larger than or equal to a threshold radiation energy. When the solar radiation energy is larger than or equal to the threshold radiation energy, the control unit adjusts the elevation and azimuth of the solar panels according to the reference data. When the solar radiation energy is smaller than the threshold radiation energy, the control unit stops adjusting the elevation and azimuth of the solar panels.

title: INTEGRATED ENERGY STORAGE UNIT
abstract: An integrated energy storage unit including at least one battery disposed between a first panel and a second insulating panel, and a housing frame securing the integrated energy storage unit. A method of storing and using solar power by coupling the integrated energy storage unit with a solar device, collecting solar energy, transferring the solar energy to electric energy, storing the electric energy, transforming the energy from DC current to AC current, and powering a device. A method of preventing a solar device from overheating and increasing energy output. A method of protecting a solar device, by moving a film over a solar device upon detection of dust or at a set time, and protecting the solar device from dust.

title: Solar energy fan
abstract: The invention discloses a solar energy fan which comprises a fan main body. A solar energy photo voltaic panel is installed at the back of the fan main body. The solar energy photovoltaic panel is in an inner arc shape, and the angle of the photovoltaic panel is adjustable relative to the fan main body. A storage battery is arranged below the fan main body. The problem that in the prior art, a solar energy fan is low in solar energy conversion is solved, and due to the fact that the solar energy photovoltaic panel is arranged to be in the inner arc shape and the angle of the photovoltaic panel is adjustable relative to the level, the solar energy fan can be over against the sun by adjustment of the angle and shone by sunrays directly, and absorbs the solar energy furthest so that the fan can be completely dependent on the solar energy to be supplied with power and energy is saved.

title: INTEGRATED ENERGY STORAGE UNIT
abstract: An integrated energy storage unit including at least one battery disposed between a first panel and a second insulating panel, and a housing frame securing the integrated energy storage unit. A method of storing and using solar power by coupling the integrated energy storage unit with a solar device, collecting solar energy, transferring the solar energy to electric energy, storing the electric energy, transforming the energy from DC current to AC current, and powering a device. A method of preventing a solar device from overheating and increasing energy output. A method of protecting a solar device, by moving a film over a solar device upon detection of dust or at a set time, and protecting the solar device from dust.

title: Energy -conserving solar energy wall for building
abstract: The utility model relates to a solar energy wall field especially is an energy -conserving solar energy wall for building, including solar energy face wall, fixed plate, cleaning device, solar cell panel and locking device, the solar energy face wall is located the center department of wall body, solar energy wall from interior to exterior is equipped with heat preservation, solar cell panel and protective layer, the four corners and the center department both sides of solar energy wall are equipped with six locking device of group, corresponding every two sets of locking device outer end allis equipped with the fixed plate, and the both sides of every group fixed plate all are equipped with fixing bolt, the solar energy wall divide into first solar energy wall and second solar energy wall through the fixed plate, the left side of first solar energy wall and second solar energy wall all is equipped with cleaning device, and through the cleaning device who sets up, when the solar energy wall used for a long time, dust accumulation layer can be piled in the surface, only needed the round trip movement of pulling handle, got rid of protective layer surface's grieshoch afterwards through the brush hair, easy operation and labour saving and time saving.

title: Energy-conserving energy storage system of solar energy
abstract: The utility model discloses an energy-conserving energy storage system of solar energy, including solar energy heating the water tank, solar energy heat-retaining constant temperature water tank, solar energy heating the water tank passes through communicating pipe with solar energy heat-retaining constant temperature water tank and is connected, solar energy heating the water tank is through being connected with solar collector A communicating pipe, and solar collector A is two, be equipped with the circulating pump on communicating pipe, solar energy heat-retaining constant temperature water tank is connected with solar collector B through communicating pipe, be equipped with the circulating pump on communicating pipe, all be equipped with the fluid level control line on solar energy heating the water tank and the solar energy heat-retaining constant temperature water tank, solar energy heating the water tank top is equipped with running water moisturizing pipe, and solar energy heat-retaining constant temperature water tank lower extreme is equipped with the hot water delivery pipe the utility model discloses simple structure, reasonable in design has improved the heat preservation effect, can continuously keep warm, can continuously provide hot water in a large number, can satisfy production hot water water demand

title: A solar energy system used for a turret clock
abstract: The utility model relates to a solar energy system, specifically relates to a solar energy system used for a turret clock and belongs to the technical field of solar energy systems. The solar energy system used for the turret clock comprises a solar disk. An output terminal of the solar disk is separately connected to a solar energy voltage-stablizer and an electric power source distribution device. An output terminal of the solar energy voltage-stablizer is connected to the electric power source distribution device. An output terminal of the electric power source distribution device is connected to a load. The solar energy system used for the turret clock of the utility model regards a solar cell panel as a clock face; solar energy is fully utilized and converted into electric energy to supply electric power for the load so as to guarantee power supplied to a system when sudden power-off of commercial power occurs to the turret clock. A detection unit can carry out detection on electric energy of the solar disc and electric energy in commercial power and a cell to realize a function of refined intelligent detection of a system power supply and obtain a clearer understanding of system operation conditions, thereby filling gaps of supplying electric power for the turret clock by solar energy.

title: SOLAR ENERGY COLLECTION, STORAGE AND DISTRIBUTION SYSTEM AND METHOD
abstract: A system for collecting, storing and distributing solar energy includes a primary solar energy reflector, a secondary solar energy reflector, a solar energy storage and distribution device and a conveying system that transports heat energy between the storage device and a heat-dependent use application. Also disclosed are methods for collecting, storing and distributing solar energy.

title: Solar energy golf cart and cart roof component thereof
abstract: The utility model provides a cart roof component of a solar energy golf cart. The cart roof component of the solar energy golf cart comprises a solar energy layer compressed piece and frames which are arranged on the periphery of the solar energy layer compressed piece. A distance between each point of all the points on the top face of the frames and the bottom face of the solar energy layer compressed piece is less than or equal to a distance between the edge corresponding with the point of the top face of the solar energy layer compressed piece and the bottom face of the solar energy layer compressed piece. The distance between each point of all the points the top face of the frames of the cart roof component of the solar energy golf cart and the bottom face of the solar energy layer compressed piece is less than or equal to the distance between the edge corresponding with the point of the top face of the solar energy layer compressed piece and the bottom face of the solar energy layer compressed piece, namely, the frames are only arranged on the edges of the side face and the bottom face of the solar energy layer compressed piece in a sleeved mode and the top face of the frame is not higher than the edge of the top face of the solar energy layer compressed piece, and therefore the periphery of the solar energy layer compressed piece is not provided with a sheltering protrusion structure. The cart roof component of the solar energy golf cart has the advantages of being in favor of scattering of rain water or dust and then solving the problem of accumulating the rain water or the dust on the periphery of the cart roof component of the solar energy golf cart.

title: Solar chemical heat storage system for heating
abstract: The utility model relates to a solar chemical heat storage system for heating. The solar chemical heat storage system comprises an energy storage assembly, a storage battery and a boiler body, whereinthe energy storage assembly is used for absorbing solar energy and adjusting the solar energy absorption amount; the storage battery is used for storing solar energy for chemical energy conversion; the energy storage assembly comprises a solar main board and solar auxiliary boards movably arranged on the two sides of the solar main board, the solar auxiliary boards are rotationally stored at thebottom of the solar main board through fixing pieces, and the solar auxiliary boards are rotationally supported on the two sides of the solar main board through locking pieces to form the same horizontal plane with the solar main board. Briefly speaking, according to the technical scheme, a coherent and compact structure is adopted; the problems that when traditional solar chemical energy storageis applied to a heating system, incrustation is likely to be generated, and high-temperature steam cannot be greatly generated are solved, and the problem that when traditional solar chemical energy storage is applied to the heating system, the solar energy absorption amount cannot be adjusted according to the real-time situation requirement is further solved.

title: Solar energy automatically tracking device and control system thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a solar energy automatically tracking device and a control system of the solar energy automatically tracking device. The solar energy automatically tracking device comprises a base, a solar energy receiving plate bracket, a photosensitive sensor and a control unit. The photosensitive sensor is arranged on the solar energy receiving plate bracket and connected with the control unit, a set of hydraulic cylinders are arranged on the base, and push rods of the hydraulic cylinders are connected with the solar energy receiving plate bracket through spherical hinges. Sliding chutes are formed in the solar energy receiving plate bracket, shafts which are hinged to solar energy receiving plates are arranged in the sliding chutes, and the control unit is connected with controllers of the hydraulic cylinders and controls the stroke of the push rods of the hydraulic cylinders. Hydraulic control is adopted, the solar energy receiving plates can be made large, and stability of the system is good. The solar energy receiving plates can be folded, in strong breeze and other severe weather, the solar energy receiving plates are folded under the control of the control unit, therefore, external force acted on a photovoltaic system is reduced, and stability of the system is improved. The solar energy receiving plates are always perpendicular to sunlight, so that the utilization rate of solar energy is increased.

title: Agricultural solar air conditioning system
abstract: The invention relates to an agricultural solar air conditioning system, and belongs to the field of new energy application. The agricultural solar air conditioning system comprises a solar power generation system and an air conditioning system. Solar energy can be converted into electric energy by solar cell panels in the solar power generation system, and the electric energy can be stored in storage cells; the electric energy stored in the storage cells can participate in air conditioning refrigeration procedures in the air conditioning system, and accordingly a greenhouse can be cooled. Theagricultural solar air conditioning system has the advantages that the agricultural solar air conditioning system is provided with the bent solar cell panels, accordingly, the utilization rate of solar energy can be increased, the illumination angles can be enlarged, and light energy absorbed by the solar cell panels can be maximized; the sugar contents of fruits planted in the greenhouse can be increased by the aid of the agricultural solar air conditioning system, the utilization rate of the solar energy further can be increased, and consumption of fossil energy and emission of greenhouse gas such as CO2 can be reduced.

title: Photovoltaic bracket equipped with solar energy storage device
abstract: The invention discloses a photovoltaic bracket equipped with a solar energy storage device. The photovoltaic bracket comprises a plurality of supporting legs, a fixing frame, a solar energy absorbing panel, a mounting plate and a solar energy storage, wherein the supporting pins are connected to the fixing frame in a crossed manner, the solar energy absorbing panel is arranged on the surface of the fixing frame by the mounting plate, and the solar energy storage is connected with the solar energy absorbing panel. By adoption of the manner, the photovoltaic bracket equipped with the solar energy storage device is simple in structure, easy to install and stable in arrangement; when the photovoltaic bracket is used together with photovoltaic apparatuses, the solar energy storage device helps the storing of the solar energy, and an emerging technology is adopted, so that the photovoltaic bracket is more effective, faster and more convenient for resource utilization.

title: SOLAR ENERGY WATER HEATING SYSTEM, NETWORK AND METHOD
abstract: In one aspect, the invention is directed to a solar energy water heating system for heating water in a water storage tank. In one particular embodiment, the system includes a controller, a solar energy collector whose energy contribution to water in the tank is controlled by the controller, and a non-solar heating system that is not controlled by the controller. Water in the tank may be heated by one or both of the non-solar heating system and energy from the solar energy collector. The controller can determine the amount of energy contributed by solar energy to the water in the tank. In another embodiment, the solar energy water heating system incorporates a controller that controls both the operation of the pump and the operation of the non-solar heating system. In another embodiment, a network of solar energy water heating systems is provided.

title: DEVICE FOR UTILIZATION OF SOLAR ENERGY
abstract: The invention relates to the device for utilisation of solar energy, especially for its conversion into heat or electric energy, comprising an absorber (A) of solar energy and in front of it arranged optical means (OM) for concentration of solar energy, which comprises a system of side by side arranged optical converging lenses (1), whereas the optical means (OM) for concentration of solar energy is arranged reversibly adjustably between the position in front of absorber (A) of solar energy and outside absorber (A) of solar energy.

title: Novel solar water heater
abstract: The utility model relates to the field of solar energy technology, concretely relates to novel solar water heater, the utility model discloses a: the solar energy collector, the solar energy collector is hollow hemisphere, there is solar cell in the outside of solar energy collector complete cover on the surface, it is the electric energy that solar cell is used for the solar energy conversion who gathers, and it is connected with the controller, the circuit output of controller is connected with the electrothermal tube, and it is arranged in acquireing the electric energy from solar cell to the control electrothermal tube heats, the electrothermal tube sets up among heating the water tank, be equipped with delivery pipe and outlet pipe among the heating the water tank, heating the water tank sets up in the hollow cavity of solar energy collector, and is provided with the heat preservation between the inside wall of heating the water tank and solar energy collector. The utility model discloses an it is great that the angle is gathered to solar energy, and its collection does not receive the influence of sun angle, can effectual the heating, satisfy user's use needs.

title: ALTERNATING CURRENT SOLAR MODULE AND ELECTRICAL ENERGY DISPATCHING METHOD
abstract: An alternating current solar module (100) and an electrical energy dispatching method. The alternating current solar module includes a solar cell module (110), an inverter (120) and an energy storage element (130). The inverter comprises an electrical energy conversion unit (122) and a micro control unit (128). The solar cell module is used for converting solar energy to generate electrical energy. The electrical energy conversion unit is used for converting the electrical energy. The micro control unit is used for controlling the inverter to transmit the electrical energy provided by the solar cell module after being converted to the energy storage element to be stored and controlling the energy storage element to provide the electrical energy stored in the energy storage element. The alternating current solar module and electrical energy dispatching method can effectively dispatch the total power provided by the solar cell module, and the redundant electrical energy can be stored in the energy storage element.

title: Solar energy condensing boiler control system
abstract: The utility model discloses a solar energy condensing boiler control system which comprises a boiler control system and a solar energy control system. The boiler control system comprises a boiler detection transduction module, a boiler real-time processing module, a combustion automatic regulation module and a boiler display module. The solar energy control system comprises a solar energy detection transduction module, a solar energy real-time processing module, a solar energy temperature difference circulation control module and a solar energy system failure memory module. The solar energy condensing boiler control system also comprises a boiler self-detection module for detecting whether the components of the boiler system can normally operate, and a solar energy failure memory and readout module for recording the recently occurred failures of the solar energy system and reading out through computer software. The solar energy condensing boiler control system can real-time monitor a solar energy condensing boiler and provide optimization guide, and can improve the operating efficiency of the boiler, so as to achieve the purpose of saving fuel. The solar energy condensing boiler control system has compact structure, convenient operation, and good safety and reliability.

title: Wind-solar complementary solar air conditioner device
abstract: The invention belongs to solar air conditioners and particularly relates to a wind-solar complementary solar air conditioner device. The wind-solar complementary solar air conditioner device is composed of a solar battery panel, a wind driven generator, a solar thermal collector, a wind-driven heating machine, a wind-driven refrigerating machine, an electric energy inversion controller, a low-temperature air-source heat pump, a thermal energy storage device, an absorption type refrigerating machine, a cold energy storage device, an electric energy storage device and a terminal wind disk. The wind-solar complementary solar air conditioner device is characterized in that the solar thermal collector, the wind-driven heating machine and the low-temperature air source heat pump are connected with the thermal energy storage device, the thermal energy storage device and the absorption type refrigerating machine are connected with the cold energy storage device, the thermal energy storage device is connected with the terminal wind disk, the wind-driven refrigerating machine and the cold energy storage device are connected with the terminal wind disk. The wind-solar complementary solar air conditioner device has the beneficial effects that wind energy and solar energy directly supply a cold source and a heat source for the terminal wind disk, complementation of the wind energy, the solar energy and the air energy is achieved, the energy conversion efficiency is improved, cost is reduced, and energy conservation and environmental protection are achieved.

title: Edible mushroom culture medium cooling chamber
abstract: The utility model discloses an edible mushroom culture medium cooling chamber, its structure includes solar panel, control box, the cooling chamber, the cooling door, solar panel is connected with the cooling chamber, control box is connected with the cooling chamber, cooling door swing joint in cooling chamber front side, solar panel comprises solar energy group's frame and solar energy group board, solar energy group frame is connected with solar energy group board, solar energy group board is equipped with low indisputable toughened glass, the glued membrane layer, solar energy chip, the notacoria layer, the solar energy bottom plate, low indisputable toughened glass is connected with the glued membrane layer, the glued membrane layer is connected with solar energy chip, solar energy chip is connected with the notacoria layer, the notacoria layer is connected with the solar energy bottom plate, the cooling door is equipped with the handrail, visual board, the door plant, the handrail is connected in the door plant front side, visual board is connected with the door plant. The beneficial effects of the utility model are that solar panel is connected with the cooling chamber, and the cooling chamber power consumption is big, has adopted solar design, has accomplished effective energy -conservation.

title: Fluidized bed direct salt dissolving system utilizing solar energy and working method of fluidized bed direct salt dissolving system
abstract: The invention discloses a fluidized bed direct salt dissolving system utilizing solar energy and a working method thereof. During illumination, a solar heat collection mirror field gathers most of solar energy into a solar fluidized bed through tracking regulation for direct salt dissolving, and gathers a small part of solar energy into a heat accumulator and converts the solar energy into heat energy to be stored in a heat storage material; and in the non-illumination period, the heat energy stored in the heat storage material is utilized to preheat the gas, and an electric heating device in the solar fluidized bed is started to realize continuous salt dissolving. According to the invention, the fluidized molten salt particles are directly heated by solar energy to dissolve the salt, the energy transmission link is simplified, the energy transmission efficiency is improved, and the efficient utilization of the solar energy is realized.

title: Solar energy water pump
abstract: A solar energy water pump comprises a solar energy cell panel and a water pump connected with the solar energy cell panel. A solar energy controller is arranged between the solar energy cell panel and the water pump, and further connected with an energy storage machine. The solar energy controller comprises a charge controller for connecting the solar energy cell panel with the energy storage machine and an electric discharge controller for connecting the energy storage machine with the water pump. The electric discharge controller comprises an electric discharge ending machine, an inverter and a frequency changer. The water pump comprises water leaves and a variable frequency motor for driving the water leaves. Therefore, the solar energy water pump has the advantages that consumption is low, endurance time is long, solar energy cell panel power is low, initial cost investment is low, structure is reasonable, installing is simple, waterproof effect of an electrical part is good, and service life is long.

title: Solar energy lamp apparatus
abstract: The utility model relates to a light fitting device, in particular to a solar energy light fitting device using solar energy. The solar energy light fitting device is composed of a solar cell component, a solar energy light fitting nonshared control unit, a storage battery and a lamp. The solar battery component is connected with the solar energy light fitting nonshared control unit via wires, and the solar energy nonshared control unit is connected with the storage battery via one group of down-leads so as to store electricity. The solar energy nonshared control unit is connected with the lamp via the other group of down-leads. Compared with the prior art, the solar energy light fitting device has the advantages of energy conservation, long service life, stable property, high lightening brightness, intelligent control, strong applicability, etc.

title: Solar energy glass pipe cart
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of solar energy, and discloses a solar energy glass pipe cart. The solar energy glass pipe cart comprises a baffle plate, a pulley wheel and an armrest frame, wherein a plurality of upright rods for fixing solar energy glass pipes are fixedly arranged on the upper part of the baffle plate. The solar energy glass pipe cart adopts the upright rods to fix the solar energy glass pipes, wherein a certain distance is kept between each two upright rods to prevent the solar energy glass pipes from being smashed; and the solar energy glass pipe cart can load and transport a large amount of the solar energy glass pipes once, thereby providing convenience for removers to use. Besides, the solar energy glass pipe cart has a simple structure and a low manufacturing cost, and is easy to popularize and use on a large scale.

title: Intelligent sunlight room
abstract: The utility model provides an intelligent sunlight room, which relates to the technical field of sunlight rooms and comprises a room main body, a solar energy collecting component and a driving system. The solar energy collecting assembly is arranged on the outer surface of the house body and connected with the house body through the driving system, and the driving system drives the solar energy collecting assembly to move relative to the house body so that the surface of the solar energy collecting assembly can face the sunlight irradiation direction. Therefore, the technical problems that in the prior art, a solar photovoltaic panel of a sunlight room cannot rotate along with sunlight irradiation at different angles and cannot receive solar energy with the maximum area all the time, and solar energy utilization is not perfect enough are solved, and the solar energy collection assembly can rotate and can face the direct sunlight irradiation direction, so that the solar energy utilization efficiency is improved. And the solar energy collection assembly can receive solar energy with the maximum area.

title: SOLAR ENERGY ALIGNMENT AND COLLECTION SYSTEM
abstract: PURPOSE: A solar energy alignment and a collection system are provided to increase the effectiveness of collecting a solar energy by including at least two solar energy collectors having a central focal point. CONSTITUTION: In a solar energy alignment and a collection system, A plurality of solar energy receivers(6-9) are arranged on a basis member(4). The solar energy receivers are arranged into a quadrant pattern An alignment controller(40) comprises an A-D converter(44) and a D-A converter. The alignment controller is electrically connected to actuators(24,25) through corresponding control lines(65,66). An energy storage system(50) stores transformed electrical energy from solar energy.

title: Solar energy comprehensive utilization system
abstract: The invention relates to a solar energy comprehensive utilization system, which comprises a plurality of diversion pipes, a solar energy conversion device, an ascension accelerating tube, an energy output device and medium. The diversion pipes are communicated with the solar energy conversion device, the ascension accelerating tube and the energy output device to form a circulation loop; the medium is arranged in the loop; the solar energy conversion device absorbs solar energy and converts the solar energy to thermal energy to heat the medium in the solar energy conversion device and circulates the medium in the loop; the heated medium is accelerated by the ascension accelerating tube and outputs energy via the energy output device. The system has the advantages of low cost and environmental friendliness, and is capable of outputting different energy via the energy output device according to the needs.

title: Multifunctional solar table
abstract: Provided is a multifunctional solar table. The multifunctional solar table is characterized by comprising a solar energy receiving panel, an energy storage unit and an LED lamp. The LED lamp is arranged at the lower end of the solar table. The solar table can absorb solar energy and fully utilize natural energy.

PURPOSE:To effectively melt the snow on the road by providing a solar device on a slope face, storing the solar energy in the summer into the ground around a horizontal well with the solar device, and utilizing the stored energy near the horizontal well at the time of a snowfall or freezing in the winter. CONSTITUTION:A solar device 3 collecting the solar energy is provided on a slope face 2 near a road 1, and a lateral well 4 storing the solar energy collected by the solar device 3 is drilled on the slope face 2. A solar energy collecting pipe 5 is arranged on the horizontal well 4, a solar energy extracting pipe 6 is arranged at the center of the solar energy collecting pipe 5, and radiating pipes 7 are extended from the solar energy extracting pipe 6. The radiating pipes 7 are arranged at a snow melting section 8 such as a road in the snow melting state, and a circulation pump 9 circulating the water or antifreeze water to the radiating pipes 7, solar device 3, solar energy collecting pipe 5, and solar energy extracting pipe 6 is provided. Valve mechanisms 10, 11 are provided on the slope face, the water or antifreeze water is circulated between the horizontal well 4 and the snow melting section 8 for melting the snow, and the water or antifreeze water is circulated between the solar device 3 and the horizontal well 4 for storing the solar energy.

title: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR SOLAR ENERGY UTILIZATION
abstract: A system for solar energy utilization is described. The system comprises a solar receiver, a solar energy concentrator mounted on a pole extending from the solar receiver along the main axis of the system, and a solar tracking system. The solar receiver is configured for receiving solar energy from the sun and concentrating the received solar energy at a predetermined spot area. The solar receiver includes a plurality of flexible mirrors independent of each other and radially arranged around a main axis of the system. The flexible mirrors are configured to be either deployed for operation or collapsed, for example for transportation or in the cases of possible damage of the system. The solar energy concentrator is located at the predetermined spot area in which the solar energy reflected from said plurality of flexible mirrors is concentrated, and configured for converting the concentrated reflected energy into electric energy. The solar tracking system is configured for sensing position of the sun and tilting the system for directing the solar receiver towards the sun to receive and reflect maximum sunlight onto the predetermined spot area.

title: Mobile phone with solar charging function and charging method thereof
abstract: A mobile phone with the solar charging function is characterized by comprising a switch module for starting or stopping solar charging, a setting module for setting charging threshold value, a detection module for detecting electric quantity of the mobile phone, a solar energy inducting module connected with the detection module and used for receiving solar energy, a conversion module connected with the solar energy inducting module and used for converting solar energy to electricity energy, and a charging module connected with the conversion module and used for charging a battery in the mobile phone. When detecting that the electricity quantity is lower than the charging threshold value, the detection module triggers the solar energy inducting module to receive solar energy. The conversion module converts the solar energy into electricity energy, and then the electricity energy is transmitted to the battery for charging. The invention further provides a mobile phone charging method. The mobile phone with the solar charging function is simple in operation and convenient to use.

title: Photovoltaic control system
abstract: A photovoltaic control system includes a solar energy board configured for receiving solar energy, a motor connected to the solar energy board to revolve the solar energy board, a voltage/current collecting circuit configured for receiving voltage and current from the solar energy board, a micro control unit (MCU) configured for receiving the voltage and current and bringing a control signal, and a motor driver configured for receiving the control signal to revolve the motor to make the solar energy board be approximately perpendicular with solar rays.

title: Phase change energy storage type solar energy fresh air heating system
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of solar energy heating, in particular to a phase change energy storage type solar energy fresh air heating system. According to the technical scheme, thephase change energy storage type solar energy fresh air heating system comprises a solar energy air heat collecting system, heat storage systems and a control system, wherein the solar energy air heatcollecting system is used for providing hot air by utilizing solar energy; the heat storage systems comprise a winter heat storage system and a summer heat storage system; and the control system is used for realizing automatic opening and closing and manual adjustment of fans, circulating water pumps and air valves. The phase change energy storage type solar energy fresh air heating system combines a solar energy air heat collector heating system and the heat storage systems, thereby meeting heating and water usage demands for buildings. The phase change energy storage type solar energy freshair heating system has almost no operation cost except that of a small amount of electric energy consumed by a fan. Even if solar energy heating cannot completely take the place of conventional energy heating, energy provided by solar energy can account for a large proportion of total consumed energy by means of combining solar energy heating with conventional energy heating to save a lot of operating costs.

title: Combined heat and power generation system based on nuclear energy and solar energy and heating net
abstract: The invention discloses a combined heat and power generation system and heating network based on nuclear energy and solar energy, and the system comprises a nuclear energy heat supply device which is connected with a heat station heat exchange device and supplies heat by converting nuclear energy into heat energy; the solar heat supply device is connected with the heating station heat exchange device, and the solar heat supply device absorbs solar energy and converts the solar energy into heat energy to supply heat; the nuclear energy heat supply device and the solar heat supply device are matched with each other to exchange heat with the heat station heat exchange device, and the heat station heat exchange device is used for supplying heat to the user side. According to the combined heat and power generation system based on the nuclear energy and the solar energy and the heating net, combined heat and power generation is carried out on the nuclear energy and the solar energy, energy storage is combined, traditional fossil fuel heating is avoided, greenhouse gas emission is reduced, the solar energy and the nuclear energy are complementary to each other, the energy utilization rate is increased, and comprehensive utilization of the nuclear energy and the solar energy is achieved.

title: Solar energy bladeless fan
abstract: A solar energy bladeless fan comprises a base and a main body connected above the base and further comprises a solar energy power unit which comprises a solar panel and a storage battery connected with the solar panel, wherein the solar panel is positioned on the back end surface of the main body and the storage battery is positioned in the base. The solar energy bladeless fan is reasonable in structure design. The solar panel positioned at the back end surface of the bladeless fan main body does not increase size of an external space of the main body. The solar energy absorbed from the outside world can be converted into electric energy and be stored in the storage battery. When power is cut or a user goes out and carries the solar energy bladeless fan to use, electric energy stored in the storage battery can provide power supply for the bladeless fan, and therefore the solar energy bladeless fan brings great convenience to people. The solar energy absorbed by the solar panel can be used as the power supply and is environment-friendly.

title: Solar energy pseudo -ginseng drying device
abstract: Solar energy pseudo -ginseng drying device, including casing, ventilation unit and solar device, ventilation unit sets up in the both sides of casing inner wall, and solar device fixes on the outer wall on casing top, solar device includes solar panel and solar energy conversion board, and the solar panel is established in the top of solar energy conversion board, the below of solar energy conversion board and casing fixed connection, and the solar energy conversion board is connected with the battery through the wire, and the battery is established on the inner wall on casing top to be connected with ventilation unit through the wire, be equipped with the switch on the battery. This solar energy pseudo -ginseng drying device passes through the solar panel and receives light energy, is turned into light energy the electric energy and stores in the battery by the solar energy conversion board again, and the battery provides the energy makes ventilation unit blow off hot -blastly for thedrying rate of pseudo -ginseng through the hot -blast temperature of temperature regulators control, guarantees that the property of a medicine of pseudo -ginseng does not run off, the drying rate that the pseudo -ginseng has not only been accelerated to this device is and energy -concerving and environment -protective rational utilization renewable energy.

title: FOOT BATHTUB USING SOLAR ENERGY
abstract: A foot bathtub using solar energy is provided to drive a heating member thereof by creating electric energy through collecting solar light or solar heat for heating water thereof. A foot bathtub supplies warm water using heat energy or electric energy collected from solar heat through a portable solar energy collecting member. The solar energy collecting member includes a solar panel(41) for collecting the solar heat, a collecting tube(42) embedded into an inner portion of the solar panel, a circulating member(43) for supplying the warm water heated by the solar heat to the foot bathtub, plural solar cells(44) installed on the solar panel for converting solar light into electric energy, and a transformer(45) for charging electric power gained by the solar cells to a storage battery(46). The foot bathtub includes a power connecting element(19) and a switching member(18).

title: Solar LED lamp
abstract: A solar LED lamp includes an envelope having a seat, a first sleeve extending from the seat and a second sleeve extending from the first sleeve. An LED lamp is received in the second sleeve of the envelope. The LED lamp includes a heat sink and a plurality of LEDs attached to the heat sink. A solar panel covers the second sleeve of the envelope for collecting solar energy and converting the solar energy to electrical energy. A storage battery is accommodated in the first sleeve of the envelope for reserving the electrical energy from the solar panel and providing electrical energy to the LED lamp. A solar controller controls the solar panel to convert the solar energy to the electrical energy or not.

title: Linear fresnel solar arrays and components therefor
abstract: Described herein are solar energy collector systems, components for solar energy collector systems, and methods for installing solar energy collector systems. The components for solar energy collector systems include but are not limited to solar radiation absorbers, receivers, drives, drive systems, reflectors, and various support structures. The solar energy collection systems, solar radiation absorbers, receivers, drives, drive systems, reflectors, support structures, and/or methods may be used, for example, in LFR solar arrays.

title: Solar energy charging/discharging system and charging/dischar method thereof
abstract: The invention provides a solar energy charging/discharging system and a charging/discharging method thereof. The solar energy charging/discharging system according to the invention includes a solar cell, a super-capacitor, and a switch. The solar cell is for collecting solar energy and converting the solar energy into electrical energy. The s super-capacitor is coupled to the solar cell. The super-capacitor and the solar cell are coupled to a load via the switch. The super-capacitor is selectively charged/discharged according to a threshold voltage.

title: SOLAR ENERGY CHARGING/DISCHARGING SYSTEM AND CHARGING/DISCHARGING METHOD THEREOF
abstract: The invention discloses a solar energy charging/discharging system and a charging/discharging method thereof. The solar energy charging/discharging system according to the invention comprises a solar cell, a super-capacitor, and a switch. The solar cell is used for collecting solar energy and converting the solar energy into electrical energy. The super-capacitor is coupled to the solar cell. The super-capacitor and the solar cell are coupled to a load through the switch. The super-capacitor is selectively charged/discharged according to a threshold voltage.

title: Refrigerating system with complementation of air energy and solar energy
abstract: The utility model relates to a refrigerating system with complementation of air energy and solar energy. The refrigerating system comprises an air energy refrigerating subsystem, a solar energy refrigerating subsystem and a solar-thermal complementary controller. The air energy refrigerating subsystem comprises a compressor, a condenser, a throttle valve, an internal heat exchanger, a working medium pump, a heat absorber and an expander. The solar energy refrigerating subsystem comprises a solar heat collector, a heat storage water tank, a generator, a condenser, an absorber and an evaporator. The air energy refrigerating subsystem is connected to a thermo-refrigerating input end of the solar-thermal complementary controller. The solar energy refrigerating subsystem is connected to a photic-refrigerating input end of the solar-thermal complementary controller.The refrigerating system with complementation of air energy and solar energy has following beneficial effects: by adoption of complementation of two new energy including air energy and solar energy, factors such as weather and space are not limited as compared with signal energy; and the refrigerating system is simple in structure, stable in operation, high in rate of thermal energy utilization, fine in refrigerating effect and broad in application scope.

title: Solar energy charging equipment
abstract: The utility model discloses solar energy charging equipment which comprises a solar energy battery panel, a charging battery and a control case, wherein the control case is internally provided with a solar energy charging controller and an inverter, the input end of the solar energy charging controller is connected with the solar energy battery panel, the output end of the solar energy charging controller is connected with the input end of the charging battery, and the output end of the charging battery is connected with the direct current input end of the inverter. The solar energy battery panel of the solar energy charging equipment has simple structure, is convenient and practical for installation and operation, and is applicable to various working environments.

title: Solar advertising board
abstract: The invention provides a solar advertising board. The solar advertising board comprises a main body, a controller, a display screen and an electric energy storage device, wherein the controller and the display screen are connected. The solar advertising board is characterized by further comprising an automatic-adjustment solar energy collecting system, wherein the automatic-adjustment solar energycollecting system is arranged on the main body, the automatic-adjustment solar energy collecting system is connected with the controller and the electric energy storage device through control circuits. Compared with the prior art, the solar advertising board provided by the invention has the advantages that electric energy is provided for the display screen through the automatic-adjustment solarenergy collecting system, the efficient conversion of solar energy is realized, the utilization rate for solar energy is improved, energies are saved, and meanwhile, the mounting and maintenance are easy. The automatic-adjustment solar energy collecting system can automatically complete the collection for solar energy, and the manual operation is not needed; the utilization and conversion efficiencies of solar energy are effectively improved, in addition, the structure is simple, the manufacturing cost is low, the popularization is strong, and the application range is wide.

title: Solar energy and commercial power two-path power supply automatic switching circuit
abstract: The utility model discloses a solar energy and commercial power two-path power supply automatic switching circuit. The circuit comprises an MCU main control circuit, an isolation current detection circuit, a low-pass filter circuit, an AC voltage input circuit, a solar energy relay drive circuit, an AC input voltage detection circuit and a solar energy input voltage detection circuit. The utilitymodel relates to a solar energy and commercial power two-path power supply automatic switching circuit. Solar energy and commercial power are input; when the solar energy output power is detected to be insufficient, the load is driven to automatically switch the mains supply and the solar energy to supply power, the solar energy output power is inquired regularly, if the solar energy output poweris enough to supply power to the load, the solar energy is automatically switched to supply power independently, and the purpose of saving the mains supply is achieved.

title: Solar energy conversion apparatus
abstract: Apparatus is disclosed for converting solar energy to more useful forms, i.e., thermal and electrical energy. Such apparatus includes a photoelectric transducer (e.g., an array of photovoltaic cells), means for concentrating solar energy on the transducer, and means for circulating a liquid between the transducer and the solar energy concentrator. The spectral properties of the liquid are such that the liquid functions as a bandpass filter, transmitting solar energy to which the transducer is responsive and absorbing solar energy to which the transducer is non-responsive. The transmitted solar energy is converted to electrical energy by the transducer, and the absorbed solar energy is converted to heat by the liquid. Preferably, the liquid is circulated through a container which, in the vicinity of the transducer, is constructed so as to provide optical gain to the system and to integrate incident solar energy for the purpose of eliminating "hot spots" which could overheat, and thereby damage, the transducer.

title: Solar energy wall lamp
abstract: The utility model discloses a solar energy wall lamp, including lamp stand, solar energy illumination box and LED light, the top of this lamp stand is equipped with the solar energy fixing base, and on this solar energy fixing base was located to solar energy illumination box, this solar energy illumination box was including solar cell panel, battery, control scheme and luminous body, and this solar cell panel card is put on the solar energy fixing base, and this solar cell panel, battery and luminous body pass through control scheme to be connected, and this battery, luminous body and control scheme arrange this solar cell panel's bottom in, the lamp stand still is equipped with the LED fixed part in the below of solar energy fixing base, and this LED light includes light emitting component and the power of being connected with light emitting component. The utility model discloses solar energy wall lamp inner structure is succinct, simple to operate, and beauty and practicability, the potential safety hazard is not just had in the environmental protection to can satisfy the lighting needs of various weather.

title: METHOD AND SYSTEM FOR COOLING BY USING SOLAR ENERGY
abstract: A system for cooling by using solar energy, that comprises a solar energy collector for collecting solar energy and converting it to heat energy; heat pipes connected to said solar energy collector for receiving the heat energy from the collector and passing it to a Thermal-Driven Cooling Machine (TDCM) used for cooling by the heat energy; a control unit for controlling the operation of the TDCM; and a heat accumulator, connected to the solar energy collector, for accumulating the heat energy provided by the collector.

title: Solar energy sewage automatic treatment system and working method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a solar energy sewage automatic treatment system and a working method thereof, and belongs to the field of sewage treatment. The solar energy sewage automatic treatment systemincludes a solar energy sewage treatment heat recovery system, a solar energy sewage heating and electromagnetic auxiliary heating system, a solar energy power supply and auxiliary system, a solar energy low-pressure evaporation system and a solar energy sewage treatment automatic control system; the solar energy sewage treatment heat recovery system includes a raw water solar energy pre-heater and a solar energy water heater, the raw water solar energy pre-heater is connected with a raw liquid high-level tank, and the solar energy sewage heating and electromagnetic auxiliary heating system includes an electromagnetic auxiliary heater which is connected with a membrane evaporator through a hot water inlet. According to the solar energy sewage automatic treatment system, an evaporation liquid condensation heat exchanger and a first concentration liquid heat exchanger are arranged, the temperature difference between the inlet and the outlet water is not more than 15 DEG C, more than 80%of heat is recycled into the system and reused so as to achieve the purpose of energy saving and consumption reduction, the degree of automation is high, and the sewage treatment can be carried out continuously in rainy days.
